Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Compliance with all department and property operating policies and procedures.
  • Maintains cleanliness of assigned areas.
  • Utilizes equipment such as pan and broom, vacuum, Unger kits, small scrubbers etc.
  • Ensures all equipment is used and maintained in accordance with proper procedures.
  • Adheres to all safety guidelines including the use of protective equipment. Uses chemicals in a proper, safe and responsible manner.
  • Exhibits a cooperative demeanor when interacting with peers, supervisors and guests.
  • Performs duties in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Maintains proper pars and stock levels.
  • Communicates problems, challenges or unusual matters of significance to supervisor.
  • Informs supervision of needed support, supplies or repairs.
  • Supports and complies with courtesy and customer service guidelines, policies and procedures.
  • Ensures all storage areas and carts are clean and organized.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodations. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Education and/or Experience

Three to six months related experience and/or training; One year certificate from college or technical school; or equivalent combination of experience and education.

Age Requirement

Must be at least 21 years of age.

Language Skills

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.

Mathematical Skills

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw and interpret bar graphs.

Reasoning Ability

Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

Cache Creek Casino Resort Tribal Gaming License. California Driver's License may be required for specific job assignments.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodations.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to climb or balance. The employee is occasionally required to sit and taste or smell. The employee must regularly lift and /or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

Position holder is expected to distinguish between clean and dirty surfaces. Position holder is expected to, at times, carry equipment from place to place. Position holder may be expected to carry work equipment thru-out the shift. Position holder may be required to lift trash receptacles in order to properly clean and/or empty them. Position holder may, at times, be required to drive company vehicles. Position holder may, at times, be required to crawl under secured items. Position holder will commonly use heavy duty power equipment such as power washers, honing machines, etc.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodations.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to fumes or airborne particles. The employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places and toxic or caustic chemicals. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; outside weather conditions; risk of electrical shock and vibration. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This position requires the position holder to spend a great deal of time indoors and around slot machines. This is a smoke filled environment.

Additional Information

Ability to remain calm and poised under pressure. Strong work ethic with a hands-on approach. Ensures safety and security policies and procedures are followed. Good time management, organizational and interpersonal skills. Excellent attention to detail a must. Highly motivated, energetic and quality oriented. Works closely with other employees. May be required to assist other departments within the division. Maintain a professional appearance reflective of the hotel image and conduct behavior in a mature and professional manner.

title: Join Our Talent Community
description:
Join Our Talent Community

At Baylor Genetics, we’re advancing the future of healthcare through the power of genomics. For nearly 50 years, we’ve been at the forefront of genetic testing and genomic research, helping physicians and patients make more informed decisions and improving lives through innovative diagnostics. If you don’t see a role on our careers page that matches your background, we encourage you to join our Talent Community. By sharing your resume and interests, you’ll stay connected to future opportunities and our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile as new roles open. Join us as we continue to transform healthcare through genomics and precision medicine.

A culture driven by purpose, innovation, and impact

At Baylor Genetics, our work is rooted in a clear purpose: using the power of genetics to help improve human health. Our team brings together scientific expertise, clinical insight, technological innovation, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful difference for patients and families. We are united by a passion for discovery, a commitment to excellence, and the belief that our work can help shape the future of healthcare.

Patients & Customer Centricity (putting them first in all we do)

Learning (growth through curiosity, innovation, and feedback)

We collaborate across disciplines, share knowledge openly, and solve complex challenges as one united team. We recognize that our greatest impact comes from bringing diverse expertise and perspectives together.

We think critically, challenge the status quo, and hold ourselves accountable to scientific and operational rigor in everything we do. We are committed to the quality, accuracy, and integrity of the work that supports patients, providers, and the future of genomic medicine.

We treat one another with compassion, elevate diverse perspectives, and make decisions rooted in honesty and trust. We strive to create an environment where everyone can contribute, be respected, and do their best work.

If you’re motivated by meaningful work, scientific and technological innovation, and the opportunity to help shape the future of healthcare, you’ll thrive at Baylor Genetics.

title: Director of Product
description:
TL;DR: If you:

  • Have yourself designed complex physical systems;

  • Can translate customer workflows into a coherent, scalable product;

  • Have a rigorous understanding of AI models, agents, evals, and failure modes;

  • Have taken an AI product from early capability to sustained use;

  • Are as happy and capable being hands-on, as you are building and leading a team;

  • Share our vision of an AI engineer for the physical world…


… you should apply for this role!

About P-1 AI:

At P-1 AI, we are building an AI engineer agent for the physical world named Archie. We maximize Archie’s anthropomorphism so that he fits seamlessly into existing engineering teams and workflows in the form factor of a human engineer. Archie today is at the level of a junior mechanical and electrical engineer, with a quantitative intuition over the product design space and the ability to use complex engineering tools—the same tools his human teammates use. Archie's tech stack includes a custom agentic harness, structured design representation, continual skills learning, and small custom post-trained models using proprietary semi-synthetic training data sets and environments which create a deep competitive moat. Our ultimate aim is to build engineering ASI. We recently announced a $50 million Series A financing led by NEA, which added former General Electric CEO Jeff Immelt to our board. The round also included the addition of several AI luminaries from Anthropic and Nominal to our existing angel investors from Google and OpenAI.

About the opportunity:

This is one of the most impactful roles in the company. You will work alongside the CEO to refine and translate the product vision for Archie into an actionable roadmap and strike the delicate balance between vision-driven and customer-driven product development. You must bring to the role a thorough understanding of how complex physical products are designed today, as well as a nuanced perspective on the capabilities and limitations of modern AI models and harnesses. You will be a key driver of our product strategy and execution, and as such you must be a true believer in our mission to build an engineering ASI for the physical world.

About the role:

  • Continuously map our ambitious vision into a focused product strategy and feature roadmap.

  • Embed with customers, understand their workflows, and inject customer use cases into the product roadmap.

  • Develop feature specifications and requirements alongside the engineering teams.

  • Work alongside engineering leaders to drive overall product architecture.

  • Lead product from emerging AI capability to trusted, sustained use in real engineering environments, setting a rigorous bar for performance, evals, reliability, and graceful failure modes.

  • Build and lead a world-class product team—while staying deeply hands-on with discovery, design, and delivery.

About you:

  • You have intimate familiarity with engineering design for some class of complex systems. If the complex systems align with our target product verticals: data center cooling and power systems, automotive, aerospace and defense—so much the better.

  • You are deeply embedded in the AI ecosystem and have a thorough understanding of how modern AI works, its limitations, and its failure modes.

  • You’ve taken an AI product from early capability to sustained customer adoption.

  • You love the 0->1 part of the journey, being hands on, attracting top talent, and motivating a team.

  • You share our conviction that AI building the physical world will be beneficial and transformative for the human experience.

Location:

Remote (US/Canada) or in-office in San Mateo, CA. Remote employees spend one week out of six working together on-site in our San Mateo office. Relocation support available.

Benefits:

Competitive salary, bonus, meaningful equity ownership, healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and unlimited PTO.

Interview process:

  • Introductory call (30 mins)

  • Biographical/behavioural interview (45 mins)

  • Case study interview (60 mins)

  • CEO interview (30 mins)

title: Process Engineer I
description:
Job Summary:

The Process Engineer supports the facility by improving manufacturing processes. This role partners with Production, Quality, Maintenance, and Engineering teams to resolve process, quality, safety, and efficiency issues while driving continuous improvement.

Responsibilities include supporting new model launches, evaluating materials and equipment, developing process documentation, monitoring process capability, and implementing improvements using SPC and Lean/CI methods. The Process Engineer also trains and coaches team members on SOPs, problem-solving, 5S, TPM, SMED, and standard work while ensuring processes meet customer, quality, cost, and safety requirements.

Essential Functions:

  • Participate in various training and workshops to expand engineering skill set.
  • Together with the team define problems relating to product/process systems and implement improvement programs to eliminate problems. Serves as part of the team and provides support to the team(s) as required.
  • Instigates studies and actions to overcome quality, processing, and safety problems, reduce waste, and improve team performance.
  • With team members, monitors process performance to identify areas for improvement, coordinating corrective actions.
  • Train team members in Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), problem-solving, CI techniques (Ex: 5S, TPM, SMED) and ensure regular audits for the maintenance of such procedures.
  • Full participation in the New Model Introduction process by the development of new products or processes and systems.
  • Coordinates testing of new materials before their introduction into the production facility.
  • Set up systems, measure process capability, and train team members in statistical process control (SPX) to meet internal and external customer needs.
  • Guarantee that process standards correspond to the company’s objectives, costs, and supplies to meet the needs of the customer.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, i.e. Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, and related Work Instructions or SOP.
  • Evaluate Work cell set up, Equipment and Operating Procedure for ergonomic impacts and provide actions for ergonomic improvements.
  • Works in compliance with all safety rules and regulations.
  • May be required to assist in training.
  • Adherence to NSG/Pilkington Standard of Business Conduct and its Values and Principles.
  • All other duties as assigned by Manager.

Top 3 Competencies Needed for Success in the Role:

  • Decision Making – takes appropriate actions to minimize risks and maximize the opportunities in the decision-making process. Promotes the review and learning from business decisions.
  • Strategic Thinking – develops strategic plans for their part of the business by setting short and long-term goals and objectives.
  • Empowers and Develops – promotes a learning culture through coaching, stretch opportunities, sharing expertise and providing honest and helpful feedback.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Engineering (mechanical, electrical, etc.) or other technically related fields plus two (2) years relevant experience or Associates degree with a minimum of four (4) years relevant experience.
  • Aptitude to achieve proficiency in all aspects of processing technology.
  • Must be able to coach and instruct operators and process technicians
  • Knowledge of and ability to use customer and supplier prints, SPC, pressure gauges, and monitoring devices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrate leadership ability and the ability to work within a team.
  • Must be proficient in the use of business software such as Excel, Word, and MS-Outlook.
  • Must have demonstrated ability to apply inferential and deductive reasoning.

Preferred Experience

  • Two years automotive manufacturing experience
  • Automation Training/Experience (ABB Robots, Cognex Vision systems)
  • Six-Sigma Certification (Greenbelt or Blackbelt)
  • Training and experience in disciplined problem solving techniques (Ex: 5-Why, 0-D, DMEAC)
  • CAD/Solidworks

title: Full-Time Red Arrow Motorcoach Operator - Calgary
description:
Red Arrow Motorcoach Operator - Calgary (Full-Time)

1857 Centre Avenue SE, Calgary, AB | Keolis Canada - Motorcoach Division
Full-Time Permanent |Unionized Position With Seniority-based scheduling | Paid Training | Travel Perks | Health & Dental Benefits

Drive Your Career Forward with Red Arrow!

For over 40 years, Red Arrow has been one of Alberta's most trusted and recognized transportation providers, connecting communities through safe, reliable, and premium motorcoach service. Every day, our drivers help students return home, connect families, support business travel, and make it possible for thousands of passengers to travel comfortably across the province.

As a Red Arrow Motorcoach Operator, you'll be much more than a driver. You'll be the face of our organization and one of the most important parts of our passengers' experience. From the moment passengers board, they place their trust in you to deliver a safe, professional, and comfortable journey. Whether you're operating a scheduled line-run between major Alberta communities, assisting passengers with their travel needs, or representing our brand at destinations across the province, you'll play a critical role in maintaining the reputation Red Arrow has built over decades.

Red Arrow is proudly part of the Keolis Canada family. Keolis is a global transportation leader operating in 15 countries and helping more than 3.4 billion passengers travel safely and reliably every year. In Canada, nearly 2,000 employees operate transit systems, intercity motorcoaches, airport shuttles, and rail networks that connect communities from coast to coast. While Keolis may be a newer name in Western Canada, our commitment remains the same: putting safety, customer service, and our people first.

This opportunity is ideal for professional drivers who enjoy working independently, take pride in delivering excellent customer service, and are looking for a role that offers variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to travel throughout Alberta while being supported by one of the transportation industry's most respected organizations. If you're passionate about safety, professionalism, and creating exceptional customer experiences, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Red Arrow team.

Why Join Red Arrow?

  • Unionized position with seniority-based scheduling
  • Competitive earnings with mileage-based pay for scheduled line-runs
  • Hourly compensation for training and charter assignments.
  • Paid training and orientation
  • Paid overnight accommodations and per diems
  • Travel Perks Across Alberta & BC
  • Health & Dental Benefits Package & RRSP contribution program
  • Paid uniforms, including winter uniforms
  • Uniform dry-cleaning program
  • Stable employment with an industry-leading transportation company
  • Opportunity to travel throughout Alberta while getting paid to do what you enjoy

What You'll Do

  • Safely operate Red Arrow motorcoaches on scheduled line-runs, charter services, and special assignments throughout Alberta.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service while creating a welcoming and professional travel experience.
  • Conduct pre-trip, enroute, and post-trip vehicle inspections.
  • Assist passengers with baggage and travel-related inquiries.
  • Load, unload, and secure luggage and parcels.
  • Adhere to assigned schedules, routes, company policies, and safety procedures.
  • Maintain accurate electronic logs and required documentation.
  • Safely navigate varying weather, traffic, and roadway conditions.
  • Represent Red Arrow and Keolis Canada in a professional and cordial manner both on and off the road.

Please note: As part of the selection process, candidates will be required to complete a Practical Driving Assessment and demonstrate safe driving practices.

What We Are Looking For

  • Valid Class 1 or Class 2Q Driver's Licence with Air Brake Endorsement.
  • Minimum five (5) years of commercial driving experience.
  • Previous passenger transportation experience is strongly preferred.
  • Clean Driver's Abstract and commitment to safe driving practices.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Professional appearance and positive attitude.
  • Sound judgment and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively manage time.
  • Ability to assist passengers with luggage and meet the physical requirements of the position.
  • Availability to work days, evenings, weekends, holidays, and overnight assignments as required.

Please note: Compensation, benefits, premiums, and employment provisions will be governed by the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA).

The Ideal Candidate Will Have Experience In The Following:

  • Professional motorcoach operations
  • Public transit operations
  • Charter or tour services
  • Passenger transportation environments
  • Customer-facing transportation roles
  • Bilingual communication skills

Please note: Preference may be given to candidates with previous passenger transportation experience and a demonstrated commitment to customer service.

Compensation:

  • Training & Charter Work: $31.00 per hour
  • Health & Dental Package + RRSP Contributions
  • Standby Travel Perks Across Alberta & BC

title: Launch PAD Community Partner
description:

Salary range $40k-$49k depending on education and experience

Gemma Services is seeking a full-time professional for our new 5-year program based out of our Southwest Philadelphia location, that is passionate about making a difference in the lives of children and families.

Why Gemma? Gemma offers a generous benefits package that includes full medical insurance coverage at no cost to the employee, eight (8) paid holidays and over three (3) weeks of paid time off in the first year. The Community Partner will implement the Family Check Up Online model to ensure fidelity to an evidence-based practice and connect families with needed resources and referrals. This role is responsible for initiating and maintaining regular contact/support with families. The Community Partner provides coaching, skill building, hope, connections and linkages. Lived experience as a caretaker for a child 0-8 preferred. Must demonstrate proficiency in computer use, including the ability to download and navigate web-based applications on various devices such as smartphones and computers. Experience in troubleshooting common technical issues related to website access and functionality is essential as the role involves assisting families with the Family Check-Up Online program and other digital resources. Must have a valid Driver’s License. Must have reliable transportation.

title: Plywood Shift Supervisor (White City, OR)

Boise Cascade is seeking an experienced, people-focused Plywood Shift Supervisor to join the leadership team at our Plywood manufacturing plant in White City, Oregon.

This is an opportunity to make a direct impact in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where safety, teamwork, operational excellence, and continuous improvement are at the center of everything we do. The successful candidate will lead by example, make sound operational decisions, and inspire production employees to achieve outstanding results while upholding Boise Cascade’s Core Values of Integrity, Safety, Respect, and Excellence.

Primary Job Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the daily activities of production employees to support safe, efficient, and reliable operations.
  • Provide daily and weekly reports summarizing production flow, performance, and operational results.
  • Collaborate with plant personnel to identify and implement improvements related to production, quality, safety, and workflow.
  • Supervise hourly production employees in housekeeping, job safety, productivity, and compliance with company policies and procedures.
  • Promote a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Facilitate periodic safety meetings and reinforce safe work practices with hourly employees.
  • Build strong employee relations and foster a collaborative, respectful, and accountable team environment.

  • Review work performance, provide coaching and feedback, and complete employee performance appraisals.

Boise Cascade has been manufacturing wood products and distributing building materials for over half a century. title: Ai Data Engineer
description:
Descrizione dell’offerta di lavoro

The Sofidel GroupSofidel, headquartered in Porcari (Lucca), is a global leader in tissue paper production. With operations in 12 European countries and 12 U.S. States, we employ over 9,500 people dedicated to innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity. Our products—such as toilet paper, paper towels, and napkins—are distributed in more than 50 countries.We own well-known brands including Regina, Nicky, Sopalin, Le Trèfle, Hakle, Softis, Nalys, Cosynel, and KittenSoft, and also produce for private-label retailers. PURPOSE

To contribute to the development and enhancement of the Corporate Data Platform and data components developing and maintaining the company's data integration and management solutions and ensuring that data from business and manufacturing systems is collected, transformed, and made available in a reliable, secure, and efficient way.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and maintain data integration pipelines (ETL/ELT) to collect and process data from business and manufacturing systems.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including databases, ERP systems, factory systems, files, APIs, and other applications.
  • Develop and maintain data models and structures supporting reporting, analytics, and AI solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, consistency, reliability, and availability across the corporate data ecosystem.

  • Support the development, optimization, and maintenance of the Company's Data Platform and data services supporting the Agent Platform.

  • Implement and follow data governance, security, and best practice standards.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement, scalability, and long-term evolution of the company's data architecture and platforms.

Your skills for the application

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or related STEM disciplines.
  • 3–5 years of experience in similar roles.
  • Excellent knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python.
  • Experience designing ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration processes.
  • Knowledge of data modeling and modern data architectures, including Data Warehouses, Data Lakes, and Lakehouses.
  • Experience with data engineering tools and frameworks such as Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, Parquet, Airflow, or equivalent technologies.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and their related data services.
  • Knowledge of code versioning tools such as Git and, preferably, CI/CD practices.
  • Experience in monitoring data processes, data quality, logging, and troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of data governance principles, data security, and access management.
  • Very good written and spoken English; good working knowledge of Italian.

These technical skills are considered as a plus

  • Experience with streaming data, such as Kafka or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of dbt, Docker, Kubernetes, or Terraform.
  • Experience in industrial/manufacturing environments and data integration from factory systems.
  • Familiarity with platforms or architectures supporting AI/ML or agentic use cases.
  • Certifications in Cloud, Data Engineering, or Big Data.

Your Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving attitude.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts in a clear and accessible way to non-specialists.
  • Collaborative, with a team-oriented and cross-functional approach in multidisciplinary environments.
  • Proactive attitude and operational autonomy, curious and open to explore new technologies and cross-sector solutions.
  • Attention to quality, documentation, and continuous improvement; high standards of integrity, confidentiality and professional ethics.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • A full-time employment
  • The chance to work in an international Group and a concrete opportunity for professional growth
  • A dynamic environment based on teamwork
  • Sofidel Language Learning Programme through innovative digital platform

OUR APPROACH TO COMPENSATION

We are committed to offering a fair and transparent compensation approach.

This role sits within a salary range of 33.000 – 40.000, defined based on internal equity and external market benchmarks. The final offer will be tailored, reflecting the selected candidate’s experience, skills, and overall contribution to the role.

title: Mortgage Servicing Specialist
description:
Position Purpose

Upholds the Credit Union’s mission of “We do the right thing one member, one employee, and one experience at a time to strengthen the communities we serve” by assisting in all functions in the Mortgage Servicing department, including but not limited to disbursing mortgages, processing paid loans, tracking hazard and flood insurance, HMDA reporting, escrow disbursals, escrow analysis, funding and setting up of FHLB loans, and all other department functions. Provides exceptional service by assisting Credit Union members, coworkers, and outside vendors.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Assists members and credit union employees in person, by telephone, and via e- mail with questions pertaining to disbursed mortgage loans including but not limited to escrow disbursements, mortgage payments, statements, and payoffs.
  • Disburses mortgage loans by entering information onto the credit union core system while maintaining a high level of attention to detail to ensure rates, payments, and terms are entered correctly. This also includes funding loans and remitting payoff checks.
  • Submits investor loans by entering loan details into the investor software.
  • Handles mortgage escrow functions including Insurance and Tax disbursements, closeouts, and analysis.
  • Works with Third Party to track insurance and force place as needed.
  • Processes paid loans which includes typing and recording Mortgage Satisfactions within the regulation timing requirements. Investor loans require additional follow up by requesting original documents back from investor.
  • Interacts with title companies to disburse construction loan draws and as needed for post-closing questions.
  • Processes Subordination, Partial Release, and Transfer of Ownership requests.
  • Balances general ledger accounts specific to the department (Mortgage Interim Account and Escrow GL).
  • Works independently within established procedures associated with the specific job function while contributing to process improvement within the department.
  • Prepares and assists with the submission of HMDA reporting.
  • May assist in training or shadowing employees. Backs up Mortgage Document Specialist as needed to ensure mortgages are recorded timely.
  • Actively attends meetings and training sessions to remain up to date regarding policies, regulations, procedures, products, and legal requirements, including the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) policies and regulations.
  • Responsible for projects assigned by the Mortgage Servicing Supervisor, VP of Mortgage Lending or other management team members.
  • Performs miscellaneous duties as requested by Mortgage Servicing Supervisor.

Necessary Experience and Qualifications

  • Ability to read, write, and comprehend detailed and technical instructions, short correspondence, and memos; the ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals as normally acquired through completion of a high school education.
  • Ability to operate an on-line computer terminal (including a good working knowledge of the core computer system, Nautilus, Encompass, Microsoft Office, and e-mail), typewriter, scanner, fax machine, and adding machine normally acquired through a basic course or one to three months of on-the-job experience.
  • Working knowledge of the products, services, and procedures needed to process transactions as normally acquired through three-to-six months of on-the-job experience, at least one of which is with the Credit Union.
  • Ability to concentrate on and pay close attention to detail for over 90% of work time. Must be able to closely examine documentation. Requires a high degree of accuracy.
  • Analytical ability necessary to research and process mortgage paperwork from start to finish.
  • Interpersonal skills necessary to deal effectively and efficiently with a diverse group of employees, members, and vendors. Requires communication/listening skills necessary to effectively obtain necessary information in relation to mortgage loans.
  • Ability to project a professional image and practice professionalism in a financial environment.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

  • Fast-paced office environment with moderate level of noise.
  • Frequent use of telephone, scanner, copier, computer, fax machine and other office machines.
  • Prolonged sitting or standing.
  • Frequent mental and visual concentration.
  • Minimal lifting up to 25 pounds.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed in this position. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or requirements.

At Utica National Insurance Group, 1,400 employees countrywide take our corporate promise to heart every day: To make people feel secure, appreciated, and respected.

Utica National Insurance Group is an "A" rated $2.0B award-winning, nationally recognized property & casualty insurance carrier.

Operating along the Eastern half of the United States, our Home Office is based in Central New York, with Regional Office locations in NYC, Dallas and Charlotte.

What you will do

You'll be a key contributor to the company's operational excellence by conducting quality assurance reviews within our Commercial General Liability and Errors and Omissions lines. With skills in leadership, collaboration, and relationship-building, you'll share file review results and host calibration sessions. In the spirit of continuous improvement, you'll use your analytical skills to identify claim handling trends and create reports to members of our leadership team with recommendations for improvement. This position requires advanced industry knowledge and strong technical claims handling acumen.

This is a hybrid role reporting to our Charlotte-Ballantyne, NC; Woodbury, Long Island; or New Hartford, NY location.

Key responsibilities

  • Ensures timely completion of assigned file reviews, calibration sessions and analysis reports to leadership.
  • Applies advanced knowledge of the claims process, policies & procedures, systems, coverage, liability, damage estimating, and/or settlement and adherence to applicable legal and regulatory compliance standards when conducting file reviews.

  • Effectively communicates observations to all levels of leadership and provides substantiate feedback and coaching to associates. Work closely with the Director of Field Claim Operations, line of business Directors and regional leadership to ensure compliance with claim handling, practices and procedures.
  • Provide training and support to the Claims field leadership and frontline Claims staff.
  • Performs other tasks as assigned by the Director of Claims Quality and Strategy.

What you need

  • 4-year college degree preferred.
  • 4-8 years' claims experience, demonstrating expertise in underlying coverages, broad background in litigated matters and development.
  • Strong background in General Liability; background in E&O preferred.
  • People and project leadership experience preferred.
  • Solid understanding and experience with Excel and PowerPoint.

Salary range: $84,600 - $124,000

The final salary to be paid and position within the internal salary range is reflective of the employee’s work experience, their geographic location, education, certification(s), scope and responsibilities in the role, and additional qualifications.

title: Metal Finisher, Hips-Stems (3rd shift)
description:
Ready to join our team? Apply today! Make sure to check your email for follow-ups.

At MicroPort, we relentlessly strive to master every detail of our medical solutions with the purpose of prolonging and reshaping the lives of patients everywhere. We welcome motivated and talented people who want to join our dynamic and inclusive company, working together to deliver meaningful medical breakthroughs. In order to accomplish this, we hold true to our core values of Quality, Integrity, Accountability, Efficiency, Innovation, Aspiration, Dedication & Collaboration. Come and join Team MicroPort!

Why You’ll Love MicroPort

You will find our team atmosphere challenging and rewarding. In addition to working with a world-class team, receiving a competitive base salary and bonus opportunities, our U.S. employees also enjoy the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Maternity Leave, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Bereavement, 401(k) (up to 4% match with vesting from day 1), PTO, Paid Holidays, Employee Assistance Program, Education Assistance...and more! At MicroPort, we care about our employees and encourage them to make healthy lifestyle choices and embrace wellness opportunities to maintain their very best health and wellbeing.

This is a 3rd shift position: 11:00pm-7:30am, Sunday evening-Friday morning

Shift Premium: 6% for 3rd shift

Overall Summary

As a Metal Finisher, you will metal finish medical devices to meet specifications, perform quality verification of medical devices, including non-destructive testing, laser mark medical devices, and operate machines used to metal finish including belt lathes, sandblast equipment, robots etc.

Your duties will include:

Metal Finisher I:
1. Operate sandblast/glass bead machines to meet quality and production requirements.
2. Ability to read and understand work instructions.
3. Operate measuring tools including: cmm, digital/optical comparators, Tally Round, air gages, calipers and micrometers.
4. Operate belt lathe machines to meet quality and production requirements.
5. Operate robotic machines to meet quality specifications and production requirements.
6. Correctly enter data into device history routers for the product produced.
7. Perform secondary operations required for production but not necessarily on a daily basis such as but not limited to: laser marking, work order completions.
8. Enter required production data into systems used by MicroPort for business purposes. (dbh, oee, Workman, Camstar etc.
9. Straighten with hydraulic press
10. Masking medical devices.

Metal Finisher II:
1. Perform penetrant inspection process to meet quality specifications and production requirements.
2. Perform required pm’s on machines and processes.
3. Train other employees to metal finish.
4. Electro polish process (if required for production)
5. Precision finishing.
6. 6S practices and skills

Sr. Metal Finisher: (only applies to internal candidates)
1. Welding (if required for production)
2. Proficiency in metal finishing in two of the following production areas tibs, fems, hips, job shop and prototypes.
3. Troubleshooting robot issues (if required for production)
4. Heat treating (if required for production)
5. Knowledge and experience in geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

About You

We might be a great match if you have:

  • Some mechanical aptitude.
  • Basic computer application skills.
  • Basic blueprint reading skills.
  • Basic metrology / measuring skills.
  • Ability to read and write in English.
  • Ability to operate within and sustain an organized work environment.
  • Demonstration of company core values.
  • A quality focus with a strong attention to detail.
  • A strong work ethic with a sense of urgency.
  • Motivated self-starter attitude and you work well independently or within teams.

YOUR EDUCATION

High School diploma or GED required

YOUR EXPERIENCE

Metal Finisher I: minimum 1 year of related experience or equivalent technical education

Metal Finisher II: minimum 2 years related experience.

Sr. Metal Finisher: (only applies to internal candidates) minimum 3 years related experience.

title: Construction Surveillance Engineer Technician
description:
The Construction Surveillance Engineer Technician (CSET) provides on-site construction oversight, quality assurance, and technical support for projects managed by the Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC). The CSET ensures that all construction activities comply with contract specifications, drawings, applicable codes, and safety standards. This role serves as the government’s on-site technical representative, monitoring contractor performance, verifying work progress, and documenting daily construction activities.

The CSET reviews design plans, submittals, and construction schedules; inspects workmanship and materials; and assists in identifying and resolving technical issues in coordination with NAVFAC engineers and project managers. The position requires sound judgment, knowledge of construction practices, and familiarity with Department of Defense (DoD) and NAVFAC policies and procedures.

Bristol Alliance of Companies (Bristol) is committed to building lasting relationships that reflect our hard work, ingenuity, and dedication to safety. Every employee has an impact on our success, which benefits the Native Culture, land, and people of the Bristol Bay region.

Our values: People, Communities, Reputation, Teamwork, Trust, and Truth.

Essential Functions

  • Coordinate Requests from Construction Contractor. Coordinate request from the construction Contractor for outage requests, excavation permits, burn permits, haul routes and other similar items. This will require liaison with the FEAD/ROICC and appropriate base personnel (Security, Public Works, Fire Department etc.) The CSET shall track status of the various requests and anything pending after five calendar days shall be investigated and a report made to the FEAD/ROICC detailing the cause for delays in issuance. This service shall be provided continuously as required during the construction period.
  • Coordinate field activities. CSET shall work with the construction contractor, Navy client customers, activity managers, maintenance and utility servers, Federal Fire departments, and Security Police so there is a seamless coordination of construction activities.
  • Attend Safety Meetings, Contractor Quality Control (CQC) Meetings, Partnering Meetings, and other conferences and meetings as needed.

  • Develop Quality Assurance Plans in collaboration with FEAD/ROICC and other personnel.

  • Prepare Construction Representative’s Reports (CRRs).

  • Monitor construction work for project CQC compliance with contract documents.
  • Report instances of non-compliance with safety requirements.
  • Monitor compliance with environmental protection requirements.
  • Review Daily Contractor Quality Control (CQC) and Contractor Production Reports.
  • Monitor the updating of Submittal Register. Maintain Working Files.
  • Technical Review of Submittals.
  • Construction Photographic Services.
  • NAVFAC’s Electronic Construction and Facility Support Contract Management System (eCMS) shall be used to manage electronic submittals and documents.

Competencies

  • Knowledge of construction scheduling methods and familiarity with the use of scheduling software, including but not limited to Primavera Suretrak/P3/P6 and Microsoft Project.
  • Proficiency in computer software programs such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; Adobe Acrobat Professional; and RS Means/Cost Works.
  • Average agility and dexterity, CSE will be required to perform duties that involve moderate walking over rough, uneven or slippery surfaces, recurring bending, crouching, stopping, stretching, climbing ladders, walking up and down several flights of stairs or similar activities, recurring lifting of moderately heavy objects less than 50 lbs., such as testing or measuring equipment, and regular visits to construction sites.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, concisely and authoritatively in English bot orally and in writing. Experience in preparing correspondence, written reports, and in briefing management personnel.
  • Experience in developing and maintaining complex, long term, multi-year program construction management activities including submittal and Request for Information (RFI) processing.
  • Experience and familiarity with Federal building design criteria and construction guide specifications.
  • Knowledge of construction practices and techniques, e.g., proper applications of construction materials and methods of installation.
  • Ability to accurately calculate construction costs for changes, price the value of needed work and provide recommendations for equitable adjustments.
  • Ability to monitor he preparation of as-built activities of contractors to ensure that those documents are being prepared on an on-going basis. Ability to review contractor submissions of as-built drawings for completeness and accuracy and advice in writing the appropriate Government personnel as to the acceptability of such submissions.
  • Ability to identify critical and long lead-time materials and recommend procurement strategies to prevent negative impact on quality, cost, and schedule.

Required Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or GED is required.
  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience as a Quality Control Manager or Superintendent working for a General Contractor on NAVFAC or USACE projects, OR a minimum of ten (10) years of experience working as a Foreman in one or more of the following trades: carpentry, electrical, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, or concrete on commercial/industrial/military projects valued in excess of $5 million. Residential experience does not qualify.
  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience working as a Journeyman in one or more of the following trades: carpentry, electrical, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, or concrete.
  • Specialized training for Construction Quality Verification or completed an equivalent course.
  • Competent computer skills for network data entry.
  • Proficiency in using computer software programs such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook, as well as Adobe Acrobat Professional.
  • Average agility and dexterity. CSET will be required to perform duties that involve moderate walking over rough, uneven or slippery surfaces, recurring bending, crouching, stooping, stretching, climbing ladders, walking up and down several flights of stairs or similar activities, recurring lifting of moderately heavy objects less than 50 lbs. such as testing or measuring equipment, and regular visits to construction sites.
  • Ability to communicate in English effectively orally and in writing.
  • Experience in maintaining official construction site records.
  • Experience in conducting meetings to resolve problems on construction projects and briefing clients and management personnel.
  • In depth knowledge of construction practices and workmanship, including experience in proper uses of construction materials and installation methods.
  • In depth experience interpreting construction drawings and specifications on construction projects.
  • Experience in making materials take-offs for construction work.
  • Ability and experience in the inspection of materials, workmanship and construction and installation of various systems within the inspector’s area of expertise.
  • Knowledge of safety practices in the construction industry, including a background of familiarity with USACE (EM-385-1-1) and OSHA safety requirements.
  • Completed 30 Hour OSHA Construction Training within the past 2 years.
  • Must hold a certificate in USACE Construction Quality Management (CQM) for Contractors Training (maintain valid 5-year certificate) or obtain certification within 60 days of onboarding
  • A valid driver’s license.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Position may be subject to both inside and outside environmental conditions, noise sufficient to cause the worker to shout.
  • Position may be subject to a variety of physical conditions – proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electric current, working on scaffolding and high places, exposure to high heat or exposure to chemicals.
  • Position may be subject to atmospheric conditions – fumes, odors, dusts, mist, gases, or poor ventilation.
  • Position may be subject to close visual acuity to perform activities such as viewing a computer terminal and extensive reading.

Physical Qualifications

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

  • Mobility: must be able to stoop, kneel, reach, walk, lift, grasp, feel, talk, hear, and perform repetitive motions.
  • Hearing: must be able to hear audible safety alarms.
  • Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform above listed tasks in a safe manner and perform activities such as viewing a computer terminal and extensive reading.
  • Lifting: must be able to exert up to 50 pounds of force occasionally and up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body.

Benefits

Excellent salary and benefits package to include paid time off, paid holidays, comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, life, short-term disability insurance, and 401(k) plan with employer match.

title: Program Manager I
description:
Calpine, a business unit of Constellation Energy Corporation (Nasdaq: CEG), is America's largest generator of electricity from natural gas and geothermal resources with operations in competitive power markets. With 79 energy facilities in operation, Calpine’s fleet has the capacity to generate approximately 27,000 MW of electricity – enough to power approximately 27 million homes. Through wholesale power operations and its retail businesses, Calpine serves customers in 22 states and Canada. Its clean, efficient, modern and flexible fleet uses advanced technologies to generate power in a low-carbon and environmentally responsible manner.

The company was established on the premise that a strong commitment to the environment is inextricably linked to excellence in power generation and corporate responsibility. Since its founding in 1984, Calpine has led the power industry in its unwavering commitment to environmental stewardship. In addition, its renewable geothermal plants use steam generated deep below the earth's surface to produce clean, renewable electricity.

Job Summary (includes but is not limited to the following, other duties may be assigned)
This position is responsible for the implementation of major programs to include predictive maintenance program, water treatment program, transformer reliability program, incident investigation program, training program, and other similar major programs. For example, the PdM program includes day to day management of the test and maintenance fleet services contractor(s), interpretation of the test results, and recommendations to Calpine Management and Calpine Engineering of critical items that are being monitored. Coordinates and monitors the scheduling, pricing, and technical performance of company programs. Responsibilities also include aiding in the negotiation of contracts and contractual changes and coordinating preparations of proposals, plans, specifications, and financial conditions of contracts. The programs managed by the Program Manager are to provide consistent implementation of the program throughout Calpine's Fleet, improving operational reliability and efficiency. Ensures adherence to master plans and schedules develops solutions to program problems and ensures programs are consistently delivered and maintained. Provides technical guidance to other departments within Calpine. Provide technical leadership to both internal and external organizations and entities.

Job Responsibilities
• Solid, working knowledge.
• Experienced professional with full understanding of job, company and industry practices.
• Performs in fully functioning capacity, equivalent to a journey level contributor.
• Makes decisions regarding own work, often in ambiguous situations; makes recommendations regarding own function/discipline.
• Solves operational problems and associated technical issues; modifies existing tools, techniques or processes.
• Works on problems of moderate complexity.
• Uses independent judgment within defined policies and practices. Interprets guidelines, select methods, techniques and analytical approach.
• Little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments.
• May be designated project or technical lead for an ongoing process or short-term project within own department.
• Information sharing – gives and receives information such as options, technical direction, instruction and reporting results.

Specific Job Responsibilities

• Provide overall chemistry monitoring oversight for plant water treatment systems to ensure operational reliability, efficiency, and compliance.
• Maintain cooling tower chemistry oversight, including monitoring treatment programs, reviewing chemistry trends, and identifying corrective actions as needed.
• Track and oversee chemical usage, inventory, and consumption trends, ensuring proper application, optimization, and compliance with environmental requirements.
• Monitor and ensure compliance with all applicable permit conditions, including water, wastewater, stormwater, recycled water, and air quality requirements.

title: Senior Director, Global Transportation & Purchasing
description:
Senior Director, Global Transportation & Purchasing

Reports To: Vice President, Supply Chain

Travel Requirements

This is position will require approximately 25–40% travel to support strategic initiatives, supplier engagement, carrier partnerships, and operational reviews. Travel requirements may vary based on business priorities.

Position Summary

The Senior Director of Global Transportation & Purchasing is responsible for leading the organization’s upstream supply chain strategy, including strategic sourcing, purchasing, inventory planning, supplier management, global transportation, trade compliance, and supply chain analytics.

Reporting to the Vice President of Supply Chain, this leader will oversee the flow of products from supplier origin through arrival at company distribution facilities, ensuring inventory readiness, transportation efficiency, supplier performance, and cost optimization. The role is accountable for developing end-to-end supply chain visibility through robust reporting, dashboarding, and analytics that enable proactive business decisions and support organizational growth.

This position serves as a key member of the Supply Chain leadership team and will drive strategic initiatives that improve service, reduce risk, strengthen supplier partnerships, optimize global transportation networks, and support scalable business growth.

Scope of Responsibility

  • Leads a team of purchasing associates, including two direct reports.
  • Oversees strategic sourcing, purchasing, inventory planning, supplier management, global transportation, trade compliance, and supply chain analytics functions.
  • Manages multi-million-dollar transportation and procurement expenditures.
  • Supports supplier networks primarily located throughout Asia and Southeast Asia.
  • Responsible for end-to-end supply chain visibility from supplier origin through receipt at company distribution facilities.
  • Develops executive-level reporting, dashboards, and KPI frameworks that support strategic decision-making and operational performance.
  • Employee has an individual responsibility for knowledge of and compliance with laws, regulations, and policies.
  • Compliance is a condition of employment and is considered an element of job performance
  • Maintain HIPAA/patient confidentiality
  • Other job duties assigned

Direct Reports

  • Purchasing & Inventory Planning Manager
  • Transportation Analyst

Key Responsibilities

Transportation Strategy & Network Optimization

  • Develop and execute the organization’s global transportation strategy to support growth, service, and cost objectives.
  • Optimize domestic and international transportation networks to improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
  • Lead transportation planning across multiple transportation modes, including ocean, air, parcel, truckload, less-than-truckload, and intermodal.
  • Establish and manage strategic relationships with transportation providers, logistics partners, freight carriers, freight forwarders, and customs brokers.
  • Lead transportation performance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives focused on service, cost, and operational performance.
  • Oversee carrier selection, contract negotiations, and ongoing partner governance.
  • Identify and execute opportunities to optimize transportation costs, improve network performance, and enhance service levels through data-driven analysis and strategic partner management.

Supply Chain Visibility & Analytics

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive supply chain visibility strategy that provides end-to-end insight from supplier origin through final delivery.
  • Build and maintain executive dashboards that provide visibility into inventory, purchasing, transportation, supplier performance, and supply chain health.
  • Establish reporting capabilities that track product movement from factory to port, across transportation modes, through distribution centers, and into inventory.
  • Develop KPI frameworks and scorecards that provide visibility into transportation performance, inventory health, supplier reliability, service levels, and freight spend.
  • Leverage analytics to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business recommendations.
  • Present supply chain performance, strategic initiatives, and recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Partner with Information Technology, Finance, Operations, and Business Leaders to establish scalable reporting and analytics capabilities.

Strategic Sourcing, Purchasing & Supplier Management

  • Develop sourcing and procurement strategies that balance cost, quality, service, and supply continuity.
  • Lead supplier selection, contract negotiations, and long-term supplier relationship management.
  • Ensure effective supplier performance management through scorecards, business reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain strong partnerships with suppliers to support organizational growth and service objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce total landed cost while improving supplier performance and service reliability.
  • Align purchasing strategies with organizational priorities and customer needs.

Inventory Planning & Replenishment

  • Lead inventory planning and replenishment strategies to ensure product availability while optimizing inventory investment.
  • Develop reporting and planning processes that provide visibility into inventory health, stock levels, supplier performance, and supply chain risk.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to establish inventory targets, replenishment strategies, and inventory policies.
  • Monitor and proactively address inventory shortages, supply disruptions, and service risks.
  • Develop KPI frameworks that measure inventory performance, fill rates, supplier reliability, and inventory turns.

Global Trade Compliance

  • Oversee import/export compliance activities, ensuring adherence to applicable trade regulations, customs requirements, and international shipping standards.
  • Manage relationships with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics partners to ensure efficient movement of goods and regulatory compliance.
  • Monitor changes in global trade regulations, tariffs, duties, and customs requirements, proactively assessing business impacts and mitigation strategies.
  • Develop processes and controls that support compliance, risk mitigation, and supply chain continuity.

Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team while fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships across Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Information Technology, and Executive Leadership.
  • Support annual planning, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic initiatives.
  • Champion a culture of operational excellence, data-driven decision making, and customer-focused service.
  • Drive organizational alignment around supply chain priorities, performance expectations, and continuous improvement opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive supply chain leadership experience, including transportation, logistics, procurement, inventory planning, and supplier management.
  • 5+ years of experience leading managers and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated experience developing supply chain analytics, executive dashboards, and reporting frameworks.
  • Experience leading inventory planning, replenishment, or supply planning functions.
  • Demonstrated experience managing supplier performance and strategic sourcing initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of domestic and international transportation operations.
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, forecasting, replenishment, and supply planning processes.
  • Experience managing budgets, forecasts, and operational performance metrics.
  • Proven experience negotiating transportation, logistics, and supplier agreements with measurable business impact.
  • Experience managing international transportation and supplier networks.
  • Strong understanding of import/export regulations, customs processes, international shipping documentation, and trade compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable business decisions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and executive stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven success leading strategic initiatives and organizational change.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration (MBA), or related field.
  • Professional certifications such as CSCP, CPIM, CLTD, CPSM, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
  • Experience supporting supplier networks within Asia and Southeast Asia.
  • Experience developing executive dashboards and business intelligence reporting tools.
  • Advanced experience with Sigma, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar analytics platforms.
  • Experience implementing supply chain visibility, control tower, or advanced reporting solutions.
  • Experience leading transportation network optimization initiatives.
  • Experience developing supplier scorecards, governance programs, and strategic business reviews.
  • Experience managing customs brokers, freight forwarders, and international logistics providers.
  • Experience in healthcare, medical device, distribution, fulfillment, or other regulated industries.

What Success Looks Like

During the first 12 months, the successful candidate will:

  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the company’s culture, products, customers, and business priorities.
  • Build strong partnerships across business units to understand operational requirements, growth plans, and supply chain needs.
  • Assess current transportation, purchasing, inventory planning, supplier management, and reporting processes to identify strengths, risks, and opportunities.
  • Establish a long-term roadmap for transportation optimization, procurement excellence, inventory planning, and supply chain visibility.
  • Design and implement a standardized executive reporting and dashboard suite that provides meaningful visibility into transportation, inventory, purchasing, supplier performance, and supply chain health.
  • Establish a consistent reporting cadence that supports executive decision-making and proactive issue identification.
  • Build trusted relationships with key suppliers, transportation partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Identify and implement transportation optimization opportunities that improve network efficiency, service performance, and overall cost effectiveness.
  • Create KPI frameworks that align supply chain performance with organizational goals and business priorities.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of a growing global supply chain organization by developing the visibility, partnerships, processes, and strategies necessary to support long-term operational excellence and business growth.

title: Crane Operator I
description:
Summary:

Precision lifting and positioning of heavy aircraft components using remote-controlled cranes. Follow strict safety protocols, inspect lifting gear (slings, hooks), and follow detailed work instructions in manufacturing or assembly

Responsibilities:

  • Assists in a variety of material support activities to ensure the timely delivery of products to the customer.
  • Ensure rig lines are tight to eliminate swing of product and keep it safe from damage.
  • Checks rigging hardware and lifting slings for damage before and after use.
  • Follows OSHA regulations (29 CFR 1926) and company specific safety procedures, including crane lockout/tagout.
  • Maintains records and logs for production purposes.
  • Communicate with Supervisors, Riggers, and other Operators to ensure safe, efficient transfer of goods.
  • Keeps tools and tooling operational by completing preventive maintenance requirements, notifying Team Lead or Supervisor of any needed repair.
  • Report all non-conformances to Lead, Maintenance and/or Production Supervisor.
  • Follow all safety procedures and report unsafe conditions to safety officials or manufacturing supervision.
  • Report on job status and productions restraints to Team leaders and/or Production Supervisor.
  • Maintain production schedule, Earned Standard Hour objectives, quality and production goals.
  • Maintain an “Ultra C-Lean” working environment by following proper work procedures, ensuring a clean work area, and confirming at the beginning and end of each shift that the work area has an accurate inventory of tools.
  • Maintain a positive work atmosphere by acting and communicating in a manner that is safe and so that you get along with customers, clients, co-workers, and management
  • Work extended hours, overtime, and weekends when necessary to support production and operations activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by supervision.
  • free of Foreign Object Debris (FOD) and non-conformance issues strongly preferred.

Skills:

A fully qualified Level I Crane Operators will have the following skills:

  • Basic computer skills (e.g., clocking in and out, Factory Trak, Syteline)
  • Clear and effective communication
  • Accurately complete required paperwork (e.g., Work Orders, inspection records, certificates)
  • Foreign Object Debris
  • Identifying and controlling nonconforming product
  • Ultra C-Lean
  • In process Inspection
  • Production Metrics
  • Problem solving
  • Root Cause / Corrective Action
  • AS9100
  • OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Regulation
  • Orizon Crane Training Certification

Work Environment and Job Functions:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud. Proper safety precautions, including the proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), must be followed as dictated by the job and working environment.

Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job:

  • Must have ability to bend, twist and stretch arms above head and walk or stand for long periods of time
  • Must be able to reach in all directions, handle and manipulate objects and materials
  • Must be able to coordinate the movement of eyes, hands, and fingers to operate machines and equipment
  • Must have standard visual acuity (correctable by prescription glasses or contacts meets the requirement), including color recognition
  • Must be able to lift and carry a minimum of 10 lbs. to a maximum of 40 lbs.
  • Must be able to hear with or without correction
  • Must have the ability to become proficient and certified, as required, with equipment used to maneuver and store large and/or heavy objects
  • Able to stand for up to 4 hours at a time between breaks

This job description is not an exhaustive or comprehensive list of all possible job responsibilities, tasks, and duties. The responsibilities, tasks, and duties may differ from those outlined in the job description and other duties, as assigned, may be required.

Reasonable Accommodation:

Orizon will make reasonable accommodations wherever necessary for a qualified employee or applicant with a disability to complete the application process and/or to perform the essential functions of his/her position.

In order to comply with U.S. government regulations applicable to this position, all applicants must be either a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., as defined in 8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(20) or a “protected individual”, as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

title: Senior IT Project Manager
description:
Senior IT Project Manager

Tulsa, Oklahoma | Hybrid | 12-Month Contract

MaxIT Consulting – Max Corporate Group is seeking an experienced Senior IT Project Manager to lead large, complex, cross-functional technology initiatives for a major U.S. organization.

This position requires a project leader who combines strong delivery fundamentals with strategic thinking, proactive risk management, executive communication, and the ability to bring structure and clarity to complex situations.

This is a local Tulsa-area opportunity with a hybrid schedule. Candidates must be able to work onsite in Tulsa Monday through Thursday, with remote work on Friday.

The Role

You will lead multiple complex technology projects and programs with significant organizational impact.

The successful candidate will work across business leadership, technical teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure projects remain aligned with business objectives, risks are identified early, decisions are made efficiently, and initiatives deliver sustainable business value.

This position requires more than project administration. We are looking for someone who anticipates issues, challenges assumptions, presents solutions, and helps teams navigate uncertainty.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coordinate multiple complex IT projects and programs.
  • Manage initiatives with significant cross-functional and organizational impact.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, and delivery milestones.
  • Maintain risk registers, governance documentation, status reporting, and other project controls.
  • Understand business objectives and translate them into structured delivery plans.
  • Manage the complete project lifecycle from initiation through delivery and closeout.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and delivery issues before they impact project outcomes.
  • Develop and implement appropriate mitigation and contingency strategies.
  • Coordinate business leaders, technical teams, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Facilitate alignment across multiple teams with competing priorities.
  • Provide concise project-performance reporting and executive-level communications.
  • Present recommendations, alternatives, trade-offs, risks, and solution paths to leadership.
  • Support decision-making by bringing clarity and structure to ambiguous situations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project delivery through AI, automation, and emerging technologies.
  • Drive accountability for high-quality execution and measurable business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Candidates should meet one of the following experience paths:

  • Bachelor's degree with at least 7 years of Project Management experience, including at least 3 years supporting Information Technology initiatives; or
  • Approximately 11 years of relevant business and project-delivery experience demonstrating equivalent capability.

Additional requirements include:

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional technology projects.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent IT initiatives or programs.
  • Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, budgeting, governance, and lifecycle management.
  • Proven experience managing project risks, issues, dependencies, and resource constraints.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience working with business leaders, technical teams, vendors, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to prepare executive-level status reports and recommendations.
  • Strong organizational and leadership capabilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Proficiency with project-management and planning tools.

Ideal Background

Strong candidates may come from technology initiatives within industries such as:

  • Technology
  • Energy
  • Utilities
  • Infrastructure
  • Financial services
  • Healthcare
  • Enterprise services
  • Consulting
  • Public-sector organizations
  • Large-scale corporate environments

Prior Oil & Energy industry experience is not required.

Experience working in enterprise-scale environments involving formal governance, multiple stakeholder groups, vendors, complex dependencies, and executive reporting will be particularly valuable.

What Success Looks Like

Successful candidates will demonstrate four key characteristics:

Proactive Leadership

You anticipate risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities before they become significant delivery problems.

Solutions-Oriented Judgment

You bring clarity to ambiguity and provide actionable options rather than simply escalating problems.

Continuous Improvement

You actively explore AI, automation, process improvements, and emerging technologies that can improve delivery quality and team productivity.

Ownership

You remain accountable for outcomes and business value rather than focusing only on completing project-management activities.

Work Arrangement

This is a hybrid position based in Tulsa, Oklahoma.

The expected schedule is:

  • Monday through Thursday: onsite in Tulsa
  • Friday: remote

Only candidates currently located in the Tulsa metropolitan area should apply.

Candidates must also be available to attend an in-person interview at the Tulsa location.

Relocation assistance is not available.

Candidate Search Area

Relevant local communities may include Tulsa and nearby areas such as:

  • Broken Arrow
  • Jenks
  • Bixby
  • Sand Springs
  • Sapulpa
  • Owasso

Candidates should be within a practical daily commuting distance of the Tulsa worksite.

Work Authorization

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer.

Visa sponsorship is not available for this opportunity, now or in the future.

How to Apply

Please submit your application through this platform with an updated resume and relevant professional information.

Candidates should be prepared to confirm:

  • Current Tulsa-area location
  • Availability for the hybrid onsite schedule
  • Availability for an in-person interview
  • IT project-management experience
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives
  • Work authorization status
  • Desired hourly rate
  • Availability to begin and complete the contract engagement

If you are an experienced IT Project Manager who combines disciplined execution with proactive risk management, strong stakeholder leadership, and strategic judgment, we would like to hear from you.

title: Case Management Supervisor
description:
Rooted in our Christian faith, Bethany Christian Services works to ensure children are safe, loved, and connected through family. Across 29 states, we strengthen families, support foster care and adoption, and walk alongside refugees with compassion. Here, living out your faith means using your gifts to bring hope and make a lasting impact.

As a Case Management Supervisor, you’ll help carry this mission forward and make a meaningful impact every day.

Position Overview:

The Receiving Specialist assists with receiving, processing, and moving merchandise from delivery to the sales floor. The Receiving Specialist is responsible for freight handling, merchandising, maintaining an organized receiving area, and supporting efficient store operations.

Primary Responsibilities:
