title: Consultant
description:
Job Description – Consultant

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer-packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

  • Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action.
  • Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence.
  • Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities.
  • Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context.
  • Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times.
  • Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change.

What will you be doing?

You will provide data and insights consulting for a range of FMCG clients. You will help to improve efficiencies and drive growth through providing analysis, insights, and valuable recommendations. This involves discussing business challenges and providing advice based on market trends, clients’ financial capabilities and other key organisational factors.

You will manage any initiative that forms part of the ongoing service delivery as outlined in the service agreement.

Job Responsibilities

Data Mining, Analysis and Advice

  • Define business problems: Through consultations with clients extract day-to-day project briefs, reverse brief with hypothesis, and provide solutions appropriate to their business needs.
  • Deliver insight led solutions: Translate complex data into actional insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes.
  • Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy.
  • Utilise sales tools and platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g. Unify+9, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery.
  • Work closely with clients to align on key milestones, desired outcomes, resources required and timeline for delivery.

Client Management

  • Champion client success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value.
  • Own the account plan: Set engagement plan with clients, develop strategies and actions to achieve the objectives, ensure ongoing monitoring and adapt to business changes if required.
  • Build Strategic Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organizations, including decision-makers and influencers.
  • Lead the execution and communication of Account Plan initiatives: Leverage appropriate account management tools (WIP, Key Events Calendar, KPI Scorecard, etc.) to ensure activities are delivered and timelines adhered to.
  • Manage clients’ expectations: Carefully plan own and team’s workload to ensure client satisfaction.

Consultative Selling

  • Drive Client Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand client relationships by aligning Circana’s data and software solutions with their strategic goals and leveraging Circana thought leadership and subject matter experts.
  • Manage the Sales Cycle: Lead end-to-end sales processes including prospecting, needs assessment, solution development, negotiation, and closing.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Client Insights, Product, and Analytics) to deliver integrated solutions and ensure client success.
  • Develop strategies and competitive differentiation for specific solution offerings.

Commercial Acumen

  • Maintain Industry Expertise: Stay current on trends in CPG to position Circana as a thought leader and trusted advisor.
  • Achieve Revenue Targets: Meet or exceed individual and team sales goals through disciplined pipeline management and strategic account planning.
  • Generate quotes and manage the billings process: Manage the sales cycle of quotes, client sign off, raw data agency, billing instructions, forecasting update, invoice checking, PO sourcing.

People Leadership and Management

  • Consistently demonstrate Circana values and lead by example.
  • Create a collaborative, motivating and high performing team environment
  • Direct and oversee workload of direct report.
  • Manage ongoing performance and development of direct report, ensuring direct report has KPIs and development goals set.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring of direct report and other junior members of the department to support their performance, growth, and development.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or related field.

  • Previous experience working in a similar role (3+ years), within the FMCG industry.
  • Strong experience analysing scan or shopper panel data.
  • Exceptional client service consulting skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective relationships.
  • Strong communication (verbal and written) and presentation skills.
  • Excellent commercial acumen and business development skills.
  • Proven ability to influence and motivate others.
  • Ability to work under pressure, prioritise and plan effectively.

Circana Behaviours

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviours sit at the core of our organisation. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviours throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

  • Stay Curious: being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Centre on the Client: relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

Location

This position can be located in the following area(s): Sydney, Melbourne

title: Strategic Supply Chain, Industrial Base Operations
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Strategic Supply Chain, Industrial Base Operations is a key strategic and operational role responsible for architecting, implementing, and governing priority rating frameworks (e.g., DPAS) and defense supply chain resilience across the enterprise.

As the company scales rapidly to support mission-critical defense programs, safeguarding material availability and accelerating delivery timelines are paramount. In this role, you will serve as the enterprise operational authority ensuring defense priority requirements are seamlessly integrated into procurement, ERP/MRP workflows, supplier contracts, and program delivery schedules. Partnering across Supply Chain, Program Management, Contracts, Legal, Engineering, and Government Relations, you will bridge the gap between high-level defense policy and tactical shop-floor execution—mitigating supply risk and strengthening our enterprise operating posture.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Defense Priority Governance & Strategy: Serve as the enterprise operational lead for defense supply priorities, partnering closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Contracts, Program Management, Legal, and Government Relations to drive operational execution and close critical supply vulnerabilities.
  • Strategic Commodity De-Risking: Collaborate with Supply Chain teams to identify critical commodities and supply chain bottlenecks where priority ratings can mitigate material risk; proactively lead cross-functional initiatives to secure and apply these ratings across programs.
  • Single Source of Truth & Data Architecture: Build, manage, and scale a centralized data repository capturing strategic commodities, program allocations, rating statuses, active purchase orders, supplier flow-downs, identified risks, and open corrective actions.
  • Contract Flow-Down & Supplier Execution: Partner with tactical and strategic procurement teams to ensure priority ratings and mandatory flow-down requirements are accurately reflected on purchase orders and legally binding supplier commitments.
  • Enterprise Systems & Workflow Integration: Collaborate with Business Systems, IT, and Operations to embed priority rating logic and traceability into core enterprise platforms, including ERP, MRP, P2P, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), and business intelligence dashboards.
  • Executive Alignment & Reporting: Deliver high-visibility reporting and operational briefings to senior leadership, VPs, and stakeholders detailing rating coverage, process deficiencies, material exposure, and strategic decisions required.
  • Enterprise Roadmapping & Operating Posture: Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership to establish annual supply priorities, assess corporate defense industrial base posture, and design continuous-improvement roadmaps to mature the company's operating model.
  • Policy Translation & Process Scale: Translate complex defense regulations, statutory mandates, and industrial base policies into actionable business processes, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), RACI matrices, templates, and company-wide training programs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations, National Security Policy, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 5+ years of experience consulting and working alongside government agencies, defense defense technology companies, or advisory firms supporting the defense industrial base.
  • Deep functional understanding of defense priority allocation frameworks (e.g., DPAS), defense acquisition workflows, FAR/DFARS flow-down clauses, and operational supplier controls.
  • Hands-on experience deploying or managing defense priority requirements within enterprise ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, Oracle) and modern procurement tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to move seamlessly between strategic enterprise vision (30,000-foot view) and granular execution (auditing individual POs, contract clauses, and delivery schedules).
  • High ownership with proven success collaborating across multi-disciplinary stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, Engineering, and Program Management).
  • Ability to travel up to 25%-50% domestically and internationally as needed.
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Business (MBA), Public Policy, or Juris Doctorate (JD).
  • Subject matter expertise in the Defense Priorities and Allocations System (DPAS) and industrial base defense policies.
  • Strong analytical capability with a proven track record of synthesizing complex contract, supplier, and program datasets into clear, actionable executive reporting.
  • Systems-level problem solver with experience navigating ambiguity, building scalable processes from scratch, and executing effectively in fast-paced environments.
  • Demonstrated track record of standing up enterprise-wide governance, SOPs, and cross-functional compliance/enablement programs.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Security Clearance.
US Salary Range
$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Benefits

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

As a strong communicator and skilled financial analyst, this person will streamline our budgeting, payroll, and financial reporting processes. The controller will also produce thorough financial-status reports for senior managers to help improve our operational efficiency and aid in our continued growth.

This position is based at our Sacramento, California corporate headquarters and provides a flexible hybrid work schedule, with 2-3 days in office per week and availability to be in office as needed.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
Calpine, a business unit of Constellation Energy Corporation (Nasdaq: CEG), is America's largest generator of electricity from natural gas and geothermal resources with operations in competitive power markets. With 79 energy facilities in operation, Calpine’s fleet has the capacity to generate approximately 27,000 MW of electricity – enough to power approximately 27 million homes. Through wholesale power operations and its retail businesses, Calpine serves customers in 22 states and Canada. Its clean, efficient, modern and flexible fleet uses advanced technologies to generate power in a low-carbon and environmentally responsible manner.

The company was established on the premise that a strong commitment to the environment is inextricably linked to excellence in power generation and corporate responsibility. Since its founding in 1984, Calpine has led the power industry in its unwavering commitment to environmental stewardship. In addition, its renewable geothermal plants use steam generated deep below the earth's surface to produce clean, renewable electricity.

Job Summary (includes but is not limited to the following, other duties may be assigned)

Calpine Energy Solutions has partnered with Community Choice Aggregators (CCA) in California to provide communities with a choice to purchase cleaner energy at competitive rates. CCAs procure renewable sources of electricity for their customers and utilize the power lines, owned by the local utility, to distribute this renewable energy. CCA Billing Analysts are responsible for ensuring a high level of operational excellence by ensuring accurate and timely daily invoicing processes and audit requirements as well as assisting with various operational tasks. CCA Billing Analysts are key components of this rapidly growing program; making themselves an essential part of Calpine Energy Solutions expanding services.

Job Responsibilities

  • Review customer records in billing database to ensure billing parameters are set up accurately
  • Correspond and follow-up daily with local utility regarding billing inquiries and exceptions for CCA customers, provide updates to CCA clients for customer service items as needed
  • Ensure timeliness and accuracy to meet high customer service expectations
  • Review and resolve exception reports daily and weekly
  • Promptly invoice the energy component of CCA Customers to ensure charges are sent to the local utility in a timely manner

Processes and Audit Review (25%)

  • Complete daily, weekly, and monthly billing related processes
  • Log tasks and exceptions appropriately for audit review

Other Customer Service Support (15%)

  • Facilitate timely resolution of inquiries and appropriately close the issue with the CCA customer

  • Be proficient in understanding and articulating the nuances of the various CCA Programs

Business Knowledge (5%)

  • Demonstrate the ability to work independently and maintain flexibility to adapt well to change
  • Maintain effective working relationships with other organizations in the company, the Call Center, CCA Clients, and utilities
  • Gain an understanding of how the tasks at hand have a broader impact to the business

title: Water/Wastewater Senior Engineer
description:
Ardurra is seeking a Water/Wastewater Senior Engineer to join our staff in Tampa, FL.

Ardurra’s innovative water and wastewater engineers collaborate closely with clients to plan, design, permit, and construct systems that address their needs comprehensively. This approach allows our clients to make smarter investments, resulting in lower life cycle costs and additional benefits.

As a recognized leader in Florida and the Southeast's water industry, Ardurra's projects encompass treatment and infrastructure initiatives for municipal and institutional clients. Our work ranges from drinking water supply to water reuse and wastewater management. We have the capability to support projects of all sizes within a flexible and innovative team environment.

Primary Function

This position will plan, design, provide construction administration, and possibly manage aspects of multidiscipline projects consisting of water/wastewater treatment and collection/distribution systems for municipal clients throughout Florida and the Southeast region. The individual should be capable of performing the technical design on water/wastewater projects and collaborate with our team of engineers, EIT’s, CADD technicians, and subconsultants, to successfully execute these types of projects.

The position will expose the engineer to a full range of water and wastewater facility projects. Projects may include water/wastewater treatment facility green field projects, upgrade and expansion projects, process upgrades or rehabilitation projects, water distribution and storage systems, transmission pipelines, wastewater collection systems, pump stations, and other water utility related projects.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Develop detailed designs, plans, specifications, reports and cost estimates for treatment plants, pipelines, pump stations, tanks and other water/wastewater storage and conveyance systems
  • Perform or manage engineering/process design, hydraulics, pumping systems, and treatment process projects
  • Ability to coordinate with the multiple departments and sub-consultants required for multi-discipline projects
  • Ability to research and utilize available resources
  • Lead or assist a project team in completing multiple projects simultaneously
  • Effectively communicate, in English, both verbally and in writing
  • Gathers data for engineering analyses through phone contacts, written correspondence, and research sources
  • Perform calculations and research in support of designs using engineering formulas and skills in formulating possible results based on different scenarios
  • Prepare engineering reports, opinions and recommendations
  • Maintain completed project files and proper document control
  • Prepare design drawings, technical specifications, material quantity take-offs and develop construction cost estimates for projects

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering from an ABET-accredited program or equivalent
  • Professional Engineering (PE) license required
  • 7-10 years’ related work experience
  • Proven proficiency utilizing various computer software packages and automated engineering and design equipment, including system capabilities and limitations for diverse engineering assignments

Why Ardurra?

While Ardurra offers competitive compensation and rich benefits programs, it is our culture that truly sets us apart from our peers. We nurture a family-like culture, striving to create a work environment that is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding but also fun. We are acutely focused on developing our staff, whether through our internal Ardurra Academy or through our industry-leading Leadership program. We have made a deliberate and focused commitment to nurture a people-centric culture where people are: valued as individuals; supported in their professional and career development with multiple, varied career paths; provided the tools and resources to be successful, engaged, and satisfied in their work; and positive benefits, time-off programs, and flexibility to help maintain a healthy balance between work and home.

Ardurra is an Equal Opportunity/ Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or sexual orientation.

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

title: Co-op - Drug Delivery
description:

As a student scientist, you will design and conduct experiments under the guidance of our experienced Scientists. You will perform analytical and characterization techniques, for the Translational Product Development team. You will have the opportunity to work with teams comprised of scientists and non-scientists to effectively coordinate Secant Group’s research efforts. This position provides you with ample opportunities to keep abreast of innovative and novel scientific developments in the pharmaceutical industry by reading relevant literature and trialing your ideas in the lab. Primary Responsibilities • Formulate various hydrophilic and hydrophobic APIs in polymers, and analyze drug release, for long-acting implantables of various geometries • Formulate large molecule (peptide and protein) loaded long-acting dosage forms • Analyze dissolution media containing API and polymers using HPLC • Extraction of APIs from polymers for analysis on HPLC • Daily runs using HPLC • Use FTIR and Raman spectroscopy to determine API-polymer mixing and distribution • Perform thermal analyses (DSC and TGA) and rheometry to determine API-polymer interactions • Determine particle size of APIs using light scattering • With guidance, select, design, and/or execute experiments, based on interpretation of previous results and understanding of known theory • Contribute to innovative approaches to achieve project goals • Anticipate/recognize potential problems with equipment and/or supplies, and initiate action to solve or prevent problems • Perform literature review to better understand any experimental problems and how to solve them • Keep detailed records of experiments and results in the laboratory notebook • Present research to the R&D team at the end of co-op.

title: Process Engineer I
description:
Job Summary:

The Process Engineer supports the facility by improving manufacturing processes. This role partners with Production, Quality, Maintenance, and Engineering teams to resolve process, quality, safety, and efficiency issues while driving continuous improvement.

Responsibilities include supporting new model launches, evaluating materials and equipment, developing process documentation, monitoring process capability, and implementing improvements using SPC and Lean/CI methods. The Process Engineer also trains and coaches team members on SOPs, problem-solving, 5S, TPM, SMED, and standard work while ensuring processes meet customer, quality, cost, and safety requirements.

Essential Functions:

  • Participate in various training and workshops to expand engineering skill set.
  • Together with the team define problems relating to product/process systems and implement improvement programs to eliminate problems. Serves as part of the team and provides support to the team(s) as required.
  • Instigates studies and actions to overcome quality, processing, and safety problems, reduce waste, and improve team performance.
  • With team members, monitors process performance to identify areas for improvement, coordinating corrective actions.
  • Train team members in Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), problem-solving, CI techniques (Ex: 5S, TPM, SMED) and ensure regular audits for the maintenance of such procedures.
  • Full participation in the New Model Introduction process by the development of new products or processes and systems.
  • Coordinates testing of new materials before their introduction into the production facility.
  • Set up systems, measure process capability, and train team members in statistical process control (SPX) to meet internal and external customer needs.
  • Guarantee that process standards correspond to the company’s objectives, costs, and supplies to meet the needs of the customer.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, i.e. Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan, and related Work Instructions or SOP.
  • Evaluate Work cell set up, Equipment and Operating Procedure for ergonomic impacts and provide actions for ergonomic improvements.
  • Works in compliance with all safety rules and regulations.
  • May be required to assist in training.
  • Adherence to NSG/Pilkington Standard of Business Conduct and its Values and Principles.
  • All other duties as assigned by Manager.

Top 3 Competencies Needed for Success in the Role:

  • Decision Making – takes appropriate actions to minimize risks and maximize the opportunities in the decision-making process. Promotes the review and learning from business decisions.
  • Strategic Thinking – develops strategic plans for their part of the business by setting short and long-term goals and objectives.
  • Empowers and Develops – promotes a learning culture through coaching, stretch opportunities, sharing expertise and providing honest and helpful feedback.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Engineering (mechanical, electrical, etc.) or other technically related fields plus two (2) years relevant experience or Associates degree with a minimum of four (4) years relevant experience.
  • Aptitude to achieve proficiency in all aspects of processing technology.
  • Must be able to coach and instruct operators and process technicians
  • Knowledge of and ability to use customer and supplier prints, SPC, pressure gauges, and monitoring devices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrate leadership ability and the ability to work within a team.
  • Must be proficient in the use of business software such as Excel, Word, and MS-Outlook.
  • Must have demonstrated ability to apply inferential and deductive reasoning.

Preferred Experience

  • Two years automotive manufacturing experience
  • Automation Training/Experience (ABB Robots, Cognex Vision systems)
  • Six-Sigma Certification (Greenbelt or Blackbelt)
  • Training and experience in disciplined problem solving techniques (Ex: 5-Why, 0-D, DMEAC)
  • CAD/Solidworks

title: Lead Quality Systems Engineer - Maritime
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maritime Division operates across multiple sites and business lines, producing advanced undersea systems for national defense. As the division scales from a single-product facility to a multi-site, multi-business-line operation, maintaining a unified and audit-ready quality management system is critical. This role sits within the Corporate Quality organization but is fully dedicated to the Maritime Division, serving as the connective tissue that keeps quality systems aligned across every site, product line, and certification boundary.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Lead Quality Systems Engineer, Maritime to join our team and own the end-to-end AS9100 quality management system across the Maritime Division. In the near term, you will support ongoing AS9100 certification and surveillance activities. Looking ahead, your primary mission is solving a much harder problem: as new product lines and manufacturing sites come online, the AS9100 certification scope expands to cover multiple sites, multiple product lines, and multiple business lines operating under shared facilities. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining a QMS architecture that keeps all of these threads audit-ready, ensuring that growth in one area does not create certification risk in another. This role requires deep expertise in AS9100 and aerospace quality systems, experience managing multi-site certification scopes, and the ability to work across organizational boundaries. If you are someone who can see the big picture of a quality system while managing the granular documentation and process discipline required to pass rigorous third-party audits, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • AS9100 Certification Ownership: Own the Maritime Division's AS9100 QMS, including all documentation, internal audit programs, corrective action tracking, and management review processes. Ensure the system remains audit-ready at all times across all sites.
  • Multi-Site QMS Architecture: Design and implement a quality management system structure that accommodates multiple manufacturing sites operating under a single or coordinated AS9100 certification scope. Address the complexity that arises when product lines span multiple facilities and when multiple business lines share a single site.
  • Audit Preparation and Liaison: Serve as the primary point of contact for third-party certification body audits, customer audits, and regulatory reviews. Manage audit schedules, coordinate site readiness, and ensure findings are closed on time. Guide the organization through the evolution from a single-site audit scope to a multi-site, multi-product scope.
  • Cross-Site Process Harmonization: Establish standardized quality processes, procedures, and documentation practices that work across all division manufacturing sites. Ensure that shared processes meet AS9100 requirements regardless of which site or business line is being audited, while allowing for site-specific procedures where necessary.
  • Risk and Gap Analysis: Continuously assess QMS gaps and certification risks as new product lines and sites are brought online. Proactively identify where the expansion of audit scope creates exposure and develop mitigation plans before issues surface in formal audits.
  • Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA): Own the division-wide CAPA process. Track nonconformances, drive root cause analysis, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and verified across all sites. Monitor trends to identify systemic issues before they become repeat audit findings.
  • Training and Culture: Build quality awareness across the Maritime Division. Develop and deliver training programs that ensure personnel at all sites understand AS9100 requirements, their role in maintaining certification, and the implications of nonconformance in a multi-site environment.
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Work across Corporate Quality, site leadership, production teams, and business line leads to ensure QMS requirements are integrated into operational planning. Participate in site battle rhythm meetings and provide regular quality status updates to division leadership.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in quality management within aerospace, defense, or government-contract manufacturing
  • Direct experience managing or significantly contributing to AS9100 certification and surveillance audits
  • Demonstrated experience with multi-site or multi-scope quality management systems
  • Strong knowledge of CAPA processes, internal auditing, and management review requirements under AS9100
  • Effective communicator who can work across organizational boundaries and present to leadership
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • AS9100 Lead Auditor certification (e.g., through Exemplar Global, RABQSA, or equivalent)
  • Experience in a scaling or startup manufacturing environment where QMS processes were being built or significantly expanded
  • Familiarity with other aerospace/defense quality standards (e.g., AS13100, NADCAP, ISO 9001, ITAR/EAR compliance as it relates to quality documentation)
  • Experience managing AS9100 scope expansions, including adding new sites or product lines to an existing certificate
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field
  • Experience with ERP/MES systems and their integration with quality management processes
  • Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certification or experience
US Salary Range
$129,000—$171,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit .

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

Qualification Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Level III Technician requires six years of field experience servicing generator systems with extensive experience on 500KW+, proficient

title: Senior Systems Engineer II
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SYSTEMS ENGINEER II

We are currently seeking a Senior Systems Engineer II for our systems engineering team based out of Long Beach, CA. This team supports our Space Systems division, and lead cutting-edge programs for civil, commercial, and defense customers. Systems engineers are responsible for the development and maintenance of technical budgets, requirements definition, test planning and execution, and overall management of the systems engineering process. They also work hands-on with flight hardware, and drive the technical development of our Space Systems missions.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Develop and maintain:
    • Technical budgets for vehicle performance
    • System requirements and verification techniques
    • Simulations and analysis across vehicle functions
    • Test methods and data analysis
  • Lead and own technical development of spacecraft missions
  • Assist with program and product management
  • Develop, in collaboration with team members, interface specifications, CONOPS definition, and other design documents

QUALIFICATIONS YOU’LL BRING AS SENIOR SYSTEMS ENGINEER II:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (software, computer, electrical, aerospace, mechanical, or other technical engineering discipline)
  • 8+ years of engineering experience in the aerospace industry

Base Salary

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. title: Clinical Engineering Cyber Specialist
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Job Function: Engineering

Industry: Hospital & Healthcare

Experience Level: Mid-Senior Level (3+ Years)

Education Level: Bachelor's Degree

Total Positions: 1

Relocation Assistance: No

Visa Sponsorship Eligibility: No

Role Overview

We are seeking a Clinical Engineering Cyber Specialist to oversee and execute critical technical components of the healthcare cybersecurity program at a major healthcare facility in Far Rockaway, NY.

In this role, you will lead the implementation of medical device cybersecurity strategies and controls, perform comprehensive risk assessments, and collaborate closely with hospital IT and InfoSec teams to ensure the security, integrity, and availability of connected medical equipment. The ideal candidate brings strong technical leadership, a proactive approach to threat mitigation, and a deep understanding of healthcare regulatory compliance.

Essential Responsibilities

Technical Support & Threat Mitigation (80%)

  • Lead the collection and maintenance of Critical Cybersecurity Data Elements (CDEs) and manufacturer documentation in the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
  • Conduct thorough risk assessments of medical assets based on collected CDEs and vendor technical documentation.
  • Oversee out-of-the-box configuration and baseline hardening of medical devices to align with established cybersecurity standards and manufacturer guidelines.
  • Manage planned and unplanned vulnerability remediation efforts, including routine software patching, hardware upgrades, and rapid responses to zero-day threats.
  • Coordinate technical cybersecurity activities, remediation workflows, and vendor patch validations with medical device manufacturers.
  • Lead the testing and validation of network segmentation rules in direct coordination with hospital IT network teams.
  • Support cross-functional IT projects involving connected medical devices operating on the hospital network.

Program Support & Incident Handling (10%)

  • Investigate cybersecurity alerts and anomalous activity across connected medical devices within the hospital and affiliated clinics.
  • Analyze high and critical vulnerabilities to develop actionable incident response recommendations.
  • Track and report on vulnerability remediation progress, identifying ongoing opportunities to strengthen HTM and IT cybersecurity practices.
  • Maintain quality control and integrity for all cybersecurity data and inventory records within the CMMS.

Training & Mentorship (5%)

  • Support Healthcare Technology Management (HTM) cybersecurity education and awareness initiatives across operational teams.
  • Coach Biomedical Equipment Technicians (BMETs) on fundamental cybersecurity hygiene, standard controls, and risk mitigation.
  • Represent the organization in industry cybersecurity workgroups, forums, and knowledge-sharing panels.
  • Complete all assigned mandatory technical and non-technical training requirements.

Regulatory & Compliance (5%)

  • Advise on hospital audits involving medical device cybersecurity, including HIPAA, Joint Commission, and relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Provide technical guidance for enterprise cybersecurity audits in alignment with organizational leadership priorities.

Qualifications & Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Clinical Engineering, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of functional experience in medical device cybersecurity, Healthcare Technology Management (HTM), or a related clinical network infrastructure environment.
  • Licensure: Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of medical device architecture, clinical workflows, and network protocols.
  • Technical knowledge of CMMS platforms and vulnerability management toolsets.
  • Practical familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001) and regulatory/compliance standards (FDA guidance, Joint Commission, HIPAA).
  • Proven track record leading technical projects and driving cross-functional alignment across IT, InfoSec, and clinical staff.
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISSP, HCISPP, CEH, or CompTIA Security+) are strongly preferred.

Benefits & What We Offer

We offer a competitive and equitable compensation structure, with salary offers determined based on a candidate's specific skills, education, and relevant experience.

Full-time employees gain access to a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Care Insurance
  • Wellness Programs and Employee Support Resources
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Matching Contributions
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Company Holidays
  • Continuous Career Growth Opportunities and Tuition Reimbursement

title: Senior Campaign Communications Specialist-Worker Power

description:
SEIU (Service Employees International Union)

JOB TITLE: Senior Campaign Communications Specialist - Worker Power

GRADE: PS-3

LOCATION: All USA or Washington, DC HQ

Include SEIU staff and other experts on campaign communications issues.

This position reports to a Communications Program Manager, and the incumbent works independently.

Work is generally performed in an office setting, but may be required to work in other settings conducive to performing the work required to complete the assignment, such as field assignments. Long and extended hours and travel required.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS: SEIU offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package that reflects our values as a labor organization and our commitment to the well-being and long-term security of our staff. Benefits include:

  • A comprehensive, employer-sponsored health benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A defined benefit pension plan

SEIU believes that workers deserve dignity, stability, and the ability to plan for their futures, and our benefits are designed to support that belief.

Writing test and writing samples required.

Working under the direction and guidance of the Division Head, the Administrator has authority over the business affairs, funds, and resources of the division. This position is responsible for aligning the division activities with the policies and procedures of the department, School of Medicine, and the University of Colorado. The Administrator represents the division within the department and the School of Medicine, and the University of Colorado, providing essential communication, and networking for the effective functioning of these entities.

Key Responsibilities\:

  • Participates and serves as the staff representative on the division’s Leadership Team and is responsible for collaborating and building solutions to operational and financial matters as well as advocating for staff and related staff resources.

  • In conjunction with the Division Head, this position is responsible for knowing, understanding, and advocating for top division-related priorities to the Department of Medicine, UCH partners, and the SOM Dean’s Office.

  • For the division leadership team, the division staff, and division administrators in the DOM, this position actively works to drive performance through engagement, commitment, collaboration, and teamwork.

  • Fiscal responsibility and management of all funds of the Division of Infectious Diseases including state, federal, auxiliary, gift, endowment funds, grant and contract funds, and CU MEDICINE/clinical funds. Also manages the financial aspects of operations and staffing, faculty recruitment, and other short- and long-term planning functions.

  • Provides oversite of budget preparation, controls, and regularly monitors revenue and expenditure activity for each source of funds.

  • Administers policies, rules and regulations from federal, state, University, CU MEDICINE and other sources. Administers and coordinates regulations and standards related to business management, clinical, research and educational administration.

  • Coordinates personnel matters for the division, including position establishment, recruitment, affirmative action, hiring and supervision of staff, performance planning and appraisal, and termination processes.

  • Participates in planning activities for the division, including long and short-range planning and community practice expansion. Works with the Division Head and other faculty members as needed or requested to analyze and report existing and/or new programs and ventures to interested parties.

Work Location\:

Hybrid – this role is eligible for a hybrid schedule of 3-4 days per week on campus and as needed for in-person meetings.

Why Join Us\:

Our faculty, more than 70 and growing, take care of patients with infectious diseases in the mountain west and across the world, do scientific research on major infectious disease (ID) health problems, and educate the next generation of physicians and scientists in our field.

Why work for the University?

We have AMAZING benefits and offer exceptional amounts of holiday, vacation, and sick leave! The University of Colorado offers an excellent benefits package including\:

  • Medical\: Multiple plan options

  • Dental\: Multiple plan options

  • Additional Insurance\: Disability, Life, Vision

  • Retirement 401(a) Plan\: Employer contributes 10% of your gross pay

  • Paid Time Off\: Accruals over the year

  • Vacation Days\: 22/year (maximum accrual 352 hours)

  • Sick Days\: 15/year (unlimited maximum accrual)

  • Holiday Days\: 15/year

  • Tuition Benefit\: Employees have access to this benefit on all CU campuses

  • ECO Pass\: Reduced rate RTD Bus and light rail service

There are many additional perks & programs with the CU Advantage.

Qualifications\:

Minimum Qualifications\:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, business administration, finance, accounting, education, social sciences, healthcare administration, public administration, communications, information systems, or a directly related field from an accredited institution.

    • A combination of education and related technical/military/paraprofessional experience may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree on a year for year basis.

  • Six (6) years of relevant professional experience in financial administration/management.

Applicants must meet minimum qualifications at the time of hire.

Preferred Qualifications\:

  • Master’s degree from an accredited college or university with a major in accounting/business/health care management, finance or closely related field.

  • Prior experience managing three (3) or more staff members.

  • Prior experience in a leadership role and can demonstrate excellence in accelerating employee performance

  • Five (5) years of responsible administrative, financial, and supervisory experience in a university or healthcare setting.

  • Prior experience with the University’s PeopleSoft finance and human resources management system.

  • Prior experience in managing clinical and/or grant revenue.

Conditions of Employment\:

  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship. We are unable to provide work visa sponsorship or employment authorization for this position now or in the future.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities\:

  • Ability to communicate effectively, both in writing and orally.

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees at all levels throughout the institution.

  • Outstanding customer service skills.

  • Strong financial management skills to include comprehensive understanding of academic medical institution financial structure and operational standards.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage funds effectively, from a variety of sources and with the use of a variety of financial management software applications.

  • Demonstrated ability to prepare and present analytical assessments and reports, and to communicate professionally and effectively.

  • Demonstrated excellence in establishing work priorities and providing follow-through and meeting established deadlines.

  • Demonstrated ability to successfully plan, organize, implement and coordinate financial and administrative activities in a diverse and complicated system.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage and supervise staff and assign or reorganize tasks to meet the Division’s overall strategic goals.

How to Apply\:

For full consideration, please submit the following document(s)\:

  1. A letter of interest describing relevant job experiences as they relate to listed job qualifications and interest in the position.

  2. Curriculum vitae / Resume

  3. Three to five professional references, including name, address, phone number (mobile number if appropriate), and email address.

Questions should be directed to\: Tate Hermanson, tate.hermanson@cuanschutz.edu

Screening of Applications Begins\:

Applications will be accepted until finalists are identified, but preference will be given to complete applications received by September 30th, 2026. Those who do not apply by this date may or may not be considered.

Anticipated Pay Range\:

The starting salary range (or hiring range) for this position has been established as $89,208 – $119,539.

The above salary range (or hiring range) represents the University’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. This position may be eligible for overtime compensation, depending on the level.

description:

title: HR Administrator
description:

Works in a typical administrative setting with climate control and appropriate lighting. Travel to branches requires exposure to outdoor and traffic conditions.

Variety of office equipment (telephone, printer, PC, mobile devices, etc.).

Our Commitment

title: Quality Technician- Graveyard
description:
Job description

Pexco has an opening for a QA Technician. This is an opportunity for you to be part of a passionate team, to learn and teach as you progress in your career.

Pexco is looking for a QA Technician for our manufacturing plant located in Fife, WA.

The Quality Department has processes in place to ensure things run smoothly, and everyone is working towards the same goal, which is to produce quality products our customers are proud of.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Maintains compliance with Company and plant safety policies and procedures.
  • Completes all annual training as required.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) during the entire shift, to include safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves, and safety footwear, etc.
  • Assist quality lead or designee with the dimensional measurement of extruded tubing and various tubing assemblies.
  • Visual inspection of extruded tubing and various tubing assemblies
  • Perform calibrations.
  • Initiation of proposed specifications and /or revision of existing specifications
  • Packaging and shipping product
  • Incoming/receiving inspection duties.
  • Production lot release activities
  • In process inspection activities
  • Maintain accurate, legible, and detailed records of activities.
  • Accurately use calipers, protractors, and other measuring devices to inspect parts.
  • Other duties as assigned by the management team.

Qualifications:

  • High School graduate or equivalent preferred
  • Experience in production environment preferred but not necessary, preferably with the Quality department.
  • Above average communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Able to perform basic mathematical computations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division)

Physical Demands:

  • Moving and lifting objects up to 30 lbs.
  • Walking, standing and otherwise perform job functions on concrete floors.
  • Occasional repetitive movements

Work Environment:

  • Works in a warehouse and manufacturing environment. Climate may be cold or hot depending on outside temperature.
  • Exposed to dust, odors, fumes, and noise associated with the extrusion and fabrication manufacturing processes.

Schedule:

  • 11pm-7am
  • Sunday to Thursday
  • Training first 2 weeks on days 7am-3pm.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Pexco (Parent Company) – www.pexco.com

Pexco is a leading component supplier across a variety of industrial end markets and applications with production facilities in the US, Mexico, and Canada. The Company is primarily engaged in designing and manufacturing not only extruded plastic (commodity to high-performance) tubes and profiles through an expansive twelve-site footprint but also specializes in the injection molding of high-performance polymer parts. In addition, Pexco offers a wide range of differentiated, value-added services, including design, prototyping, die building, sub-assembly, fabrication and supply chain management. Moreover, Pexco has developed deep expertise in processing PTFE rod, tube, sheet, tape, and pipe, as well as in rubber extrusion serving the RV and other industries.

Pexco’s innovative products are utilized in fluid handling, electrical insulation, traffic safety, infrastructure, and lighting applications across aerospace & defense, medical, electronics & semiconductors, mobility, environmental testing, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, and other high-growth end-markets. The Company sells directly to more than 2,000 customers, including OEMs and end-users, as well as through distribution in certain markets.

Pexco has built an industry-leading reputation through its focus on short-run products with rapid turnarounds, tight tolerances, material science expertise, and a high degree of operational complexity. The company has a proven track record of growing its core segments and entering attractive new verticals over time to gain an increased share of a $10 billion total addressable market.

Pexco’s strategy is to consistently deliver compelling customer value within both our core and strategic market segments. Continuous improvement and ease of doing business (internal and external), remain a consistent operating theme for Pexco.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

Pexco is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Pay: $25per hour

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible spending account
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Experience:

  • Calipers: 1 year (Required)
  • Manufacturing: 1 year (Required)
  • Quality: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior ProServe Cloud Architect – Travel & Hospitality, AWS Professional Services - Benelux
company: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL, Dutch Branch
description:
AWS is seeking an exceptional Senior ProServe Cloud Architect to join our team supporting one of EMEA's most strategic partnerships in the travel and hospitality sector. In this role, you'll work directly with a leading global travel platform to architect and deliver transformative cloud solutions that redefine customer experience at scale.

As the technical bridge between ProServe Account Executives and Shared Delivery Teams, you'll translate complex business challenges into innovative, scalable AWS solutions. You'll own the technical narrative—from initial discovery through solution design and delivery—ensuring every engagement drives measurable business impact for one of the world's most influential travel technology companies.

What excites you:

1. Architecting at scale: Design solutions that handle millions of customer interactions across global markets, leveraging AWS services including Amazon Connect, AI/ML, and real-time data processing
2. Innovation with impact: Shape the future of travel technology by implementing omnichannel customer service platforms, personalization engines, and intelligent automation
3. Strategic influence: Partner directly with customer engineering and product leaders to drive cloud adoption and modernization initiatives
4. Technical breadth: Work across the full AWS stack—from serverless architectures and containerization to data analytics and AI-powered customer insights
5. Thought leadership: Coach customer teams on cloud best practices, DevOps automation, and operational excellence while building lasting technical relationships

This is a customer-facing role requiring travel to client locations across EMEA to deliver hands-on professional services and strategic guidance.

Key job responsibilities
Solution Design & Architecture: Create and lead complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions that deliver measurable Customer Business Outcomes (CBOs). Operate as the technical conduit between ProServe Account Executives and Shared Delivery Teams, ensuring proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and optimized for customer success.

Pre-Sales Technical Leadership: Provide technical expertise, best practices, and solution demonstrations during the pre-sales motion. Lead initial scoping, design, and engagement planning to accelerate deal closure and drive customer lifetime value.

Trusted Customer Advisory: Act as a strategic advisor to customer engineering and product leaders on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions to address their most complex business challenges. Define cloud operating models and drive enterprise transformation initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Account Managers, Shared Delivery Teams, and AWS service teams to ensure seamless solution hand-off and successful implementation. Influence revenue through bookings, solution alignment, and delivery excellence.

Knowledge Leadership: Mentor and train team members, create reusable artifacts, and drive process improvements across the organization. Share technical expertise through internal and external thought leadership.

Business Value Translation: Translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including C-level executives.


A day in the life
Your day will center on direct engagement with a leading global travel platform's engineering and product leaders, translating their business challenges into scalable AWS solutions. You'll lead technical pre-sales activities—designing architectures, scoping engagements, and presenting solutions to both technical teams and executives. You'll solve complex problems like architecting omnichannel customer service platforms handling millions of global interactions, designing real-time analytics solutions, modernizing legacy applications, and implementing AI/ML-powered personalization—all while defining cloud operating models that enable organizational transformation.

About the team
The Professional Services team at AWS is responsible for assisting enterprise customers as they shift to the cloud by incorporating our services into their overall architecture. We work hand-in-hand with customer teams and AWS partners to provide deep expertise in the architecture, design, development, and implementation of cloud computing initiatives that result in real business outcomes. As part of our team, you’ll accelerate the adoption of our products all while advocating for the success of our customers.

title: Van Data Analist naar Data Engineer
description:
Je bent data analist en wil meer bouwen aan de achterkant: stabiele datapipelines, slimme modellen en betrouwbare platforms. In ons 1,5-jarig programma groei je stap voor stap naar de rol van volwaardig Data Engineer. Je werkt projectmatig bij een opdrachtgever, met ruimte om jouw route te kiezen. Blijf jezelf voor: we helpen je vooruit, op jouw manier. Na 1,5 jaar kun je na jouw opleiding in dienst treden bij de opdrachtgever!

Dit ga je doen

  • Je volgt een leerroute richting Data Engineer en past die direct toe in je opdracht.
  • Je ontwerpt en bouwt datapipelines (batch en/of realtime) en zet ETL-processen op, dit zodat je geen frustratie meer ervaart omdat je zelf bepaalt hoe duurzaam en robuust het gebouwd wordt. Dit doe je samen met collega's.
  • Je werkt mee aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van een dataplatform binnen een Microsoft Azure omgeving, waarbij je data uit verschillende bronnen samenbrengt en ontsluit. Dit doe je middels de Medaillion architectuur.
  • Je modelleert data en levert datasets op die klaar zijn voor rapportages en analyses.
  • Je borgt kwaliteit met testen, monitoring en heldere documentatie, bijvoorbeeld via Microsoft Purview.
  • Je stemt af met stakeholders; de inhoud verschilt per opdrachtgever en project

Je bent fit for the job als je...

  • je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring hebt als data analist, data scientist of BI developer.
  • je een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt behaald in Informatica, Data Science, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde, (Toegepaste) Wiskunde, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar.
  • je een stevige basis hebt in Power BI en Python en/of SQL
  • je ervaring hebt opgedaan met data modelleren binnen een cloud (Microsoft Azure) omgeving is een pré.
  • je enige ervaring hebt met Azure Datafactory, Databricks/Spark, dbt, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Tests & Monitoring en/of Git workflows of soortgelijke tools zijn een sterke pré.
  • Je jezelf committeert aan een ontwikkeltraject van 1,5 jaar en beschikbaar bent voor 36-40 uur per week.

Dit krijg je van ons

We bieden een salaris tussen de 3.800 en 6.000 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week passend bij je ervaring en expertise.

Vanuit jouw rol als data analist groei je op opdracht naar een data engineer. Wij zorgen voor passende opdrachten die deze ontwikkeling stap voor stap mogelijk maken. Het ontwikkelprogramma ondersteunt je hierin en versnelt jouw groei naar een volwaardig data engineer. Je volgt praktische trainingen waarin je erkende certificeringen behaalt richting de Azure stack, krijgt coaching van je performance manager en maakt deel uit van een groep die dezelfde ontwikkeling doormaakt. Juist door samen te leren en ervaringen te delen, versnellen jullie elkaars groei.

Ontdek of deze vacature goed bij u past door alle informatie hieronder te lezen.

Klik hier voor onze onepager met alle belangrijke informatie die je nodig hebt voordat je besluit te solliciteren op dit programma!

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist

Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis. Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van start up tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen team Technology werken we in twee focusgebieden: Data & Analytics en IT. Jij maakt onderdeel uit van Team Data & Analytics, samen met zo'n 35 professionals binnen een unit van 100 specialisten. Onze cultuur is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Het mooie van Technology? We werken niet sectorgebonden. IT en data raken elke sector, daardoor vind je bij ons altijd een project waar jouw kennis, ideeën en energie perfect tot hun recht komen.

Op vrijdag werken we samen in ons clubhuis in Arnhem. Deze dag staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega's en het versterken van de verbinding met Team EIFFEL. Verwacht een opdrachtgever je die dag op locatie? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

EIFFEL is onderdeel van Team EIFFEL: een community van 3.000+ experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en actief bij 600+ opdrachtgevers. Groot in schaal, maar persoonlijk in aanpak. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die zichzelf wil blijven ontwikkelen en voor wil blijven.

#LI-GH1

Deze skills komen van pas

  • SQL
  • RESTful API development
  • Kennis van programma's en portfolio's
  • Kennis van BI-tools
  • ETL processen

Je werkt gestructureerd, denkt in oplossingen en vindt het leuk om dingen te automatiseren. xtzxhlp Nieuwsgierigheid en eigenaarschap helpen je om snel meters te maken als Data Engineer.

title: Quality Inspector
description:
Job Summary

The Quality Inspector is responsible for inspecting plastic injection molded components, and precision machined parts at various stages of production, including receiving, in-process, first article, and final, to ensure compliance with customer specifications, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. This role operates under AS9100D and AS9102 guidelines, using precision measurement tools and collaborating closely with production, engineering, and quality teams to maintain the highest quality standards.

Job Location Yorba Linda, CA Mon-Fri 6:30am-3:00pm $20-$25 DOE

Key Responsibilities:

1. Inspection & Compliance

  • Perform receiving inspections on raw materials, components, and vendor supplied parts, verifying certifications, dimensions, and compliance with purchase orders
  • Conduct in-process, first article, and final inspections for molded and machined parts using precision tools
  • Interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and GD&T requirements to ensure compliance
  • Perform First Article Inspections (FAI) in accordance with AS9102 requirements
  • Maintain lot traceability and review material certification for aerospace compliance

2. Documentation & Reporting

  • Accurately document inspection results and maintain organized quality records
  • Generate Nonconformance Reports (NCRs) when required
  • Comply with AS9100 document control processes

3. Collaboration & Problem-Solving

  • Support root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions with cross-functional teams
  • Collaborating with production, engineering, and quality departments to resolve quality issues

4. Tools & Equipment

  • Utilize calipers, micrometers, height gauges, bore gauges, thread gauges, optical comparators, CMMs, and other precision tools

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Minimum 2 years of quality inspection experience in manufacturing; aerospace, plastics injection molding, or machining preferred
  • Strong understanding of AS9100D and As9102 standards
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD&T
  • Proficient with precision measuring equipment and Microsoft Office
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and documentation

Preferred:

  • Experience with CMM programming/operations
  • Knowledge of aerospace material specifications and special processes
  • Training in root cause analysis and continuous improvement

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit, stand and walk for extended periods
  • Lift up to 25lbs occasionally
  • Visual acuity to detect fine details during inspections

Personal Attributes

  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving skills
  • Team-oriented with good communication abilities
  • Commitment to quality and continuous improvement

Company Overview

Precise Aerospace Manufacturing - precisemfg.com

Precise Aerospace Manufacturing Inc. (PAM), established in 1965, is a premier full-service supplier specializing in close-tolerance custom molding and machining for the aerospace, defense, medical, and electronic industries. With over five decades of experience, PAM offers expertise in injecting, compression, and transfer molded plastics, as well as CNC machining and value-added assembly.

The company maintains AS9100 and ISO 9001 certification, ensuring adherence to stringent quality standards. PAM is also approved by major OEMs and has been privileged to manufacture parts for the NASA Space Shuttle Program

Located in Yorba, Linda, California, Precise Aerospace Manufacturing is committed to delivering high-quality, precision-engineered solutions to meet the demanding requirements of its diverse clientele.

Pexco is a leading component supplier across a variety of industrial end markets and applications with production facilities in the US, Mexico, and Canada. The Company is primarily engaged in designing and manufacturing not only extruded plastic (commodity to high-performance) tubes and profiles through an expansive twelve-site footprint but also specializes in the injection molding of high-performance polymer parts. In addition, Pexco offers a wide range of differentiated, value-added services, including design, prototyping, die building, sub-assembly, fabrication and supply chain management. Moreover, Pexco has developed deep expertise in processing PTFE rod, tube, sheet, tape, and pipe, as well as in rubber extrusion serving the RV and other industries.

Pexco’s innovative products are utilized in fluid handling, electrical insulation, traffic safety, infrastructure, and lighting applications across aerospace & defense, medical, electronics & semiconductors, mobility, environmental testing, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, and other high-growth end-markets. The Company sells directly to more than 2,000 customers, including OEMs and end-users, as well as through distribution in certain markets.

Pexco has built an industry-leading reputation through its focus on short-run products with rapid turnarounds, tight tolerances, material science expertise, and a high degree of operational complexity. The company has a proven track record of growing its core segments and entering attractive new verticals over time to gain an increased share of a $10 billion total addressable market.

Pexco’s strategy is to consistently deliver compelling customer value within both our core and strategic market segments. Continuous improvement and ease of doing business (internal and external), remain a consistent operating theme for Pexco.

Equal Opportunity Employment

Pexco is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all employees. It is the company's policy to seek and employ the best qualified personnel in all positions to provide equal opportunity for advancement to all employees, including upgrading, promotion and training, and to administer these activities in a manner which will not discriminate against or give preference to any person because of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, handicap, ancestry, sexual orientation, marital status, arrest or conviction record, or any other discriminatory basis prohibited by state or federal law.
