title: Professional Per Diem
description:
Overview

The Per Diem MAP Trainer provides Medication Administration Program (MAP) training coverage on an as-needed basis across Vinfen Training Center locations in Lawrence, Allston, Weymouth, and Hyannis. This role delivers MAP certification, recertification, and other approved MAP training in accordance with Massachusetts Department of Developmental Services (DDS) and Department of Public Health (DPH) requirements and Vinfen standards. This is a per diem, non-supervisory position designed to provide additional instructional coverage based on training schedules, instructor availability, and organizational needs. Hours and training locations will vary.

The position is based in Allston, with occasional coverage required at Vinfen Training Center locations in Lawrence, Weymouth, and Hyannis, based on training and staffing needs.

Responsibilities

Training & Facilitation
  • Facilitate MAP certification, recertification, and other approved MAP training sessions in accordance with state and Vinfen requirements.
  • Deliver clear, learner-centered instruction using approved MAP curriculum, materials, and instructional practices.
  • Support learners with practice, questions, and preparation required as part of the scheduled training.
  • Maintain a professional, supportive, and effective learning environment.
Training Coverage
  • Provide training coverage at Vinfen Training Center locations in Lawrence, Allston, Weymouth, and Hyannis, based on organizational need.
  • Maintain flexibility to support scheduled classes, instructor absences, additional training capacity, and other identified coverage needs.
  • Coordinate with the MAP Training Program team regarding assigned classes, locations, materials, and other training needs.
Documentation
  • Complete required attendance records, training documentation, test scores, certification forms, and other required records.
  • Ensure all documentation is accurate and submitted within required timeframes.
  • Communicate learner concerns, training issues, or follow-up needs to the MAP Training Program leadership team.
Other
  • Follow all DDS, DPH, MAP, and Vinfen training requirements.
  • Perform related training duties as assigned.
Knowledge and Skills
  • Knowledge of Massachusetts DDS and DPH MAP requirements and medication safety practices.
  • Ability to effectively facilitate adult learners.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain instructional professionalism and confidentiality.
  • Ability to work independently while following established curriculum, procedures, and training expectations.
  • Flexibility to provide training at multiple Vinfen locations.

About Vinfen

Established in 1977, Vinfen is a nonprofit, health and human services organization and a leading provider of community-based services to individuals with mental health conditions, intellectual and developmental disabilities, brain injuries, and behavioral health challenges. Our services and advocacy promote the recovery, resiliency, habilitation, and self-determination of the people we serve. Vinfen's 3,500 dedicated employees are experienced, highly-trained professionals who provide a full range of supportive living, health, educational, and clinical services in over 550 sites throughout Massachusetts and Connecticut. For more information about Vinfen, please visit www.vinfen.org/careers.

My Job. My Community. My Vinfen.

Vinfen is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Qualifications

Typical Requirements

  • Certified MAP Trainer or ability to obtain MAP Trainer certification within 60 days of hire.
  • Experience delivering MAP or clinical training preferred.
  • Experience in human services, healthcare, residential services, or a related environment preferred.
  • Ability to travel to Vinfen Training Center locations in Lawrence, Allston, Weymouth, and Hyannis as assigned.
Scheduling ExpectationsThis is a per diem position with no guaranteed number of hours. Work will be offered based on training schedules and coverage needs. The employee must have the flexibility to provide coverage at multiple Vinfen Training Center locations.

title: Information Security Engineer
description:
At Affinity Plus every employee understands how their work affects our members experience and we strive to provide an experience that can't be found anywhere else. Great service starts with great employees and that is why we focus on providing not only the best place our members will ever bank but the best place our employees will ever work. Between our one of a kind culture, incredible benefits, and work/life balance; we believe you will feel the Affinity Plus difference.

Position Summary
The Information Security Engineer plays a key role in protecting Affinity Plus Federal Credit Union from cybersecurity threats by designing, implementing, managing, and continuously improving the technologies and controls that support the Information Security Program. This position is responsible for maintaining and enhancing security infrastructure, supporting threat detection and response capabilities, conducting security assessments, and collaborating with internal teams and external partners to strengthen the organization’s security posture. The role serves as a technical subject matter expert and helps ensure security systems, processes, and defenses are effective against current and emerging threats while supporting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of corporate data and resources.

Duties & Responsibilities
Security Engineering & Infrastructure Management
• Serve as a key resource in the evaluation, selection, implementation, configuration, and ongoing management of information security tools, technologies, and platforms.
• Maintain, support, and optimize the security infrastructure and technologies utilized by the Information Security Program.
• Collaborate with technology teams to ensure security solutions are effectively integrated, configured, and maintained across the enterprise.
• Evaluate existing security controls and recommend enhancements to improve operational effectiveness, efficiency, and security posture.
• Lead the implementation and lifecycle management of security technologies, ensuring solutions remain current, supported, and aligned with organizational needs.

Threat Management, Detection & Response
• Collaborate with Information Security team members to develop, maintain, and continuously enhance Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) capabilities and detection strategies.
• Coordinate with threat intelligence sharing organizations and security partners to facilitate the collection, analysis, and sharing of relevant threat intelligence.
• Conduct threat intelligence, threat hunting, and reconnaissance activities to identify emerging threats, assess risks, and improve organizational preparedness and response capabilities.
• Monitor and evaluate threat intelligence information to identify potential impacts to the organization and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
• Act as a technical resource during the investigation, analysis, and response to security events and incidents.
• Develop and maintain detection use cases, correlation rules, alerts, and dashboards to improve visibility into potential security threats and suspicious activity.

Vulnerability Management & Security Assessments
• Ensure internal and external vulnerability assessments, attack surface reviews, scans, and security testing activities are conducted regularly.
• Analyze assessment results and collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize remediation efforts and reduce organizational risk.
• Partner with third-party security providers and internal teams to support penetration tests, security assessments, tabletop exercises, audits, and related testing activities.
• Validate remediation efforts and verify identified vulnerabilities have been appropriately addressed.

Security Strategy, Governance & Continuous Improvement
• Assist in the development, implementation, maintenance, and communication of enterprise-wide information security strategies, standards, procedures, and policies.
• Provide technical expertise and recommendations to support strategic security initiatives and program enhancements.
• Research emerging technologies, security trends, vulnerabilities, and threat landscapes to support the continuous improvement of the Information Security Program.
• Collaborate with Information Technology, business stakeholders, and security partners to strengthen organizational cybersecurity capabilities.

Security Consulting & Collaboration
• Serve as a technical subject matter expert for information security technologies, controls, and best practices.
• Partner with internal teams to provide security guidance and recommendations for projects, operational initiatives, and technology implementations.
• Support awareness and education efforts by sharing technical security knowledge and best practices with stakeholders across the organization.
• Build and maintain productive relationships with internal teams, vendors, industry groups, and external security partners.
• Other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications and Skills
Required Knowledge
• 3+ years of experience in an Information Security role.
• Intermediate experience in Network Administration/Architecture, Security Framework Usage, SIEM Usage.
• Extensive experience in a range of threat intel/recon tools, including propriety and open source models.
• Strong understanding of security theories including Defense-In-Depth, Cyber KillChain, Assumed Breach, Zero Trust.
• Ability to initiate, react to, and take direction on specific course or response, action, and mitigation that is heavily dependent and individualized to the security situation.


Qualifications and Skills
Decision Making/Problem Solving/Advising

• Ability to recognize operational inefficiencies and identify improvement opportunities

Collaboration/Building Relationships

• Ability to collaborate effectively within and across teams.

Accountability

Communication

Learning
• Ability to actively pursue opportunities to expand knowledge and skills; applying learning to improve performance.
• Willingness to learn new skills, processes, and technologies with support and training.

Adaptability

• Demonstrated ability to show resilience and adaptability in the face of challenges or changes.

Other Skills

Preferred

title: Clinical Trial Innovation Program Director
description:
Overview

Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center is an independent, nonprofit organization providing adult cancer treatment and groundbreaking research focused on cancer and infectious diseases. Based in Seattle, Fred Hutch is the only National Cancer Institute-designated cancer center in Washington.

With a track record of global leadership in bone marrow transplantation, HIV/AIDS prevention, immunotherapy and COVID-19 vaccines, Fred Hutch has earned a reputation as one of the world’s leading cancer, infectious disease and biomedical research centers. Fred Hutch operates eight clinical care sites that provide medical oncology, infusion, radiation, proton therapy and related services, and network affiliations with hospitals in five states. Together, our fully integrated research and clinical care teams seek to discover new cures to the world’s deadliest diseases and make life beyond cancer a reality.

At Fred Hutch we value collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity and respect. Our mission is directly tied to the humanity, dignity and inherent value of each employee, patient, community member and supporter. Our commitment to learning across our differences and similarities make us stronger. We seek employees who bring different and innovative ways of seeing the world and solving problems.

The Director, Clinical Trial Innovation Program will oversee Project Rainier, a strategic clinic research transformational initiative focused on streamlining clinical trial startup, optimizing the delivery of research in the clinic, and increasing clinical trial accruals. Project Rainier will expand access to clinical trials, enhance patient experience, and strengthen scientific leadership.

Based on recommendations from a comprehensive diagnostic, the Sr. Director will design, establish, govern, and lead an enterprise transformation operating structure to deliver the intended outcomes of Project Rainer. They will provide overall program thought leadership, planning, stakeholder engagement, and day-to-day project management to ensure successful execution of initiatives across cross functional workstreams. The role will build and execute a detailed implementation plan by defining specific actions, timelines, owners, and dependencies; ensuring strong linkage across workstreams; and tying all efforts directly to measurable outcomes and defined north star goals. The Program Lead will work closely with operational leaders to create governance structures that establish clear decision pathways and lead the development of change management deliverables.

This role will have the opportunity to work partially at our campus and remotely.

At Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, all employees are expected to show a commitment to our values of collaboration, compassion, determination, excellence, innovation, integrity, and respect.

Responsibilities

  • Direct strategic planning, operating model development, and implementation of a large, multi-workstream initiative by coordinating across workstreams and underlying workgroups, ensuring alignment, identifying interdependencies, and driving integrated execution across all efforts.
  • Establish, lead, and continuously refining governance structures that span clinical and research operations; serve as the central escalation and governance point by proactively surfacing risks and issues, identifying gaps in structure or stakeholder representation, and providing decision support to executive leadership.
  • Define, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and value realization metrics to ensure program outcomes align with strategic objectives. title: Mental Health Rehabilitation Worker (Social Services)
description:
Salary Details

The salary range for this position is CAD $31.64/Hr. - CAD $31.64/Hr.

Job Summary

Come work as a Mental Health Rehabilitation Worker with Vancouver Coastal Health (VCH) on the Adult Rehabilitation team at Willow Pavilion 2 (Tertiary Mental Health) at Vancouver General Hospital. Apply now to join our team!

Within the context of a client and family-centred recovery model and in accordance with established vision and values of the organization, works as a member of an interdisciplinary tertiary mental health team to provide comprehensive psychosocial rehabilitation services within a recovery framework. A primary goal of the tertiary mental health program is to successfully support individuals in returning to the community through increasing functional skills and abilities, reducing the positive and negative symptoms of psychiatric illness, increasing coping strategies to mitigate treatment resistant psychiatric symptoms, minimizing challenging behaviours, increasing social interconnections and improving physical health and wellness.Reporting to the Program Coordinator and under the daily direction of the Registered Nurse and/or Registered Psychiatric Nurse, the Mental Health Rehabilitation Worker provides support to the recovery of individuals living with severe and persistent mental illnesses who require resources beyond the scope of secondary mental health services due to the intensity, complexity or intractability of their symptoms. Provides a variety of day-to-day physical, emotional, and social supports, advocacy, life skills assistance and support to access resources to individuals with complex severe and persistent mental illnesses. Works collaboratively with the interdisciplinary team to assist in the development of individualized rehabilitative treatment plans. Contributes to the overall evaluation of the client. Observes and monitors clients’ progress, symptoms and behavioural changes and reports significant observations. Establishes, maintains and enhances therapeutic relationships based on respect. Promotes independence for client while supporting them with activities of daily living such as personal care, including bathing, grooming, dressing, oral hygiene, toileting needs, perineal care and incontinence supply changes; community appointments/errands/activities; and meal planning and preparation. Assists in maintaining a safe environment for clients and the team. Participates in team meetings, engages in team planning and quality improvement activities, and maintains and updates own knowledge.

ABOUT WILLOW PAVILION (VGH)

Willow Pavilion is a Regional Tertiary Mental Health & Substance Use facility located on the Vancouver General Hospital Campus. It is an advanced practice environment that offers wrap-around services to clients experiencing refractory psychiatric conditions. The interdisciplinary team includes occupational, physical, vocational, and recreation therapists and assistants, pharmacists, dieticians, social workers, nurses, rehabilitation workers, doctors, peer support workers and others.

title: Remote - Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineering
description:
As a Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineering, you are a product-minded, full-stack engineer who ships faster and smarter with AI coding agents as core development tools — and who owns the harder half of that equation: knowing when the output is right. As we ship faster with agents, the engineers who can tell correct code from plausible-looking code become the ones everything else rests on. This is a builder's seat, not a ticket queue. You write production code, you build the test and evaluation infrastructure other engineers depend on, and you set the quality bar for AI-generated work.

Your work reaches millions of people. We build the travel and rewards platforms behind major banks, membership organizations, and travel brands, where members book real trips with real money and points, so trust is the product. The automation, guardrails, and release criteria you build are what let the rest of engineering move quickly without breaking that trust.

What You'll Own

  • Own the quality bar for agent output: Review and validate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability, and build the tooling that makes that judgment repeatable rather than heroic.
  • Build test and evaluation infrastructure: Design the automated testing, regression, and AI evaluation systems other teams build on, including the harnesses that catch silent failures a green test suite would miss.
  • Automate the quality path: Define workflows that automate testing, code-review triage, and deployment checks, and get them into CI so they gate real releases.
  • Define what "ready to ship" means: Set release criteria, coverage expectations, and quality signals that teams actually use, and make the fast path the safe one.
  • Ship features end to end: Build and deliver full-stack features and services for our travel platform, from implementation through production. You stay in the codebase, not adjacent to it.
  • Work with agents as core tools: Direct AI coding agents through multi-step work using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, with prompts, context, and checkpoints that produce code worth shipping.
  • Instrument for failure: Build the observability, alerting, and guardrail dashboards that tell us what broke, how we would know, and what it means for the member.
  • Protect member trust: Safeguard the privacy and security of members' sensitive data alongside our Risk and Security teams.
  • Raise the bar around you: Share what you learn about AI-assisted development and quality practice with engineers across the team.

What You'll Bring

You do not need every item below. We are excited by candidates with real strength across several of these areas.

  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience building web applications and services, or 6+ years for the senior level.
  • Real depth in software quality: test strategy, automation frameworks, and CI-gated quality checks. You have owned quality as an engineering problem, not a process one, and you write the tests and the tooling yourself.
  • Hands-on use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot in professional workflows, with real judgment about where they fail.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more of TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, or C#/.NET, plus a modern frontend framework such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Angular.
  • Experience with automated testing across the stack, including unit, integration, and end-to-end frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Jest, Vitest, or pytest.
  • Experience with RESTful API design, microservices, and cloud-native delivery on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Working knowledge of containerization and CI/CD pipelines (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol, prompt engineering for code, or AI evaluation frameworks is a plus.
  • A formal CS degree is a plus, not a requirement. Depth of engineering knowledge matters most.

Benefits & Perks

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Exclusive employee travel rates
  • Travel discounts through arrivia programs
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company participation

Who We Are

arrivia is the leading provider of travel loyalty, membership, and cruise solutions, powering travel experiences for millions of members through some of the world's most recognized brands, including T-Mobile, Marriott Vacations Worldwide, Hilton Grand Vacations, American Express, Alaska Airlines, Singapore Airlines, and more.

We're combining travel, technology, and innovation to build the future of loyalty. Through continued investment in AI, automation, and next-generation travel solutions, arrivia is transforming how people discover, book, and experience travel around the world.

title: Director, Employment and Community Services
description:
Overview

Director, Employment & Community Services Division

UCP Central PA is seeking an experienced, innovative human services leader to serve as our Director of Employment and Community Services.

This is an opportunity to lead the continued evolution of services designed to help people with disabilities participate meaningfully in their communities, pursue competitive integrated employment, build independence, and achieve personally meaningful outcomes.

The Director will provide strategic and operational leadership for an integrated division encompassing Community Participation Supports (CPS), Employment Services, and Home & Community Services (HCS). Working through a management and supervisory structure, the Director will be responsible for strengthening service integration, expanding employment opportunities, improving operational and financial performance, maintaining regulatory excellence, and ensuring individuals have access to supports that evolve with their goals and needs.

This position reports to the Senior Director of Operations.

What You'll Lead

The Director will provide leadership across a complex, multi-site service environment and will be responsible for:

Provide strategic and operational leadership for Community Participation Supports, Employment Services, and Home & Community Services, integrating services to reduce silos and create coordinated, person-centered pathways.

Advance competitive integrated employment and meaningful community participation by expanding employment pathways, employer partnerships, career exploration, benefits counseling/work-incentive resources, and individualized supports while ensuring employment opportunities are consistently explored across CPS, HCS, and Residential Services.

Drive operational and financial performance through clear expectations, data and performance dashboards, effective resource allocation, utilization and productivity management, budgeting, and strategies that strengthen long-term financial sustainability.

Ensure regulatory compliance and quality excellence across all services, maintaining continuous readiness with ODP, Medicaid Waiver, licensing, provider qualification, incident management, quality management, and organizational requirements.

Develop and hold leaders accountable by coaching and supporting managers and supervisors, strengthening leadership capacity and succession planning, and fostering a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Establish consistent service-delivery standards for referral intake, evaluation, service matching, pathway planning, documentation, participant transitions, and outcomes while identifying opportunities for service growth, redesign, and technology-enabled supports.

Build strong internal and external partnerships with Residential Services and other UCP departments, employers, OVR, Administrative Entities, Supports Coordination Organizations, educational institutions, workforce-development organizations, and community partners to expand opportunities and strengthen coordinated service delivery.

What Success Looks Like

The successful Director will help UCP Central PA build a service system in which an individual's current service setting does not define their future opportunities.

Success will include:

  • Increased competitive integrated employment and employment exploration, including consistent access to employment opportunities for individuals across CPS, HCS, and Residential Services.
  • Stronger, more coordinated service pathways across CPS, Employment Services, and HCS, with improved referral conversion and service-start timelines.
  • Improved operational performance, including authorization utilization, workforce deployment, productivity, and service capacity.
  • Sustained regulatory compliance, quality performance, and financial sustainability across the division.
  • Measurable, person-centered outcomes demonstrating meaningful progress toward employment, independence, and community participation.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of strategic leadership and operational discipline and will be comfortable leading both organizational change and complex day-to-day human services operations.

Preferred knowledge and experience include:

  • IDD and autism services, including person-centered planning, community-based supports, and services that promote independence and meaningful community participation.
  • Pennsylvania ODP and Medicaid Waiver services, including applicable regulatory requirements such as 55 Pa. Code Chapters 6100 and 2380, quality management, and continuous regulatory compliance.
  • Multi-site human services leadership, including leading through managers and supervisors, workforce planning, and managing geographically dispersed operations.
  • Competitive integrated employment and employment services, including employment pathways, benefits counseling, Social Security work incentives, and employer partnerships.
  • Financial and operational management, including budgeting, utilization, productivity, workforce optimization, and using data to drive performance and accountability.
  • Organizational change and growth, including service redesign, continuous improvement, program development, and building partnerships with funders, referral sources, employers, and community organizations.

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, education, human services, social sciences, business/healthcare administration, or a related field expected, with progressively responsible leadership experience in human services or a related field. A master's degree in a related discipline and experience leading complex human services operations are preferred.

Experience managing multiple programs, locations, or service lines and demonstrated success leading through other managers or supervisors is strongly preferred. Leadership experience in Employment Services—including supported employment, competitive integrated employment, job development, or employment pathway expansion for individuals with disabilities—is highly preferred.

UCP Central PA is committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, please contact us by sending an email to jobs@ucpcentralpa.org.

title: Chief Information Officer
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of a global law firm's technology strategy and redefine how legal services are delivered through AI and innovation?

The Chief Information Officer (CIO) is the firm's senior-most technology executive, responsible for establishing and executing the firm's technology, innovation, and information governance strategy. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the CIO leads two highly integrated functions: a comprehensive IT organization overseeing infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, and end-user services; and an Innovation team focused on AI adoption, legal technology, data analytics, research capabilities, and practice group enablement. The CIO plays a critical role in advancing the firm's vision for technology-enabled legal service delivery by leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance client service, increase efficiency, and drive competitive advantage.

As the executive accountable for the firm's technology ecosystem, the CIO ensures technology investments, operations, and innovation initiatives align with business objectives and client expectations. This leader oversees a complex technology and vendor landscape while balancing operational excellence, security, risk management, and innovation.

The ideal candidate is a forward-thinking executive who is equally comfortable discussing infrastructure resilience and AI-driven transformation. They will build strong relationships across the partnership and business operations, demonstrate exceptional executive presence, and bring a deep understanding of the unique regulatory, ethical, and competitive dynamics of a global law firm.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy & Executive Leadership

  • Develops and executes an integrated technology and innovation strategy aligned with the firm's business objectives, client service priorities, and long-term growth goals.
  • Acts as a strategic advisor to firm leadership on technology investments, operational effectiveness, risk management, and emerging capabilities.
  • Represents IT and Innovation on firm governance bodies including the AI Governance Committee and Risk Committee, and with the Executive Committee and Global Board, as well as other relevant partner-level forums.
  • Tracks market trends, emerging technologies, and competitive developments across the legal industry to position Eversheds Sutherland at the forefront of innovation.
  • Anticipates and monitors structural disruptions, including the impact of generative AI on the lawyer leverage model and traditional economics—and ensures the firm's technology posture supports strategic adaptation and responsiveness to rapidly evolving client expectations around AI-augmented service delivery.

Innovation & AI Adoption

  • Leads the firm's Innovation function, overseeing AI strategy, legal-specific tool deployment, and the full lifecycle of technology evaluation, piloting, and adoption across practice groups—with an emphasis on accelerating time-to-deployment to meet the pace of client demand.
  • Participates in and supports the AI Governance Committee, ensuring responsible deployment, client confidentiality compliance, and ethical use of AI across all approved platforms.
  • Drives attorney-facing AI adoption, working directly with practice group leaders to identify how AI can improve matter quality, reduce cycle times, lower cost-to-serve, and differentiate client deliverables—enabling the firm to deliver legal services that are demonstrably better, faster, and more cost-effective.
  • Oversees the evaluation, procurement, and performance management of legal AI tools (e.g., Harvey, Copilot, Claude, Legora) and legal research platforms.
  • Develops and maintains an AI usage governance framework, including tracking of AI utilization by client and matter to support billing transparency, client reporting, and risk management.
  • Promotes a culture of innovation, curiosity, and technology adoption across attorneys and business professionals, reinforcing technology as a strategic differentiator.

Legal Technology & Practice Group Alignment

  • Aligns technology capabilities to Practice Group needs, ensuring attorneys have tools that meaningfully improve practice and client outcomes.
  • Oversees legal research platform strategy, including vendor selection, training, and integration with knowledge management and matter workflow.
  • Leads the firm's data analysis and legal analytics capabilities, enabling data-driven insights for practice management, pricing strategy, and business development.
  • Governs the firm's data integration architecture, including data lake strategy, API integrations between legal systems, and the pipeline that connects practice group data to business intelligence tooling.
  • Provides strategic oversight of the firm's intranet platform to ensure it remains a valuable knowledge-sharing, communication, and self-service resource.

Technology Training & Change Enablement

  • Oversees the firm's technology training function, ensuring effective onboarding, adoption, and ongoing proficiency across all technology platforms.
  • Designs training programs that reflect the time constraints and learning preferences of an attorney population, including just-in-time resources, practice-specific curricula, and on-demand formats.
  • Leads change management strategy for major technology deployments, ensuring attorney and staff readiness before go-live and sustained adoption post-launch.
  • Measures and reports on technology adoption metrics as a core indicator of IT and Innovation program effectiveness.


Infrastructure & Operations

  • Oversees the design, delivery, and reliability of LAN, WAN, cloud, and AI infrastructure across all firm offices.
  • Owns the firm's Azure cloud environment, including governance, FinOps discipline, and cost optimization strategy.
  • Ensures high availability and performance of core legal applications including iManage, Interaction, Aderant, and core Microsoft Applications.
  • Directs enterprise audio-visual and conferencing infrastructure to support hybrid work and client-facing environments.
  • Leads Windows desktop engineering, application deployment, and lifecycle management across the firm's device fleet.
  • Oversees Mobile Device Management (BYOD) programs, including policy enforcement and endpoint security integration.
  • Drives a disciplined system patching and vulnerability remediation program in coordination with the CISO.

Cybersecurity & Risk Governance

  • Provides oversight of the information security function through the CISO, ensuring the firm's security posture meets the highest standards demanded by clients, cyber insurance obligations, and regulatory expectations—and that the pace of innovation never compromises the confidentiality and integrity of client data.
  • Fosters a risk-aware culture across IT and Innovation, with particular sensitivity to the confidentiality demands of legal client data and the emerging risks introduced by AI tools, ensuring that rapid adoption is always paired with rigorous privacy safeguards and governance controls.
  • Ensures the firm maintains best practice positions on data retention, e-discovery readiness, and breach response preparedness.
  • Provides cybersecurity reporting and risk narratives to firm leadership.

Service Delivery & User Experience

  • Oversees all user support, helpdesk, and onboarding functions, ensuring high-quality, consistent service to attorneys and business professionals across all offices.
  • Defines service level expectations, escalation paths, and continuous improvement programs for end-user support.
  • Ensures the IT and technology onboarding experience for lateral partner hires and new associates reflects firm standards and accelerates productivity.
  • Maintains an environment that supports attorney productivity in mobile, remote, courtroom, and client-site scenarios.

Vendor, Contract & Financial Management

  • Manages the firm's technology vendor portfolio across IT and Innovation, with discipline around contract governance, renewal management, and spend rationalization across a multi-hundred tool stack.
  • Leads technology budget development, spend planning, and variance accountability in coordination with Finance and the COO.
  • Drives portfolio rationalization to reduce redundancy, optimize licensing costs, and improves visibility into total cost of ownership.
  • Evaluates and manages strategic vendor relationships including cloud providers, managed service partners, and mission-critical SaaS vendors.

Project Management & Program Delivery

  • Oversees the IT PMO, ensuring consistent methodology, resource planning, and stakeholder communication on technology and innovation initiatives.
  • Prioritizes and sequences infrastructure, application, security, and innovation projects in alignment with firm strategy and resource capacity.
  • Leads complex program delivery including platform migrations, office builds and relocations, and M&A integration activities.
  • Ensures Innovation initiatives are managed with the same rigor applied to operational IT—with clear charters, milestones, and value realization metrics.

People Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Builds, leads, and retains a high-performing team spanning IT operations and Innovation, across multiple functional areas and geographies.
  • Fosters a culture of accountability, curiosity, and services excellence within a combined department, navigating significant change.
  • Defines org structure, role clarity, and career development frameworks appropriate to an AmLaw-caliber technology and innovation function.
  • Designs and executes structured development programs for direct reports, with a focus on building next-generation technology leadership within the firm.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 15+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including at least 5 years in a senior executive technology role such as CIO, Deputy CIO, CTO, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated success leading both enterprise IT operations and innovation functions within a legal, professional services, or similarly complex client-service environment; AmLaw 100 experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise infrastructure, cloud technologies (Azure preferred), endpoint management, and business-critical applications.
  • Proven ability to deploy and scale AI technologies responsibly while balancing innovation, security, privacy, and governance requirements.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience managing multimillion-dollar technology budgets and complex vendor portfolios.
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills with experience engaging executive leadership, boards, and partnership organizations.

Preferred

  • Experience with iManage, Aderant/Elite or similar legal platforms, and Microsoft 365 at enterprise scale.
  • Hands-on experience with legal AI platforms (Harvey, Copilot, Claude, Legora) and legal research tools (Westlaw, Lexis+, vLex).
  • Experience designing data lake architectures and managing data integration programs across enterprise systems.
  • Familiarity with legal analytics, practice intelligence platforms, and business development technology.
  • Experience managing office expansions.
  • Experience with the IT challenges and opportunities of international organizations, including the global regulatory environment and different technology standards.
  • Experience with Azure cloud operations, services, and cost optimization.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree a plus.
  • Relevant certifications (CISSP, CISM, ITIL, PMP, or equivalent) a plus.

This is a hybrid role and will require on-site presence 3 days per week. The salary ranges for this position vary depending on the geographic location and other factors such as experience, internal equity, market data, and job-related considerations. title: Equipment Rebuild Technician – Warehouse & Production
description:
Equipment Rebuild Technician – Warehouse & Production

Los Angeles, CA | $21/hr + Overtime | Full-Time

Are you the type of person who likes taking things apart, figuring out how they work, and putting them back together?

Auto-Chlor System is hiring an Equipment Rebuild Technician for our Los Angeles facility. This is a hands-on position where you'll refurbish commercial dishwashing equipment so it can be put back into service at customer locations.

Think of it similar to working in a mechanic shop—but instead of working on different cars, you'll work on different pieces of commercial equipment. You'll tear machines down, inspect components, determine what can be reused or needs to be replaced, install replacement parts, and rebuild the equipment for its next customer.

When you're not rebuilding equipment, you'll support warehouse and production operations, including preparing chemical products, building pallets, receiving shipments, organizing inventory, and operating a forklift.

Schedule & Pay

  • Starting pay: $21.00/hour
  • Start time: 6:30 AM
  • Approximately 4–5 hours of overtime per week
  • On-call rotation about once every 7–9 weeks

What You'll Do

  • Disassemble commercial dishwashing equipment
  • Inspect parts and components for wear or damage
  • Determine which components can be cleaned and reused versus replaced
  • Replace worn or damaged parts
  • Reassemble and prepare machines for future installation
  • Troubleshoot basic mechanical equipment issues
  • Clean and organize equipment and parts
  • Assist with production and warehouse responsibilities
  • Prepare and stack chemical products on pallets
  • Pour and handle cleaning chemicals following established safety procedures
  • Receive incoming deliveries and organize materials
  • Operate a standard sit-down forklift
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area

What We're Looking For

You don't need to have rebuilt commercial dishwashing equipment before. We're looking for someone who is mechanically inclined, dependable, and comfortable working with their hands.

You may be a good fit if you have experience with:

  • Mechanical repair or equipment maintenance
  • Automotive, small-engine, appliance, or equipment repair
  • Manufacturing or production
  • Warehouse operations
  • Assembly or machine operation
  • Facilities or building maintenance
  • Hand and power tools
  • Troubleshooting and repairing equipment

Forklift experience is preferred.

Most importantly, you should enjoy figuring out how things work, be willing to learn, and be comfortable balancing mechanical work with warehouse and production responsibilities.

Why Auto-Chlor?

Auto-Chlor System has been serving the restaurant and hospitality industry since 1938. Our teams install, service, and maintain commercial dishwashing systems for customers throughout the country.

This role gives you the opportunity to develop hands-on mechanical and equipment knowledge while working with different machines instead of performing the same production task all day.

If you're mechanically curious, enjoy working with your hands, and are looking for a stable opportunity where you can continue building your skills, we'd like to hear from you.

They play a crucial role in supervising the MAT initiative, ensuring its adherence to best practices, and promoting the delivery of high-quality care to individuals seeking medication-assisted treatment services.   • Direct clinical services according to licensure and scope of practice, overseeing healthcare staff training provided to other facility personnel.

Education

title: AMES BUYER
description:
Position Summary

The Buyer is responsible for managing and optimizing the inventory of materials, parts, tools, equipment, and services required to support aircraft heavy maintenance, component repair and overhaul, manufacturing operations, and affiliated companies.

This position manages the purchasing lifecycle from requisition review and supplier sourcing through quotation, purchase order generation, delivery, and supplier performance monitoring. The Buyer analyzes historical usage, inventory levels, shortages, and forecasts to ensure materials are available when needed while minimizing excess inventory and unnecessary costs.

The Buyer also supports supplier qualification and development, monitors required quality certifications, resolves delivery discrepancies, and assists with negotiating pricing and rebate agreements to achieve cost-effective procurement while maintaining compliance with applicable company, aviation, financial, and regulatory requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Review, coordinate, and process requisitions for materials, parts, tools, equipment, and services required to support heavy maintenance, component repair and overhaul, manufacturing operations, and affiliated companies.
  • Review requisitions and requests for completeness, appropriate justification, and required approvals.
  • Plan and provision materials based on operational requirements, inventory levels, historical usage, and anticipated demand.
  • Assist in developing and documenting specifications for Requests for Information (RFI) and Requests for Quotation (RFQ).
  • Research and source materials, parts, tools, equipment, and services from qualified suppliers.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations and assist with purchasing decisions.
  • Generate and transmit purchase orders in accordance with established purchasing procedures.
  • Validate and scan required reference documentation provided by requestors and enter appropriate information into the WINGS IT system part master for new material requirements.
  • Review inventory minimum and maximum stock levels and recommend appropriate provisioning actions.
  • Analyze material shortages and assist in developing timely resolutions to support operational requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and reviewing short- and long-term material requirements forecasts.
  • Evaluate, recommend, develop, and manage suppliers.
  • Investigate and resolve supplier delivery discrepancies.
  • Monitor and report supplier performance using applicable IT systems and Access database tools.
  • Evaluate engineering modification orders and provision materials based on bills of materials.
  • Draft, negotiate, and manage supplier pricing and rebate agreements.
  • Identify opportunities for long-term pricing agreements and commodity bundling to improve cost efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing, supplier, inventory, and supporting documentation.
  • Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • High school diploma or GED required.

Experience

The original job description does not identify a minimum required amount of prior work experience. Relevant procurement, materials, inventory, or supply chain experience is preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Ability to learn and operate inventory and purchasing systems.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and manage purchasing documentation.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records, track multiple orders, and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to assess urgency and business impact and effectively prioritize purchasing activities.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines while balancing urgent operational requirements with longer-term procurement planning.
  • Ability to learn and apply fundamental inventory control, purchasing, and supply chain processes.
  • Familiarity with contractual terms and purchasing documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate information and make informed decisions.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow established procedures.
  • Ability and willingness to work rotational weekend shifts.

Preferred Qualifications

Siamo una realtà dinamica ed in espansione, dove le persone vengono valorizzate per portare ricchezza e benessere a loro stesse e di riflesso all'organizzazione. title: Shipping & Receiving Lead
description:
Position Summary

The Shipping & Receiving Lead is responsible for overseeing daily shipping and receiving operations to ensure products are received, stored, and shipped accurately, efficiently, and safely. This role provides direction and support to shipping and receiving team members, coordinates workflow priorities, maintains inventory accuracy, and ensures compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and safety standards. The Shipping & Receiving Lead serves as a key point of communication between warehouse personnel, production, customer service, and management to support on-time delivery and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Shipping Operations
    • Coordinate and oversee daily shipping activities to ensure on-time and accurate shipments.
    • Prepare outgoing shipments, including packaging, banding, labeling, loading, and completion of shipping documentation.
    • Verify customer orders, shipping quantities, and special instructions prior to shipment.
    • Ensure all products are packaged securely and comply with customer and company requirements.
    • Schedule freight pickups and communicate with carriers as needed.
    • Troubleshoot shipping discrepancies and resolve issues in a timely manner.
  2. Receiving Operations
    • Oversee receiving activities, including unloading, inspection, and proper storage of incoming materials and products.
    • Verify incoming shipments against purchase orders, packing slips, and receiving documentation.
    • Coordinate with purchasing and production teams regarding shortages, damaged materials, or discrepancies.
    • Ensure all received materials are accurately entered into inventory systems.
  3. Inventory Management
    • Maintain accurate finished goods and raw material inventory using FIFO practices.
    • Monitor inventory transactions and ensure timely and accurate documentation.
    • Conduct routine cycle counts and assist with physical inventories.
    • Investigate and communicate inventory discrepancies to management.
    • Support inventory organization and material flow improvements.
  4. Leadership and Team Support
    • Provide daily direction, training, and support to shipping and receiving personnel.
    • Assist in assigning workloads and prioritizing tasks to meet operational demands.
    • Promote teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement within the department.
    • Train team members on proper shipping, receiving, inventory, and safety procedures.
    • Support management in maintaining departmental productivity and performance standards.
  5. Warehouse Organization and Safety
    • Maintain cleanliness and organization of warehouse, shipping, and receiving areas.
    • Ensure fire exits, aisles, and work areas remain clear and accessible.
    • Operate forklifts and material handling equipment safely and efficiently.
    • Enforce compliance with company safety policies, quality standards, and OSHA requirements.
    • Identify and communicate safety concerns or operational improvement opportunities.

Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum of 3 years of warehouse, shipping/receiving, or manufacturing experience.
  • Previous leadership or team lead experience.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Experience with ERP or inventory management systems preferred.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement.

Personal Attributes

  • High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
  • Reliable and dependable with a strong work ethic.
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently.
  • Flexible and adaptable to changing business needs and priorities.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and efficiency.

Physical Demands

This role requires light to moderate physical effort, including lifting up to 50 pounds. Regularly requires standing, walking, bending, reaching, and moving throughout the facility. Operation of forklifts and other material handling equipment is required. Eye, ear, hand, and footwear protection are required in designated areas.

title: Senior Environmental Health & Safety Specialist
description:
Summary

The Senior EHS Specialist serves as a subject-matter expert responsible for advanced execution, coordination, and continuous improvement of Environmental, Health, and Safety programs. This role provides technical leadership and functional oversight of EHS activities, leads complex investigations and compliance initiatives, and mentors EHS Specialists, while stopping short of formal supervisory authority.

Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Compliance

· Lead the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of EHS programs to ensure compliance with OSHA, NFPA, ISO 14001, and applicable federal and state environmental regulations.

· Serve as a technical lead for ISO 14001 EMS activities, audits, and corrective actions.

· Maintain and oversee OSHA and environmental recordkeeping requirements, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness.

· Evaluate, recommend, and support implementation of pollution prevention and control techniques.

Risk Management & Incident Response

· Lead complex accident and incident investigations; perform root cause analysis and ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained.

· Analyze injury, illness, and incident trends; develop and recommend proactive risk-reduction strategies.

· Respond to emergency situations involving hazardous materials, radiation, fire, or smoke; prepare detailed reports and formal recommendations.

Inspections & Field Execution

· Conduct advanced safety and environmental inspections, including high-risk operations and repeat findings.

· Identify unsafe conditions and oversee corrective action follow-up, including removal of defective equipment.

· Support development and tracking of department safety work orders and corrective action systems.

Leadership & Mentorship

· Provide day-to-day technical guidance and coaching to EHS Specialists.

· Act as a lead resource on assigned programs, shifts, or facilities.

· Support onboarding, training, and professional development of EHS staff.

· Serve as interim lead in the absence of the EHS Specialist Supervisor, as assigned.

Reporting & Communication

· Prepare and present EHS reports, metrics, and recommendations to management.

· Translate technical and regulatory requirements into practical guidance for plant leadership and employees.

· Collaborate cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, and HR to integrate EHS into business processes.

Other Duties

· Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

---

Experience Required

· Bachelor’s degree in Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related field.

· 5+ years of progressively responsible EHS experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.

· Advanced experience leading EHS programs, investigations, audits, or compliance initiatives.

· Degrees above the minimum education requirement may substitute for experience on a year-for-year basis.

Knowledge and Skills

· Advanced knowledge of OSHA, NFPA, and environmental compliance requirements.

· Demonstrated ability to lead investigations and conduct root cause analysis.

· Strong analytical, documentation, and reporting skills.

· Ability to influence without authority and mentor less-experienced professionals.

· Effective communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.

· Working knowledge of radiation safety standards and emergency response protocols.

Education and Experience

· High School Diploma: Required

· Associate Degree: Preferred

· Bachelor’s Degree: Strongly Preferred / Typically Required

· Certifications (Preferred): CSP, ASP, CIH, CHMM, or equivalent

Physical Requirements

· Considerable physical activity; may include lifting, pushing, or pulling up to 50 pounds.

· Frequent exposure to industrial environments requiring strict adherence to safety precautions.

· Exposure to temperature extremes, dust, fumes, noise, and other manufacturing conditions.

description:

Building the space between proven and possible, MDA Space is a trusted mission partner to the global space industry. As a Mechanical/PCB & Harness Assembler, you will perform mechanical assemblies, high‑reliability IPC‑Class‑3/​NASA soldering, and wire‑harness fabrication to IPC specifications; verify work with a digital multimeter; collaborate with engineers and quality to prototype, document, and ensure on‑time delivery of compliant assemblies.   • Optical‑assembly experience (mirror/prism bonding)
  • Familiarity with additional electrical test equipment (beyond a digital multimeter)

Certification Expectations:

  • Preferred/Asset: Active IPC‑Class‑3 certifications covering IPC/WHMA‑A‑620, IPC‑A‑610, NASA STD‑1, IPC J‑Standard (and space‑application addenda)
  • Training: In‑house training/re‑training can be provided for candidates who do not yet hold the full suite of certifications, if needed

Education & Experience

title: Registered Nuse - Intensive Care Unit
description:
Overview

Position - ICU RN within the Burn Unit

Location: Fort Sam Houston

Schedule: The contractor shall provide nursing support a seven (7) day a week, 24- hour a day operation to include holidays. Below is an example of the most common shift times which consist of eight (8) work hours with a non-paid 30-minute lunch or dinner break, a ten (10) hour shift and a 12-hour shift with a non-paid lunch or dinner break. The maximum number of shift hours to be scheduled in a twenty-four (24) hour period is twelve (12), unless an emergency occurs.

Day Shift - 0645-1515

Evening Shift - 1445-2315

Night Shift - 2245-0715

7A-7P - 0645-1915

7P-7A - 1845-0715

Pay: $51.46/hr & Health & Wellness $4.57*/hr worked (in lieu of benefits)

Holidays: Required

Benefits: Vested vacation, sick leave, holiday leave, Life, Accidental Death and Dismemberment, Short Term Disability

Optional Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(K) matching with employee participation in 401(K) plan

Responsibilities

  • Obtains patient history, pertinent family history and advanced medical directive information. Observes, assesses and records symptoms, reactions, and progress; assists physician during treatments and examinations; administers medication and prescribed treatment, completes admissions and discharges and promote convalescence and rehabilitation. RNs are responsible for monitoring and interpretation of collected data by the LVNs and unlicensed assisted personnel, informing the medical staff as appropriate.
  • Assesses patient/family knowledge level, develops, and implements a plan of instruction and documents demonstrated level of understanding. Each nurse will manually and/or electronically document all patient care given and the progress of the patient utilizing the BAMC documentation standards in the patient's medical record.
  • The RN assesses the patient and plans for appropriate nursing care. The care provided is documented in their patient's medical record along with their progress. RNs also develop and manage nursing care plans; instructs patient and their families in proper care and helps individuals and groups take steps to improve or maintain their help.
  • Communicates pertinent patient information to charge nurse and/or physician as appropriate. The RN verifies transcription of physician orders.
  • Administers medication and blood products with the knowledge of actions and usual dosages of commonly used drugs. Medications shall be administered within the scope of nursing practice and include intravenous ,subcutaneous, oral, transdermal, rectal and intramuscular. Each nurse will have knowledge of actions, adverse effects, interactions and dosages.
  • Performs a vast array of direct patient care procedures to include buy not limited to: range of motion exercises, lifting, turning, transporting and positioning patients, personal hygiene care, changing linen and clothing and feeding patients.
  • Manages care of patients for a wide range of procedures of an advanced nature and difficulty where there is a high risk for infection and bodily functions are mechanically assisted by life support.
  • Manages and ensure proper procedures are followed with the tissue/skin bank and blood bank.
  • Registered nurses shall provide professional oversight for licensed practical nurses and unlicensed ancillary personnel. Plans and implements care with the collaboration of other healthcare providers. Calls report to the appropriate unit/ward and provides pertinent data such as surgical procedures performed, patient problems, nursing diagnosis and actions, patient response, specialized care, and equipment necessary to support the patient.
  • Demonstrates the ability to react with alertness and sill in any emergency, e.g., cardiac, or respiratory arrest, hemorrhage, shock, severe physical trauma, and psychiatric reaction. Initiates life saving measures in the absence of a physician. Depending on position and protocol may serve as member of resuscitation or emergency code team.
  • Demonstrates the ability to manage interpersonal relationships and maintains composure and reacts appropriately while relating to patients and families; manage distraught, irritable, unreasonable, or angry individuals; and maintain positive rapport with all individuals involved in patient care.
  • Assesses patients' conditions for potential crises and distinguishes between normal and abnormal physical findings. Knowledgeable of the pharmacology of most used emergency drugs, anticipated results, usual dosages, and their location on crash cart. Capable of emergency equipment operation; defibrillator, EKG machine, cardiac monitor and other equipment as determined by MTF, unit/clinic and position.
  • In addition to medical surgical duties, contract RN performs critical care duties to include assessing, planning, implementing and evaluating age-specific comprehensive nursing care to critical ill patients of all ages. A thorough knowledge of the interrelationship of body systems in maintaining and restoring health is required. The Critical Care/ICU nurse will provide labor intensive care to a variety of patients with numerous complex medical pathologies such as multiple organ failure, trauma and patients requiring intense surgical interventions.
  • Manages patients requiring intense monitoring wi* technological equipment such as mechanical ventilators, adjunct airways, electrocardiograph machines, catheters, arterial lines, defibrillators, renal replacement therapy equipment, transcutaneous and external pacing devices and many others.
  • Communicates pertinent patient information to the charge nurse and/or physician as appropriate. Transcribes and verifies transcription of physician orders. In the presence of the physician initiates life saving measures, which include but are not limited to advance cardiopulmonary resuscitation, calculating dosages, mixing, and administering lethal drugs.
  • Medication administration includes titration of life-threatening intravenous medications such as vasoactive, anticonvulsants, insulin, thrombolytics and many other medications.
  • Assists and manages invasive procedures such Swan Ganz insertion, balloon pump management, temporary pacemaker insertion, arterial punctures, endotracheal intubation, and other invasive procedures.

Qualifications

  • Registered Nurses must possess an Associate diploma or Baccalaureate degree in Nurse from an accredited school of nursing from at least one state or territory in the U.S. and must be a graduate from an accredited school of nursing. All nurses must have been a health care provider for a minimum of one (1) year within the past three (3) years prior to employment by the contractor.
  • Registered Nurses must have a minimum of one (1) year of nursing experience within the last three (3) years in the area and level of nursing that is to be provided. ICU RNs shall have one (1) year ICU experience within the last three (3) years of nursing experience. A waiver may be granted by the COR in conjunction with approval by the department chief.
  • Have and maintain current certification in Basic Cardiac Life Support (BCLS). Certification in BCLS must be renewed every two years. Contract employees may attend the BAMC BCLS Recertification and Advance Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) Recertification Courses at the discretion of the COR and in a non-pay status. With COR approval, additional training opportunities within the facility may be offered to contract employees. Contractor employees may attend in a non-pay status if not during their scheduled duty day.
  • Documentation of training and skills appropriate to the RN's particular specialty, a copy of the nursing skills assessment checklist and the results for a medication test that are common to this facility. The applicant must receive a grade of 80 or higher on the medication test and be administered by the contractor.
  • Nurses must exercise a positive, helpful demeanor, display courtesy and tact frequently under stressful conditions and duress atan accelerated pace to due to life-threatening patient situations.
  • Understand, speak, read, and write English fluently.
  • Completed health examination in accordance with Health and Immunization requirements.
  • Have no health or physical disability restrictions that interfere with the performance of assigned duties.

title: Senior Project Manager (Pharma)
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Project Manager (SPM) is responsible for leading projects from initiation through completion, ensuring work is delivered on time, within scope, and on budget while consistently meeting or exceeding client and internal expectations. The SPM serves as a trusted client contact and strategic partner across Account Management, Creative, Strategy, and Production, driving seamless collaboration and high-quality execution across integrated marketing initiatives. This role requires strong leadership, adaptability, and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

The Senior Project Manager will be working EST timezone.

Key Responsibilities, including but not limited to:

Delivery Standards & Workflow Management

  • Lead and manage large-scale, complex projects including integrated campaigns, product launches, digital and print tactics, websites, email programs, social media initiatives, and multi-channel marketing efforts.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, scopes, budgets, forecasts, and resource allocations to support proactive execution and successful delivery.
  • Own project facilitation throughout the lifecycle, driving alignment, resolving ambiguity, and ensuring clear next steps across teams.
  • Manage the full project lifecycle, including project documentation, scopes of work, estimates, status reports, change orders, and budget reconciliation.
  • Monitor project health, identify risks and dependencies, escalate issues when necessary, and implement actionable solutions to maintain delivery timelines.
  • Ensure all projects adhere to agency standards, processes, and quality expectations.
  • Conduct internal and client-facing meetings, including kickoff meetings, status updates, project reviews, and working sessions.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and reporting using project management tools such as Smartsheet, Hive, Workfront, SharePoint, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
  • Lead routing and review workflows across cross-functional teams, ensuring deliverables are assigned to the appropriate stakeholders, feedback is consolidated efficiently, approvals are secured on schedule, and final assets are delivered accurately and on time.
  • Track progress across projects, manage reporting updates, and oversee day-to-day project communications and deliverables.

Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Act as a trusted client contact for project communications, providing timely updates, setting clear expectations, and fostering strong client relationships.
  • Build and maintain trusted client partnerships through proactive communication, collaboration, and executional excellence.
  • Stay informed on client processes, procedures, and business needs, adapting communication and workflows accordingly.
  • Support project-related presentations, discussions, and strategic planning initiatives.
  • If and as needed, attend client meetings to track deliverables, align on priorities, and ensure deadlines and expectations are met.

Budget, Forecasting & Resource Management

  • Develop, manage, and reconcile project budgets from initiation through completion, ensuring accurate financial tracking and resource optimization.
  • Prepare estimates, support forecasting activities, and align project plans with evolving scope and business needs.
  • Partner with finance and department leadership on revenue reconciliation, staffing alignment, and budget management.
  • Manage finance and project health reviews, including burn reports and delivery risk assessments.
  • Ensure projects are appropriately staffed, scheduled, and resourced to support successful execution.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Mentor, support, and provide guidance to Project Managers and Associate Project Managers and/or Project Coordinators, fostering professional development and project management best practices.
  • Support onboarding, training, and development initiatives for project management team members.
  • Serve as a collaborative leader across cross-functional teams, building trust, promoting accountability, and encouraging effective communication.
  • Adapt communication style based on audience and circumstances to drive alignment and productive collaboration.
  • Assist department leadership with workload management, team support, and quality oversight for deliverables.
  • Model professionalism, maturity, collaboration, and solution-oriented leadership across teams.
  • May manage direct reports.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Apply established processes, templates, and tools consistently across projects, ensuring alignment with departmental standards.
  • Act as a process champion and internal resource, supporting process improvement initiatives in partnership with department leadership.
  • Contribute to departmental initiatives, business development efforts, and agency-wide operational improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of project management experience within an integrated advertising, marketing, or digital agency environment.
  • Experience working with AOR Pharma Launch.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, integrated campaigns and large-scale initiatives across multiple channels.
  • Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
  • Skilled in project planning, facilitation, budgeting, forecasting, risk management, and issue resolution.
  • Experience managing project budgets and financial tracking processes.
  • Strong meeting facilitation and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and solution-oriented with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Experience with software development life cycles, digital production, creative workflows, and web technologies preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools such as Workfront, Smartsheet, Hive, Microsoft Project, SharePoint, or similar platforms.
  • PMP, Six Sigma, or related certifications are a plus.

Reports To: Associate Project Director

Benefits:

  • We are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to all of our employees:
  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance. We cover a generous portion of employee contributions
  • 401K plan. We invest in present and future you, which is why we offer a generous match and immediate vesting on our plan
  • Parental Leave. Generous paid time off for parents to bond with their newest addition
  • Professional Development. Each employee has an annual budget to allocate to professional development opportunities. Employees are encouraged to take a workshop, attend a webinar, join associations, and do anything else that will help them grow in their careers.
  • And more! We offer flexible time off, life insurance, LTD, a robust employee assistance program, and more!

description:

ADB is a Nationwide full turnkey provider of technology infrastructure solutions including Wireline, Wireless, Technology, and Engineering. Our customer centric approach has ensured long term relationships with commercial clients, service providers, local, state, and federal government organizations. We recognize our team members as our greatest asset ensuring that their safety, well-being, and career growth are always our number one priority. Our ALL IN culture includes a focus on Safety, Wellness, Learning, Diversity and Inclusion, and giving back to our Communities.

ADB Wireless is seeking a Level II Technician Tower to safely and efficiently climb and maneuver on a wireless structure under the direct supervision of senior tower professionals.
