title: Landscaper
description:
Join the SFM Services Team!

SFM Landscape Services is looking for experienced and reliable Landscapers to join our growing team. As a member of the SFM Services team, you will play an important role in maintaining attractive, safe, and well-kept outdoor spaces for our commercial and government clients.

SFM Landscape Services provides services at multiple locations, and available positions may vary by site based on current operational needs. The specific position, work location, schedule, and responsibilities will be discussed during the hiring process and determined based on the candidate’s experience and interview.

Hourly Rate

The hourly rate typically ranges from $16.00 to $19.00 per hour, depending on experience and the assigned work site.

Schedule

The typical schedule is Monday through Friday, from 7:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. However, schedules may vary depending on the position and work assignment offered based on the candidate’s experience and interview.

Essential Job Functions

Landscapers are responsible for helping create and maintain attractive, clean, and well-kept outdoor spaces. Duties may include, but are not limited to:

  • Operate small landscaping equipment to perform tasks such as mowing, trimming, edging, hedge trimming, weed removal, and leaf removal.
  • Perform landscape maintenance tasks efficiently while following established procedures and standards.
  • Communicate and coordinate effectively with the Foreman and/or Supervisor to ensure the accurate and timely completion of maintenance and installation jobs.
  • Maintain assigned areas in a clean, safe, and professional manner.
  • Follow all applicable safety procedures and properly operate and maintain assigned equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Previous experience in Landscape Maintenance is highly preferred.
  • Ability to operate small landscaping equipment, including lawnmowers, string trimmers, edgers, hedge trimmers, leaf blowers, and weed removal equipment.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good time management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and effectively manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Reliable and punctual attendance.
  • Professional appearance and adherence to grooming standards as outlined in SFM’s Employee Handbook.
  • Must successfully complete pre-employment screening, including a Level 2 Background Check and drug test.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work outdoors and in various landscaping environments, including exposure to plants, landscaping materials, dust, noise, and varying weather conditions.
  • Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to perform physical tasks associated with landscape maintenance for extended periods.

Become Part of SFM Services

At SFM Services, our Landscapers are an important part of the team and represent our company every day through their reliability, hard work, and commitment to quality.

If you are looking for an opportunity to grow with a professional team and take pride in the work you do, we encourage you to apply and become part of SFM Services.

Apply today and take the next step toward joining the SFM Services team!

Apply online or in person at our office located at 7500 NW 74th Ave., Medley, FL 33166.

**SFM Services is a drug-free workplace and equal opportunity employer**

¡Únete al equipo de SFM Services!

SFM Landscape Services está buscando jardineros con experiencia y confiables para unirse a nuestro equipo en crecimiento. Como parte del equipo de SFM Services, desempeñarás un papel importante en el mantenimiento de áreas exteriores atractivas, seguras y bien cuidadas para nuestros clientes comerciales y gubernamentales.

SFM Landscape Services brinda servicios en múltiples ubicaciones, por lo que las posiciones disponibles pueden variar según las necesidades operativas de cada sitio. La posición específica, ubicación de trabajo, horario y responsabilidades se discutirán durante el proceso de contratación y se determinarán de acuerdo con la experiencia del candidato y la entrevista.

Pago por Hora

El pago por hora generalmente oscila entre $16.00 y $19.00 por hora, dependiendo de la experiencia y del sitio de trabajo asignado.

Horario

El horario habitual es de lunes a viernes, de 7:00 a.m. a 3:30 p.m. Sin embargo, los horarios pueden variar dependiendo de la posición y asignación de trabajo ofrecida, de acuerdo con la experiencia del candidato y la entrevista.

Funciones Esenciales de la Posición

Los jardineros son responsables de ayudar a crear y mantener áreas exteriores atractivas, limpias y bien cuidadas. Las funciones pueden incluir, entre otras:

  • Operar equipos pequeños de jardinería para realizar tareas como cortar césped, recortar, bordear, podar setos, eliminar maleza y remover hojas.
  • Realizar tareas de mantenimiento de jardines de manera eficiente, siguiendo los procedimientos y estándares establecidos.
  • Comunicarse y coordinarse eficazmente con el Capataz y/o Supervisor para garantizar la finalización precisa y oportuna de los trabajos de mantenimiento e instalación.
  • Mantener las áreas asignadas limpias, seguras y en condiciones profesionales.
  • Seguir todos los procedimientos de seguridad aplicables y operar y mantener correctamente los equipos asignados.
  • Realizar otras tareas según sean asignadas.

Requisitos de la Posición

  • Se prefiere ampliamente experiencia previa en mantenimiento de jardines.
  • Capacidad para operar equipos pequeños de jardinería, incluyendo cortadoras de césped, desbrozadoras, bordeadoras, recortadoras de setos, sopladores de hojas y equipos para eliminar maleza.
  • Gran atención al detalle y capacidad para trabajar eficazmente en un entorno de ritmo rápido.
  • Buenas habilidades de gestión del tiempo y organización.
  • Capacidad para priorizar tareas y manejar múltiples responsabilidades de manera efectiva.
  • Asistencia confiable y puntualidad.
  • Presentación profesional y cumplimiento de los estándares de presentación personal establecidos en el Manual del Empleado de SFM.
  • Debe completar satisfactoriamente el proceso de evaluación previo al empleo, que incluye una Verificación de Antecedentes de Nivel 2 y una prueba de drogas.

Requisitos Físicos

  • Capacidad para trabajar al aire libre y en diversos entornos de jardinería, incluyendo exposición a plantas, materiales de paisajismo, polvo, ruido y diferentes condiciones climáticas.
  • Capacidad para levantar y/o mover hasta 50 libras.
  • Capacidad para realizar tareas físicas relacionadas con el mantenimiento de jardines durante períodos prolongados.

Forma Parte de SFM Services

En SFM Services, nuestros jardineros son una parte importante del equipo y representan a nuestra compañía todos los días mediante su confiabilidad, esfuerzo y compromiso con la calidad.

Si buscas una oportunidad para crecer junto a un equipo profesional y sentir orgullo por el trabajo que realizas, te invitamos a presentar tu solicitud y formar parte de SFM Services. ¡Aplica hoy y da el siguiente paso para unirte al equipo de SFM Services!

Puede presentar su solicitud en línea o en persona en nuestra oficina ubicada en 7500 NW 74th Ave., Medley, FL 33166.

**SFM Services es un lugar de trabajo libre de drogas y un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades**

title: Service Project Manager
description:
Innovative Steam Technologies (IST), a Division of Propak Systems Ltd, is the leading worldwide supplier of steam generators used in Power, Cogeneration, and Enhanced Oil Recovery applications.

The Service Project Manager is responsible for providing project management, project controls, and technical support for Service projects, including equipment repairs, inspections, commissioning, installations, and ongoing fleet support. This role supports projects from initial scope development and quotation through planning, execution, closeout, and customer reporting, ensuring work is completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with applicable engineering, quality, and company requirements.

The Service Project Manager works closely with customers, Service, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, and other internal and external stakeholders to coordinate successful execution of service activities. This position also provides technical and field support during equipment inspections, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and repair activities and may serve as IST's technical representative at customer sites.

This position reports to the Service Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develops and maintains project execution plans for Service projects, including scope, schedule, budget, resources, materials, subcontractors, and site requirements;
  • Acts as a primary point of contact for communications between the customer, Service Department, and other IST/Propak stakeholders for assigned projects;
  • Prepares budgetary and firm-price quotations and proposal documentation using established costing tools and processes;
  • Coordinates firm-price reviews and pre- and post-deployment meetings with the Service Team and Company Management as required to review scope, schedule, risks, resources, and execution requirements;
  • Prepares Parts Requisitions and Purchase Requisitions to initiate manufacturing and procurement of materials, equipment, contractors, and other external support required for project execution;
  • Coordinates purchase specifications, subcontract documents, and technical requirements with Procurement and other departments;
  • Assists in the procurement, expediting, and delivery of engineered equipment, materials, services, tools, parts, and consumables required for Service projects;
  • Coordinates and expedites shipments of tools, parts, equipment, and consumables required for field activities;
  • Coordinates project activities with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Procurement, Project Management, Field Service, and other departments to ensure order fulfillment and successful execution;
  • Ensures Service projects are executed in accordance with applicable engineering, quality assurance, safety, customer, and company requirements;
  • Develops and maintains project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and status reports;
  • Monitors project progress, percent complete, cost to date, forecast costs, and estimated cost at completion (ECAC);
  • Tracks and forecasts change orders, scope changes, and additional work and ensures project records and forecasts are updated accordingly;
  • Identifies project risks, technical concerns, schedule impacts, cost issues, and other potential problems at the earliest opportunity and communicates them to appropriate management personnel;
  • Provides project status and progress reports to customers, project teams, and management;
  • Coordinates preparation and submission of service reports, customer reports, quality documentation, ASME documentation, and project closeout packages;
  • Reviews and reconciles timesheets, expense reports, contractor invoices, rental invoices, shipping invoices, and other project-related expenses to support accurate project costing and customer invoicing;
  • Provides technical support to internal and external customers relating to equipment installation, commissioning, inspection, repair, troubleshooting, and service activities;
  • Performs equipment inspections and assists with technical troubleshooting at customer sites, including equipment located in confined spaces and environments with low light, temperature extremes, dust, and other challenging conditions;
  • Provides technical guidance to customer personnel and contractors during equipment installation and commissioning activities as required;
  • Ensures field activities are performed in accordance with applicable erection manuals, engineering documentation, procedures, specifications, and quality requirements;
  • Supports commissioning, start-up, troubleshooting, and performance testing of IST equipment at customer sites;
  • Develops and maintains professional relationships with customers, suppliers, contractors, and other external stakeholders;
  • Acts in an ethical and reasonable manner in business dealings with company suppliers, contractors, customers, and other stakeholders;
  • Supports continuous improvement, cost reduction, quality, and strategic initiatives within the Service Department and IST;
  • Drives and supports a "Safety First" culture in all aspects and locations of IST;
  • Travels domestically and internationally to support Service projects, commissioning, installation, inspection, troubleshooting, and customer service activities;
  • Performs other project management, technical, and field service duties as requested.

Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree or diploma in Mechanical, Process, or Chemical Engineering or Engineering Technology. Equivalent experience in lieu of education will be considered.
  • Eng., CET, C.Tech., PMP, or equivalent professional designation is preferred.
  • Professional registration or eligibility for registration is an asset.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in project management, field service, technical service, engineering, manufacturing, or a related industrial environment;
  • Experience managing industrial service, repair, installation, commissioning, or maintenance projects;
  • Experience developing project execution plans, schedules, budgets, forecasts, and customer reporting;
  • Experience preparing quotations, cost estimates, purchase requisitions, subcontract requirements, and other project documentation;
  • Experience coordinating procurement, contractors, suppliers, and third-party service providers;
  • Experience with industrial steam generation, boilers, HRSGs, OTSGs, power generation, oil and gas, petrochemical, or related equipment is preferred;
  • Previous EPC or EPCM experience is an asset;
  • Previous fabrication or manufacturing experience is an asset;
  • Experience working at customer sites and coordinating field activities is preferred;
  • Experience with ASME documentation, quality documentation, or pressure equipment is an asset

Interested candidates should apply via IST’s job board at .

Innovative Steam Technologies thanks all applicants for their interest however only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Building Engineer- Volusia/Flagler/North Brevard/Orange  Counties
description:
At Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU), our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

As a Building Engineer in our Baytree Headquarters you will be responsible for maintaining, operating, and troubleshooting building systems. Your role will focus on performing routine maintenance tasks, responding to service requests, and ensuring systems operate safely. This role will focus on Servicing Branch Locations in Volusia/Flagler/North Brevard/Orange Counties.

Why Join SCCU?

  • Member-Focused Mission: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
  • Career Growth: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

Building Engineer Key Responsibilities

  • Perform scheduled maintenance, repairs, and inspections of building systems; address service requests, including hot/cold calls, plumbing issues, and lighting repairs.
  • Troubleshoot minor equipment malfunctions and escalate issues as needed.
  • Replace light fixtures/bulbs, filters, and other components as required.
  • Maintain accurate records of inspections and equipment performance.
  • Interact with occupants, contractors, and facilities managers and work closely with facilities management leadership to support smooth building operations and resolve location issues.
  • Assist with preventive maintenance tasks and contractor oversight.
  • Conduct property inspections to identify deficiencies.
  • Record equipment readings and ensure assigned building systems are operating according to standards.
  • Follow company safety protocols and wear appropriate PPE; ensure compliance with OSHA, NEC, NFC, NFPA regulations; report safety hazards; participate in safety inspections.
  • Provide guidance to junior Technicians when needed.
  • Communicate verbally and in writing with teammates, leadership team, and vendors in a professional manner, keeping the appropriate customer(s) informed/updated as needed.
  • Work closely with senior management to develop technical skills and participate in professional development programs.

Building Engineer Requirements

  • HS Diploma or GED required
  • A valid Universal level EPA Section 608 certification is required.
  • A valid Florida driver’s license with and an acceptable driving record is required
  • Minimum of four (4) years of technical experience in all aspects of building engineering with a strong background in technical aspects of HVAC equipment and systems, plumbing, electrical, equipment repair and maintenance, and overall system design and application.
  • 3-5 years of job-related experience or commensurate certification/trade experience.

Job Title Compensation

  • Starting Salary: $32.04 - $33.93 per/hour depending on experience.
  • Bonus Opportunity: Eligible for a 4% ONE SCCU Annual Bonus.

SCCU Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
  • Financial Perks: 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
  • Education Support: Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
  • Generous Time Off: 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!

Work Schedule

  • Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.
  • Occasional Saturdays & On Call as needed

About SCCU

Since 1951, Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU) has proudly served our community, growing to over 685,000 members and managing $9 billion in assets. With 67 branches spanning Florida’s east coast, we are the third-largest credit union in the state. In 2025, we expanded into Orange County to better serve the growing East Orlando market.

As a not-for-profit financial institution, SCCU is dedicated to putting our members first. Unlike traditional banks, we return profits to our members through better rates, lower fees, and enhanced services. While we offer the same financial products—like checking, savings, and loans—our focus remains on empowering our members and supporting their financial well-being. With local decision-making and a commitment to exceptional service, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the lives of those we serve.

title: Operational Technology and NERC Compliance
description:
Manager, Operational Technology and NERC Compliance

If you are looking for an opportunity to directly contribute to a dynamic, team-centric environment where you will work side-by-side with leadership, learning from some of the most experienced and respected professionals in the industry on a broad range of management consulting engagements, you are looking in the right place.

ScottMadden is a general management consulting firm with three main practice areas — Energy, Corporate & Shared Services, and Enterprise & Specialized Services. We work with forward-thinking clients across a wide variety of business units and functions.

The Manager, Operational Technology and NERC Compliance

The Manager, Operational Technology (OT) and Digital/AI Enablement provides technical and strategic expertise to ScottMadden clients and internal teams, supporting the modernization of utility operations across generation, transmission, and distribution environments.

This role extends beyond traditional NERC compliance to focus on enabling clients across:

  • Cybersecurity & Compliance (NERC/CIP and beyond)
  • Data & Architecture (OT/IT convergence, data governance, integration)
  • AI & Advanced Analytics (use case development, pilots, scaling)
  • Operational Systems & Digital Modernization (EMS/SCADA, EAM, DERMS, etc.)
  • Workforce Enablement & Change Management (future of work, training, adoption)
  • Integrated Operations & Performance Optimization (cross-functional decision support, outage optimization, fleet-level insights)

The Manager helps clients move from compliance-driven programs to digitally enabled, AI-supported operations that improve reliability, safety, and cost performance.

Travel, at the discretion of the client, may be necessary.

Essential Functions

Client Delivery & Advisory

  • Provide subject matter expertise across OT, cybersecurity, and digital transformation domains
  • Lead and support client engagements spanning NERC compliance, OT modernization, and AI-enabled operations
  • Translate operational challenges into scalable digital and AI-enabled solutions (e.g., outage optimization, predictive maintenance, control room decision support)

OT/AI Strategy & Enablement

  • Help clients define and implement roadmaps across the six OT/AI pillars
  • Identify and prioritize high-value use cases for AI and advanced analytics within OT environments
  • Support integration of OT systems with enterprise data platforms and cloud environments where appropriate

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Maintain deep expertise in NERC - CIP / O&P and related regulatory frameworks while helping clients modernize compliance programs
  • Advise on risk-based approaches that integrate cybersecurity, reliability, and operational performance

Business Development

  • Support new opportunities across OT, digital, and AI domains
  • Develop proposals and thought leadership aligned to client needs and market trends
  • Support client relationship development and account growth

Internal Capability Development

  • Contribute to development of methodologies, tools, and accelerators (e.g., compliance automation tools, OT maturity models, AI prototypes)
  • Support development of reusable assets aligned to OT/AI enablement COE
  • Mentor junior staff and contribute to knowledge sharing across the firm

The Project Team

You will work on small project teams to identify, and often implement, solutions to client problems and challenges. Project teams are typically composed of three or four consultants and a partner. Working closely with experienced ScottMadden consultants and partners will maximize your learning and enable meaningful project contributions from your very first assignment.

The Culture

ScottMadden is an inclusive, tight-knit community of professionals where both collaboration and individual performance are rewarded. Initiative and creativity are recognized and valued. Our culture is both collegial and entrepreneurial. Employees build relationships that extend beyond the office and are always willing to help one another to ensure the work for our clients is done right.

ScottMadden is an ideal place to make your mark and take your career to the next level. Consultants are provided a supportive network for career advancement. You will be assigned a senior-level sponsor who encourages and supports your development goals, and a similar-level onboarding ambassador who ensures you have all the tools needed to be successful during your first year with the firm. Feedback is provided frequently, with structured review processes occurring at the end of each project and annually.

Promotions occur on a quarterly basis and are paced to each individual’s progress. Bonuses are earned quarterly based on the objective measure of utilization.

The Qualifications

Our ideal candidate is well rounded and possesses the following:

  • Strong industry knowledge across OT environments, utility operations, and digital transformation
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • NERC/CIP compliance and regulatory programs
    • OT cybersecurity and risk management
    • Utility operational systems (e.g., SCADA, EMS, DMS, EAM)
    • Data architecture, integration, or analytics in OT environments
    • AI/advanced analytics use cases in industrial or utility settings
  • Ability to connect technical solutions to business value and operational outcomes
  • Strong consulting mindset: structured problem solving, client management, and executive communication
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects and multiple workstreams
  • Excellent leadership, collaboration, and interpersonal skills

The Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related field (advanced degree a plus)
  • 10+ years of experience in energy or critical infrastructure, with exposure to OT environments
  • 2+ years of consulting experience strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience working at the intersection of operations, technology, and business strategy

title: Production Scheduler II (Manufacturing)
description:
Job Summary:

This individual will be responsible for planning, organizing, and maintaining the Shop Floor Schedule. The SFS is a planned production assembly schedule, in weekly capacity-constrained sections, that is derived from the Master Production Schedule. The goals of the Production Scheduler are production efficiency, velocity, and on-time completion of Shop Operations and Shop Orders to Original Customer Promise. The Production Scheduler works together with the Master Scheduler to ensure plant loading that results from the SFS neither under or overloads available capacity. The Production Scheduler also works together with Manufacturing Engineering, Purchasing, and Material Analysts to ensure plant loading from the SFS takes into consideration material availability.

Minimum Qualifications: (Education, Experience, Knowledge, and Skills):

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 3-5 years of planning experience preferred
  • APICS – CPIM certification is preferred or willing to obtain
  • Individual must be a highly-organized, open-minded & motivated self-starter.
  • A high level of communication skills (verbal & written) is required.
  • A “hands-on” approach to monitoring production processes versus the SFS is required – including frequent interactions with floor-level supervisors, production managers, materials analysts, buyers, and senior management.
  • A proactive problem solving methodology – acting as a catalyst for bringing to right team members together to resolve issues that create risk of shipment to OCP, before results are missed.
  • Ability to report findings and KPI’s to Production Control Manager.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain the Shop Floor Schedule (SFS), with the goal of achieving 90%+ on-time shipment to OCP.
  • Drive high accuracy into the SFS for a rolling 4-week time period, to ensure plant capacity is effectively utilized to meet aggressive business growth goals.
  • Develop an SFS that specifies the timing and sequence of shop operations and shop orders based on multiple inputs – Master Production Schedule (MPS), material availability, labor capacity, and project priority.
  • Develop and maintain (in IFS) a clear view of plant demand/loading by Work Center (based on current scheduled SO loading and hours in routings).
  • Monitor workflow and plant production areas to ensure on time delivery while reducing downtime, changeovers and hours worked.
  • Setup and maintain a strong communication system with Work Center leads and Manufacturing Engineering to ensure hours in routings accurately reflect the time needed to do the work. Identify areas where estimates and actual hours differ, and coordinate with Manufacturing Engineering to update templates to ensure future accuracy.
  • Develop work process/procedure to utilize current IFS functionality to improve the accuracy and efficiency of scheduling new work and balancing Work Center loading. Load new SO's based on open capacity.
  • Supply work bills and other paperwork required to complete the scheduled work (Kitting)
  • Identify, own, and deliver revisions made to Bill of Material that impact manufacturing.
  • Proactive communication in the event of under or over load situations to enable adjustments in shop operation/order schedules to ensure on-time performance is maintained for business-critical projects.
  • Maintain KPI's for Shop Order and Shop Operation on-time completion to (original) schedule.
  • Additional responsibilities and objectives will be added as needed based on business and area of needs.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

  • Must be able to work in an office environment with a lot of sitting
  • Must be able to tolerate a full day of computer screen viewing
  • Some walking will be required to browse production on the shop floor
  • Professional office environment
  • General manufacturing environment

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Management reserves the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time, based on business needs.

Additional Position Information:

Required Education & Experience:

title: Vice President Defense and Intelligence Engineering
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role:

As the Vice President of Defense and Intelligence (D&I) Solutions Engineering, you will lead, scale, and direct the software engineering organization responsible for building Planet’s end-to-end dual-use products and applications. You will own the technical architecture, systems development, and operational delivery of flagship dual-use products—such as Global Monitoring Service (GMS), Marine Domain Awareness (MDA), automated change detection feeds, and agentic workflows.

In this executive engineering role, you will lead multi-disciplinary teams across software, architecture, AI/ML, analytics, and forward deployed engineering. You will partner directly with Product Management, Core Platform Engineering, and Executive Leadership to transform raw satellite imagery and API services into scalable, mission-critical dual-use software solutions. You will oversee system availability, performance SLAs, and ITAR-compliant deployment pipelines, serving as the senior engineering authority for Planet’s defense and intelligence software portfolio. Ideal candidates are visionary engineering leaders passionate about delivering impactful geospatial solutions.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our San Francisco or Washington DC office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own:

  • Engineering Leadership & Delivery: Lead, mentor, and scale multi-disciplinary software engineering teams (software, data/ML, platform, and infrastructure) tasked with building and maintaining end-to-end dual-use products like Global Monitoring Service (GMS) and Marine Domain Awareness (MDA).
  • Architecture & Systems Design: Define the software architecture, data models, and technical standards required to deliver high-throughput geospatial analytics, real-time alerting, and automated detection platforms at scale.
  • Trade & Regulatory Compliance: Oversee engineering development standards and deployment pipelines to ensure full technical compliance with International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR).
  • Product Co-Development: Partner with Product Management to translate high-level market vision and defense mission requirements into scalable engineering roadmaps, system designs, and execution sprints.
  • AI & Agent Integration: Direct the technical integration of advanced machine learning models, analytics, and agentic workflows into Planet's dual use product stack.
  • Operational Excellence: Drive software engineering metrics, system reliability, low-latency processing, and secure cloud deployment architectures across commercial and sovereign environments.

What You Bring:

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering and systems architecture, with a focus on high-scale data, computer vision, or geospatial applications.
  • 8+ years of direct experience leading and scaling multi-disciplinary engineering organizations (software, data/ML, platform, and cloud infrastructure).
  • Direct experience managing engineering teams, software build pipelines, and data handling governed by International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR).
  • Demonstrated track record of architecting, building, and operating end-to-end dual-use or defense software applications (such as domain awareness, automated change detection, or spatial monitoring platforms) at scale.
  • Active high-level government security clearance, or demonstrated eligibility to obtain top-secret clearance upon hire.
  • Deep technical expertise in distributed cloud architectures, high-throughput data processing pipelines, API infrastructure, and machine learning model integration.
  • Proven ability to drive software delivery metrics, maintain high operational availability/SLAs, and establish rigorous engineering practices.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a relevant technical discipline.
  • Direct engineering experience building foundation models for remote sensing use cases, agentic platforms, or automated tip-and-cue execution loops.
  • Background in developing software for secure government environments, air-gapped systems, or sovereign cloud deployments (e.g., AWS GovCloud/C2S).
  • Experience in multi-sensor data fusion workflows, including optical satellite imagery and Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR).

  • Prioritizes patient care utilizing the Emergency Severity Index (ESI) or facility-approved triage system.
  • Develops, implements, and evaluates individualized plans of care.
  • Administers medications, blood products, IV therapies, and treatments safely and accurately.
  • Monitors patient response to treatment and promptly communicates changes in condition to the provider.
  • Provides care to patients across the lifespan, including pediatric, adolescent, adult, and geriatric populations as applicable.
  • Assists with emergency procedures including trauma resuscitation, stroke alerts, STEMI activations, code blue responses, rapid responses, and disaster management.
  • Initiates and maintains IV access and assists with advanced airway management as needed.
  • Performs and interprets patient monitoring including cardiac telemetry, pulse oximetry, capnography, and hemodynamic monitoring.

Patient Throughput and Coordination

  • Collaborates with physicians and multidisciplinary teams to facilitate timely patient evaluation, treatment, admission, transfer, or discharge.
  • Coordinates patient care activities to support efficient patient flow and reduce length of stay.
  • Ensures appropriate documentation and communication during patient handoffs.
  • Participates in transfer processes and stabilization of patients requiring a higher level of care.

Documentation

  • Documents assessments, interventions, patient responses, and outcomes accurately and timely within the electronic medical record.
  • Maintains compliance with regulatory, legal, and accreditation requirements.
  • Completes required quality and safety documentation.

Patient and Family Education

  • Provides education regarding diagnoses, medications, procedures, discharge instructions, and follow-up care.
  • Assesses patient understanding and readiness to learn.
  • Promotes patient engagement and shared decision-making.

Quality and Safety

  • Adheres to infection prevention and control practices.
  • Identifies and reports safety concerns, adverse events, and near misses.
  • Participates in performance improvement, patient safety, and quality initiatives.
  • Maintains compliance with hospital policies, CMS, Texas Department of State Health Services, and accreditation standards.

Professional Practice

  • Demonstrates professional communication and collaboration with patients, families, physicians, and staff.
  • Serves as a patient advocate.
  • Participates in departmental meetings, education, and competency validation.
  • Maintains required certifications and licensure.

Emergency Department Specific Responsibilities

  • Rapid assessment and stabilization of critically ill or injured patients.
  • Care of patients presenting with:
    • Cardiac emergencies
    • Stroke symptoms
    • Trauma injuries
    • Respiratory distress
    • Sepsis
    • Behavioral health emergencies
    • Medical and surgical emergencies
    • And any other patient condition presenting to the ED
  • Participation in disaster preparedness and emergency management activities.
  • Assists with procedural sedation and emergency procedures within scope of practice.
  • Supports EMTALA compliance requirements.
  • Responds to hospital emergency codes as assigned.
  • Other responsibilities as directed by leadership.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong critical thinking and clinical judgment skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple patients simultaneously.
  • Knowledge of emergency nursing principles and standards.
  • Ability to recognize and respond to rapidly changing patient conditions.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.
  • Proficiency in electronic medical record documentation.
  • Ability to maintain composure and effectiveness during high-stress situations.

Physical Requirements

  • Frequent standing, walking, bending, lifting, pushing, and pulling.
  • Ability to lift and move patients and equipment with appropriate assistance.
  • Ability to respond quickly to emergency situations.

Performance Expectations

  • Demonstrates commitment to patient safety, quality outcomes, customer service, and regulatory compliance.
  • Maintains competency in emergency nursing skills and hospital-required competencies.
  • Supports departmental goals related to patient satisfaction, throughput, quality metrics, and clinical outcomes.
  • Visual and auditory acuity sufficient for patient assessment and monitoring.

Core Values

  • The Emergency Department RN is expected to uphold the hospital's mission, vision, and values while providing compassionate, safe, high-quality care to every patient, every time. #100

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
Overview/ Job Responsibilities

Entarian is looking for a DevSecOps Engineer to support the Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) Ordnance Information System (OIS) program based in Mechanicsburg, PA, as they modernize their legacy IT systems. The right candidate will be working directly with our program’s Lead Pipeline / DevSecOps Engineer and the DevSecOps Engineering team, software developers, production/operations, and integration teams to support a complex program to provide Agile development and operations and maintenance on a mission-critical program. This DevSecOps engineer will implement the pipeline execution plan to maximize our performance and quality with the right automations and efficiencies for our IT modernization efforts.

This position is on-site in a secured space 5 days/week and can be filled in either Mechanicsburg, PA, OR Yorktown, VA.

As the DevSecOps Engineer, you will interface with the Lead Pipeline / DevSecOps Engineer to assist in the strategy, design, development, and maintenance to build pipelines and methods to monitor our Kubernetes cloud targeted development, test/staging, and production environments. You are focused on automation and are passionate about creating best-in-class tooling for our Developers, Integration, Cybersecurity, and Operations teams. You will work collaboratively with the department and functional groups across the organization.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Implements CI/CD and DevSecOps execution plan to maximize performance and quality.
  • Monitors associated standards (for areas such as build and deployment processes, data pipeline between software development tools through deployment to Kubernetes pods, etc.).
  • Monitors CI/CD and DevSecOps capabilities/processes to ensure they align with Navy policies and implements security architecture according to plans that includes, but not limited to, automation, where best suited, and ensures processes and implementation account for data separation, environment separation (dev, test, prod), and separation of user and privilege user roles.
  • Applies CI/CD for defining & operating the configuration management process to handle Non-Production and Production environments.
  • Builds CI/CD based version control, automated builds, and release management that align with Navy requirements.
  • Documents the program’s enterprise CI/CD and DevSecOps strategy, high level data flow, implements/monitors an end-to-end data management/ technical architecture, integrates with the right tools (Jira, Jenkins, Selenium, ANSIBLE, GitLab, Docker, etc.), and provides corresponding roadmaps. Drafts and edits existing documentation as well as coordinates documents with subject matter experts within contract program and software development teams.
  • Works with Lead Pipeline / DevSecOps lead to facilitate solutions to integrate a more automated code analysis validation process, where possible.
  • Monitors CI/CD and DevSecOps implementation across a matrixed team, tracking and managing solutions, status updates, schedules and risks. Daily collaboration efforts with extended team(s) are expected.
  • Communicates with team leadership and potentially with senior leadership (internally or client) regarding matters of significant importance to the organization/project.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Must have fully adjudicated DOD T5 background check (Top Secret Clearance) to start; U.S. Citizen required only for Federal Clearance Requirement
  • Certification Requirement: Directive 8570.1/8140 - IAT II: Security+
    • Baseline cert (required to start): Security+ (or CCNA-Security, SSCP, CySA+, or GICSP)
    • Computing Environment Cert (must obtain within 3 months if not in hand): AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or similar equivalent Cloud environment certification (Cloud Architect, DevOps or SysOps Associate or Professional Certification)
  • AA/AS (in Engineering, Computer Science or related field) or equivalent experience and 1+ years of prior relevant DevSecOps experience
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline automation tools, cloud environments and associated cloud deployments and network stack/protocols; knowledgeable in building and working with Docker or similar containers;
  • Ability to work in agile environment and collaborate with other teams/groups in a fast-paced agile environment;
  • Experience programming and designing software using Terraform and AWS cloud services
  • Experience with modern development software, tools, and methodologies such as GitLab and Docker
  • Strong verbal and written technical communication skills

Desired Qualifications

  • Understanding and experience programming and designing software using Ansible, Java, J2EE, Oracle, WebLogic, Tomcat
  • Experience with modern development software, tools, and methodologies; Jenkins, Jira, Nexus, Maven, OpenShift, SonarQube, Fortify, Junit, Karma, Selenium, Cyprus, Artifactory
  • Experience in network and cyber security design, engineering, and operations with emphasis on Navy capabilities
  • Experience developing models using Sparx EA, Splunk, MuleSoft, SalesForce
  • Experience with NIST SP 800 series or ISO 27000 series documents for information security management and risk assessment
  • Experience with Angular, ReactJS, Spring MVC, JQuery, JSF, JSP, MyBatis, Hibernate, IBM MQ, Kafka, ELK, Grafana, or PLSQL
  • Experience with server virtualization technologies such as VMware, Citrix, or Hyper-V
  • Experience with operating systems such as RedHat Linux and Windows Server
  • Kubernetes troubleshooting experience (pod failures, networking, deployments, etc.)
  • Experience in ITIL, ISO20000 / ISO27001 implementations
  • Navy IT projects experience

About Us

Formed through the strategic union of Sev1Tech and ERT, Entarian is a premier provider of mission-critical engineering and technology solutions. Founded on a legacy of excellence dating back to 1993, Entarian is a product of an evolved and fully diversified engineering and federal technology leader. From deep space to defense and civilian missions, Entarian delivers secure, mission-aligned digital solutions that drive national resilience and operational effectiveness. We don't just support modernization; we define it.

title: Biology Academic Advisor
description:
Overview

The Academic Advisor will advise for the Biology programs within the College of Arts and Sciences. The position will help build a total ArtSci experience, including the development of a culture of empowering student success, engagement through inside and outside-the-classroom opportunities, and the transition to meaningful careers. The selected candidate will work closely with the Biology Department and its programs.

Responsibilities

  • Assist students with creating and managing a program of study that maximizes their 1) potential for success while in school, 2) timely graduation, and 3) opportunities to reach academic and career goals after graduation.
  • Provide students with correct up-to-date academic information about university graduation requirements.
  • Track students' academic progress and inform them of their status.
  • Work closely with the assigned department to recruit and retain high quality students.
  • Participate in assessment activities.
  • Develop expertise in academic advising tools such as: DegreeWorks, Banner, etc.
  • Assist students in the exploration of their educational goals, including possible areas of study, class selection, connecting students to curricular and extracurricular opportunities, and exploring career and graduate school opportunities.
  • Help students to understand the expected standards of achievement and likelihood of success in areas of study, as well as providing them information about alternatives, limitations, and possible consequences of academic decisions.
  • Maintain familiarity with available campus resources and effectively connect students to campus resources when appropriate.
  • Recommend students for a variety of awards and scholarships.
  • Maintain and update student files to effectively track student progress.
  • Assist in other areas as needed.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Up to 1 year of relebant work experience.
  • Excellent computer skills including experience with Microsoft Office.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Educational background in the life sciences or experience or educational background in education or counseling.
  • Understanding of developmental academic advising processes.
  • Experience with the software programs DegreeWorks, Banner, and/or Aggie Handshake.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of student development and the ability to serve and assist the students in developing effective academic plans and career and life goals in order to promote student retention and academic success.
  • Knowledge of student advising and graduation requirements for academic degrees, and the ability to anticipate department and/or student needs.
  • Ability to creatively and independently problem-solve by prioritizing and multitasking while under pressure.
  • Ability to serve individuals with diverse personalities through the use of effective oral, written and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to understand and form a commitment to USU's mission, strategic initiatives, and communities of engaged learners.
  • Knowledge of university course schedules and degree requirements.
  • Knowledge of student advisement methods and techniques (monitoring students' classes, scheduling, academic progress, and registration).
  • Ability to keep student information confidential and abide by FERPA laws.
  • Ability to always maintain professionalism even in high stress situations.
  • Understanding of, or ability to learn University IT systems including DegreeWorks, Banner, Aggie Handshake, and other academic and office productivity software.
  • Ability to work on one's own with minimal supervision.

Required Documents

Along with the online application, please attach:

  • Cover letter to be typed/pasted at the end of your application

$47,500, plus excellent benefits

ADA

Founded in 1888, Utah State University is Utah’s premier land-grant, public service university. As an R1 research institution, Utah State is dedicated to advancing knowledge and serving the public good through innovative research and scholarly activities that are grounded in reciprocal engagement with local, regional, and global communities. title: Instructional Assistant - Pre-Kindergarten Blended Program 50%
description:
Overview

POSITION TITLE (Oracle title)

INSTRUCTIONAL ASSISTANT-PRE-K (General Education, Special Education, or Title I)

WORKING TITLE

Instructional Assistant-Pre-K Blended (Assignment could be divided and be in a Pre-K General Education classroom, Pre-K Special Education assignment, and/or Pre-K Title I school site assignment)

SCHOOL/DEPARTMENT

Office of Early Learning (OEL)

LOCATION

School Site

PAY GRADE

Noncertified Grade 20 or 21 (Dependent upon assignment(s))

FLSA STATUS

Nonexempt

ELIGIBILITY FOR EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

No

WORK WEEK SCHEDULE

Monday-Friday (occasional evenings and weekends)

POSITION PURPOSE:

Performs instructional support work assisting classroom teachers in classroom activities as well as general administrative support tasks. Implements goals and objectives established by licensed teachers and works directly with students. Assists in the instruction of individual students or groups of students in all curricular areas as directed by teachers or administrators. Plans and collaborates with teachers in devising special strategies related to childcare licensure requirements, if applicable. Position can be utilized in more than one assignment (blended).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)

  • Considerable knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point; Google Apps;

  • Working knowledge of successful instructional delivery methods;

  • Working knowledge of the core subjects at the grade level to which employment assignment is made;

  • Ability to recognize and support students of diverse backgrounds, learning abilities, and learning styles;

  • Ability to protect the confidentiality of personally identifiable information in accordance with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974 (FERPA) and other applicable federal and state laws, policies, and regulations;

  • Ability to work in a team environment and effectively collaborate with others;

  • Ability to motivate students;

  • Ability to constantly supervise the safety and well-being of students;

  • Ability to work with a diverse student population and recognize variations in student backgrounds, abilities, and learning styles;

  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely both in oral and written form using a variety of communication techniques and tools to ensure the appropriate flow of information, collaborative efforts, and feedback;

  • Ability to implement academic and behavioral interventions, as needed;

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with school system staff, students, parents, businesses, community agencies, and the public.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE FOR NC PRE-K PROGRAMS (can include Blended and/or Title I)

  • High school diploma or GED and shall hold or be working towards, an Associate’s degree in birth-through- kindergarten, child development, early childhood education, or an early childhood education related field or a Child Development Associate (CDA) credential. Instructional assistants working toward the minimum of an associate degree shall make progress by completing a minimum of six documented semester hours per year; AND

  • For Title I schools, meet the employment requirements outlined by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA), Public Law 114-95.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE FOR NON NC PRE-K PROGRAMS (can include Preschool Special Education/Self-Contained, Blended, and/or Title I)

  • High school diploma or equivalent; AND

  • For Title I schools, meet the employment requirements outlined by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA), Public Law 114-95.

CERTIFICATION AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS

  • Maintain a Crisis Prevention and Intervention (CPI) certification (specific program to be determined based off position; maintain that certification through the proper renewal process; adhering to all timelines; CPI training will be provided through WCPSS, if needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • CPR and First Aid certification.

  • For Pre-K Special Education and Blended programs, experience working with or assisting individuals with special needs (an individual with one or more difficulties such as, a physical, emotional, behavioral, or learning disability or impairment that causes an individual to require additional or specialized services or accommodations).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

All Pre-K Programs:

  • Provides assistance with activities and duties that implement the total school program, assists teachers in instructional activities, and assists teachers in ensuring an encouraging, caring, safe and healthy environment for all students.

  • Aids teachers with planning and organizing, evaluating instructional activities, developing classroom licensure procedures, and preparing necessary materials; ensures materials for students are readily available according to the needs of the lesson plan.

  • Demonstrates professional and technical skills necessary to function effectively in the classroom and to support the school program.

  • Works with an individual student and/or specific groups of students in different pre-k licensed classrooms and/or area of the school, as needed.

  • Participates in the district staff development program and continued professional growth in the area of assignment.

  • Maintains a positive disposition, exercises good judgement, and remains calm when dealing with students at all times.

  • Compiles, maintains, and files reports, records, and other required documents, maintaining confidentiality.

  • Coordinates and assists students with special health care needs, which could include:

  • Personal hygiene, restroom functions, diapering, etc.;

  • Mobility assistance including lifting, positioning or transferring student(s);

  • Behavioral assistance and CPI skills.

  • Performs other related duties, as assigned.

Preschool Special Education/Blended Programs:

  • Provides support and assistance to teachers in coordinating instructional programs for special education students, including familiarity with student’s IEP; ensures an encouraging, caring, safe, and healthful environment for all students.

  • Assists teachers with strategies related to the implementation of students’ behavioral intervention plans.

  • Assists teachers with implementation of low- and high-tech assistive technology and augmentative communication devices in the classroom to meet both class-wide and individual student needs.

  • Performs other related duties, as assigned.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a classroom environment and requires sitting and standing throughout the day. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, scanners, and copiers. The position, at times, must be able to come into direct contact with school system staff, staff members of external funding agencies, and the community. Work is considered medium physical work, requiring the exertion of up to 50 pounds force occasionally, and/or up to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. School can contact the school’s Physical Therapist for assistance, if needed, with proper lifting techniques.

EFFECTIVE DATE: 6/2026

They are not intended to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required by the employees assigned to this position. This description may be revised by HR and approved at any time.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - B2B platform (Laravel + Nuxt/Vue)
description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.


The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4. Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Full Lifecycle Development: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end B2B features across the stack- from Laravel/Doctrine JSON:API endpoints to reactive Nuxt 3/4 Vue components and server routes.

  • Embed & Analytics Engine: Develop and optimize high-performance embedded widget systems, Nitro server engine logic, iframe cross-origin messaging, client event-tracking SDKs, and data ingestion pipelines.

  • API & Database Architecture: Design robust relational database schemas (MySQL), Doctrine entity mappings, clean migrations, performant RESTful/JSON:API contracts, and Redis caching layers.

  • AI-Native Acceleration: Integrate AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) into daily development for rapid feature prototyping, code refactoring, test generation, and building LLM-driven product features (e.g., automated applicant evaluation).

  • Third-Party Integrations*:* Integrate and maintain core third-party services and APIs, including CRM platforms, error tracking systems, payment gateways, and cloud data services

  • Automated Testing & Quality: Establish comprehensive automated test coverage (PHPUnit for backend, Playwright and Vitest for E2E/components) integrated into CI/CD pipelines to guarantee zero regressions.

  • Mentorship & Code Reviews: Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews and collaborate closely with product managers, QA engineers, and leadership to elevate team standards.

Required Qualifications (Must Haves)

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional full-stack web development experience, with at least 1+ year actively incorporating AI coding assistants into daily engineering workflows.

  • Backend Expertise (PHP & Laravel): Strong commercial experience with PHP 8+ and Laravel (clean service architecture, queues/jobs, middleware, and OAuth2/Passport authentication).

  • Frontend Mastery (Vue 3 & Nuxt 3/4): Deep proficiency in modern Vue 3 (Composition API), Nuxt 3 or Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Pinia state management, and Tailwind CSS.

  • Database & ORM Skills: Strong relational database modeling and query optimization in MySQL, along with solid experience using ORMs (Doctrine ORM / DBAL or deep Eloquent experience with the ability to adapt to Doctrine quickly).

  • API Design & Caching: Deep understanding of RESTful / JSON:API standards, server-side validation error mapping, request formatting, and Redis performance caching.

  • AI-Native Workflow: Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) as a force multiplier for coding, debugging, and test creation.

  • Automated Testing: Hands-on experience writing backend test suites (PHPUnit) and frontend/E2E tests (Playwright, Vitest, or Cypress).

  • DevOps & Tooling: Solid working knowledge of Git, CI/CD release pipelines, Docker containerization, and Linux/container environments.

  • Async Communication & Autonomy: Exceptional written technical communication skills for authoring PRs, architectural design docs, and issue tracking; high autonomy to navigate multi-service codebases, solve complex blockers independently, and drive initiatives.

Good to Have

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience.

  • Certifications*:* Advanced degree or formal certifications in Cloud Architecture, Modern Software Engineering, or AI Engineering.

  • Doctrine ORM: Direct production experience with Doctrine ORM / DBAL in Laravel environments.

  • Widget & SDK Systems: Experience developing embeddable web widgets, lightweight JavaScript tracking SDKs, iframe cross-origin communication, or browser fingerprinting.

  • Modern Tooling: Experience with Nitro server engines, Bun runtime, PrimeVue components, or streaming data into data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery).

  • Payment Gateways: Integration experience with payment processors (Stripe/Braintree) and B2B subscription billing lifecycles.

  • Gemini LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating Google Gemini models (prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, Gemini API / SDKs).

  • Cloud Infrastructure (GCP): Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Kubernetes, Cloud Build).

    Bonus Skills (The "X-Factor")

    • Technical Leadership: Prior experience in a Tech Lead or Team Lead capacity—driving architectural decisions, coordinating delivery, and unblocking team members.

    • Domain Knowledge: Background in high-growth B2B SaaS platforms, grant/applicant management systems, EdTech, recruitment/ATS tools, or conversion tracking ecosystems.

    • Product-Minded Execution: Strong product ownership mindset—evaluating engineering trade-offs through the lens of user experience, conversion funnel impact, and tangible business value.


Why Join ScholarshipOwl?

  • Mission-Driven Work – Build technology that helps students unlock education opportunities

  • Fully Remote – Work from anywhere while collaborating with a global team

  • High Impact & Ownership – Small team, big challenges, real autonomy

  • Unlimited PTO – Take time when you need it, we trust you

  • Coworking Budget – $200/month to invest in your ideal coworking workspace

  • Continuous Learning Culture – We support curiosity, experimentation, and growth

  • Hardware Budget – Up to $1,600 to invest in your ideal computer.

  • Annual Company Off-sites – Meet your teammates in person and connect beyond the screen

Ready to lead and build something meaningful?

Apply now and help us shape the future of AI-powered education.

title: Water & Waste Water Operator
description:
TITLE: Water and Wastewater Operator

Potential 4-10's work weeks

Potential sign-on bonus.

POSITION PURPOSE:

Our team is growing! We are looking for a dynamic team member looking to build their career at our state-of-the-art beef processing facility. The Water and Wastewater Operator will join a department that is critical in the operation of True West Beef, having the opportunity to be a part of successfully operating a brand-new, multi-faceted, wastewater treatment operation. This position will be responsible for the day-to-day operation and maintenance of wastewater treatment equipment, biological processes, land application sites, composting operations, and a public drinking water system. Operators will fill a dynamic role with assigned duties to include sample collection, lab analysis, data management, compliance documentation, preventative maintenance, equipment repair, instrument calibration, process troubleshooting and various other related tasks. If you are a punctual and motivated self-starter who can work with or without direct supervision, apply to be a part of our team.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform daily sample collection, lab analysis, and mathematical calculations aligned with technical procedures and approved scientific methods.
  • Collect, collate, record, evaluate, and interpret technical data to support plant operations and meet regulatory compliance.
  • Provide clear and concise communication and system updates to co-workers and the management team.
  • Monitor SCADA system through HMI, review and evaluate trends, and surveil alarms.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment and troubleshooting skills.
  • Perform preventative maintenance, repair, and calibration of system equipment in coordination with the company's computerized maintenance management system.
  • Maintain all facilities and documentation in an audit-ready state through persistence and the implementation of good housekeeping practices.
  • Operate support equipment as needed (forklift, telehandler, UTV, man lift, loader, tractor, dump truck, etc.).
  • Track chemical usage and supply inventories to ensure availability and uninterrupted operation.
  • Follow written and verbal instructions. Comply with company policies and procedures including all related safe work practices.

Benefits

  • Shift 4/10 schedule
  • Paid Time Off, Floating Holidays, and Paid Holidays
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • On-the-job training
  • Opportunity for advancement

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Valid Idaho driver’s license and dependable transportation.
  • Personal cell phone and basic tools required (tools +/- $250).
  • Proficient with Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Willingness and ability to serve on call and/or work nights, weekends, or holidays.
  • Comfortable working in odorous, hot, humid, dirty, noisy, or generally unsavory environments. Comfortable working indoors, outdoors and in inclement weather.
  • Capable of lifting, pushing, or pulling 50 pounds, climbing ladders, standing, crawling, stooping, twisting, kneeling, working from a boat, working in confined spaces, working from heights, working in physically demanding situations, and safely working around hazardous chemicals or equipment.

EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Drinking water, wastewater treatment, or laboratory-related experience or certifications preferred.
  • Coursework, training, or experience in biology, chemistry, hydraulics, or mechanics is preferred.
  • A strong desire to learn the water and wastewater treatment field. Eagerness to pursue industry-related education and required professional licensing (water, wastewater).

Reports to: Environmental & Wastewater Manager

**Applicants are encouraged to submit a resume with their application.

$22 - $32 per hour, DOE

Come MEAT Us!

We grew up here. We are family-owned and call Idaho home. Join our team at our brand new, state-of-the-art beef processing plant in Jerome, ID. We produce world-renowned Snake River Farms and Double R Ranch beef, which are coveted by top chefs around the globe …. and which you will have discounted access to, becoming the hero of your backyard BBQ’s.

From ranch to table, we are involved in every step of the beef lifecycle and are committed to producing the finest beef available. We are more than just a place to work, we are a family! With ample growth opportunities, competitive benefits, and a strong family culture, we’re here to welcome you home!

title: API INSPECTOR - Austin Industrial, Inc. (Olin - Plaquemine, La)
description:
About Austin Industrial

Austin Industrial provides premier self-perform maintenance, construction, and soft craft service to leading industrial companies across the U.S. An industry leader for more than 60 years, we offer single-source solutions to our customers in the oil, gas, chemical, food, agriculture, power, and manufacturing industries.

To learn more about us, visit .

Job Description: Industrial API Inspector

Position Summary

The Industrial API Inspector is responsible for performing inspections of equipment, materials, and processes to ensure compliance with American Petroleum Institute (API) standards, industry codes, and regulatory requirements. This role supports safety, reliability, and quality assurance within industrial environments such as refineries, petrochemical plants, pipelines, and fabrication facilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct inspections in accordance with applicable API standards (e.g., API 510, 570, 653, etc.)
  • Perform visual inspections, non-destructive testing (NDT) oversight, and thickness measurements
  • Evaluate integrity of pressure vessels, piping systems, storage tanks, and related equipment
  • Review inspection data, reports, and maintenance records for compliance and accuracy
  • Identify defects, corrosion, mechanical damage, or other conditions that may impact equipment safety and performance
  • Prepare detailed inspection reports with findings, recommendations, and corrective actions
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA, client, and site-specific safety protocols
  • Coordinate with engineers, maintenance teams, and operations personnel to resolve inspection issues
  • Witness and verify repair, alteration, and testing activities
  • Maintain up-to-date certifications and knowledge of API codes and industry best practices
  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. Austin is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED (Associate’s or technical degree preferred)
  • Current API certification(s) such as:
    • API 510 (Pressure Vessel Inspector)
    • API 570 (Piping Inspector)
    • API 653 (Tank Inspector)
  • Relevant experience in inspection, maintenance, or construction within oil & gas, petrochemical, or industrial sectors
  • Strong understanding of industry codes and standards (API, ASME, ASTM, etc.)
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs, and technical documents
  • Knowledge of corrosion mechanisms and inspection techniques
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • NDT certifications (e.g., UT, RT, MT, PT)
  • Experience with RBI (Risk-Based Inspection) methodologies
  • Familiarity with inspection software and digital reporting tools
  • TWIC card or ability to obtain one
  • OSHA safety certifications

Work Environment

  • Industrial settings including refineries, chemical plants, and construction sites
  • May involve working at heights, in confined spaces, and in varying weather conditions
  • Requires use of personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Travel may be required depending on project or site assignments

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand, walk, climb, and bend for extended periods
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs
  • Comfortable working in physically demanding and potentially hazardous environments

Key Competencies

  • Safety-focused mindset
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication (written and verbal)
  • Time management and organizational skills
  • Integrity and attention to detail

Certifications & Compliance

  • Must maintain active API certifications
  • Comply with company and regulatory safety standards
  • Participate in ongoing training and re-certification as required

Physical, Mental & Environmental Requirements

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Employees must be able to sit, stand, walk, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, reach, and use hands and fingers to perform assigned duties. Positions may require lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling up to 50 pounds, working at elevations, on uneven surfaces, or in confined spaces. Employees must possess sufficient visual, hearing, communication, and motor skills to safely perform job responsibilities.

Employees must be able to read, comprehend, and follow safety procedures, work instructions, and company policies; exercise sound judgment; solve problems; maintain attention to detail; effectively manage stress; and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced work environment.

Work may be performed in industrial and construction environments with exposure to weather conditions, temperature extremes, noise, dust, fumes, moving equipment, vibration, and other site-specific hazards. Employees must be able to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) and meet all customer, site, regulatory, medical, and fitness-for-duty requirements applicable to the position.

Must be able to perform all job duties while maintaining a constant commitment to safety, quality, and productivity expectations.

Austin Industrial is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
